565.rw-bal{font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:800;font-size:2.6rem;line-height:1;color:#fff;display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:.4rem}
566.rw-bal small{font-size:.9rem;font-weight:600;opacity:.75;letter-spacing:.08em}
567.rw-worth{font-size:.8rem;opacity:.75;margin-top:.2rem}
568.rw-tierline{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.6rem;margin-top:.9rem;flex-wrap:wrap;font-size:.8rem;opacity:.9}
569.rw-badge{display:inline-block;padding:.2rem .6rem;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.16);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.06em;font-size:.72rem;text-transform:uppercase}
570.rw-prog{height:6px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.2);margin-top:.9rem;overflow:hidden}
571.rw-prog-b{height:100%;background:#fff;border-radius:999px;width:0;transition:width .4s}
572.rw-hero .ap-fine{color:rgba(255,255,255,.75)}
573.rw-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.9rem;padding:.8rem .95rem;border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r);background:var(--bg2);margin-bottom:.5rem}
574.rw-row.off{opacity:.55}
575.rw-row .rw-c{font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:800;font-size:.95rem;color:var(--navy);min-width:62px}
576.rw-row .rw-l{flex:1}
577.rw-row .rw-l strong{display:block;font-size:.86rem;color:var(--navy)}
578.rw-row .rw-l small{font-size:.72rem;color:var(--mute)}
579.rw-row .rw-l{min-width:0}
580@media(max-width:360px){.rw-row{flex-wrap:wrap}.rw-row .btn{width:100%}}
581.ob-steps{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(190px,1fr));gap:.6rem}
582.ob-step{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:.6rem;text-align:left;padding:.7rem .8rem;border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r);background:var(--bg2);cursor:pointer}
583.ob-step.on{border-color:var(--navy);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--navy)}
584.ob-step.done .ob-n{background:var(--navy);color:#fff;border-color:var(--navy)}
585.ob-n{flex-shrink:0;width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:50%;border:1.5px solid var(--line);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:.72rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--mute)}
586.ob-t strong{display:block;font-size:.84rem;color:var(--navy);font-family:var(--fd)}
587.ob-t small{font-size:.7rem;color:var(--mute);line-height:1.4}
588.ob-q{padding:.9rem 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
589.ob-q strong{display:block;font-size:.88rem;margin-bottom:.5rem;color:var(--navy)}
590.ob-a{display:block;width:100%;text-align:left;padding:.55rem .75rem;margin-bottom:.35rem;border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r);background:var(--bg2);cursor:pointer;font-size:.82rem}
591.ob-a.on{border-color:var(--navy);background:#fff;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--navy);font-weight:600}
592.ob-out{margin-top:1.1rem;padding:.9rem 1rem;border-radius:var(--r);border-left:3px solid var(--line);background:var(--bg2)}
593.ob-out strong{display:block;font-family:var(--fd);font-size:.95rem}
594.ob-out p{margin:.3rem 0 0;font-size:.82rem;color:var(--body)}
595.ob-out.contractor{border-left-color:var(--navy)}
596.ob-out.review,.ob-out.employee{border-left-color:var(--red);background:var(--red-w)}
597.ob-chk{display:flex;gap:.6rem;align-items:flex-start;padding:.6rem 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);font-size:.84rem;cursor:pointer}
598.ob-chk input{margin-top:.2rem;flex-shrink:0}
599#aiFab{position:fixed;right:18px;bottom:calc(18px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));z-index:70;width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:50%;border:none;background:var(--navy);color:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.24)}
600#aiFab:hover{background:var(--red)}
601#aiPanel{position:fixed;right:18px;bottom:calc(80px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));z-index:71;width:min(380px,calc(100vw - 36px));max-height:min(560px,calc(100vh - 140px));background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;box-shadow:0 16px 48px rgba(0,0,0,.22);display:flex;flex-direction:column;overflow:hidden}
602.ai-h{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.6rem;padding:.8rem 1rem;background:var(--navy);color:#fff}
603.ai-h strong{display:block;font-family:var(--fd);font-size:.92rem}
604.ai-h small{display:block;font-size:.72rem;opacity:.75}
605.ai-h>div{flex:1}
606.ai-x{background:none;border:none;color:#fff;font-size:1.3rem;line-height:1;cursor:pointer;opacity:.8}
607.ai-log{flex:1;overflow-y:auto;padding:.9rem 1rem;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.6rem}
608.ai-m{max-width:88%;padding:.55rem .75rem;border-radius:12px;font-size:.84rem;line-height:1.5}
609.ai-m.you{align-self:flex-end;background:var(--navy);color:#fff;border-bottom-right-radius:4px}
610.ai-m.bot{align-self:flex-start;background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom-left-radius:4px}
611.ai-m.bot a{color:var(--red);font-weight:600}
612.ai-chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.35rem;padding:0 1rem .6rem}
613.ai-chip{font-size:.74rem;padding:.3rem .6rem;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;background:var(--bg2);cursor:pointer}
614.ai-chip:hover{border-color:var(--navy)}
615.ai-in{display:flex;gap:.4rem;padding:.7rem 1rem calc(.7rem + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
616.ai-in input{flex:1;padding:.5rem .7rem;border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r);font:inherit;font-size:.84rem}
617.ai-in button{padding:.4rem .8rem;font-size:1rem;line-height:1}
618@media(max-width:560px){#aiPanel{right:10px;left:10px;width:auto;bottom:calc(76px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px))}#aiFab{right:12px;bottom:calc(12px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px))}}
619.ap-tiles{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:.7rem}
620.ap-tile{border-radius:var(--r2);padding:1.1rem;min-height:120px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:flex-end;text-align:left;border:none}
621.ap-tile.a{background:var(--red-w)}
622.ap-tile.b{background:var(--navy-w)}
623.ap-tile strong{font-family:var(--fd);font-size:var(--fs-body);font-weight:800;color:var(--ink)}
624.ap-tile small{font-size:var(--fs-micro);color:var(--body);margin-top:.15rem}
625
626/* --- profile switcher sheet --- */
627#sheet{display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:210;background:rgba(18,36,92,.45)}
628#sheet.open{display:block}
629.sheet-c{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:0;background:var(--bg2);border-radius:0 0 var(--r3) var(--r3);max-height:88vh;overflow-y:auto;box-shadow:var(--sh2)}
630.sheet-h{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:1.1rem var(--px) .5rem;max-width:760px;margin:0 auto}
631.sheet-h strong{font-family:var(--fd);font-size:var(--fs-body);color:var(--navy)}
632.sheet-h button{background:none;border:none;font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:700;font-size:var(--fs-micro);color:var(--body)}
633.sheet-b{max-width:760px;margin:0 auto;padding:.4rem var(--px) 1.6rem}
634.pchip{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.75rem;width:100%;text-align:left;border:1.5px solid var(--line);background:var(--white);border-radius:var(--r2);padding:.85rem 1rem;margin-bottom:.55rem}
635.pchip.on{background:var(--navy);border-color:var(--navy);color:var(--white)}
636.pchip i{font-style:normal;font-size:var(--fs-body)}
637.pchip div{flex:1;min-width:0}
638.pchip strong{display:block;font-family:var(--fd);font-size:var(--fs-body)}
639.pchip small{display:block;font-size:var(--fs-micro);opacity:.72;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
640.pchip em{font-style:normal;font-size:var(--fs-body)}
641
642
643/* ── SERVICE ICON GRID ───────────────────────────────────── */
644.svc-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:.65rem;margin:.5rem 0 .9rem}
645.svc-tile{all:unset;box-sizing:border-box;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:.45rem;padding:1rem .55rem .85rem;background:var(--white);border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r2);text-align:center;cursor:pointer;transition:border-color var(--tr),box-shadow var(--tr),transform var(--tr);width:100%}
646.svc-tile:hover{border-color:var(--navy-l);box-shadow:var(--e-hov);transform:translateY(var(--lift))}
647.svc-tile:active{transform:translateY(0) scale(.98)}
648.svc-tile.on{border-color:var(--red);background:var(--red-w);box-shadow:0 0 0 1px var(--red)}
649.svc-tile svg{width:30px;height:30px;stroke:var(--navy);transition:stroke var(--tr)}
650.svc-tile.on svg{stroke:var(--red-d)}
651.svc-tile s{text-decoration:none;font-family:var(--fd);font-size:var(--fs-badge);font-weight:800;color:var(--ink);line-height:1.25}
652.svc-tile sub{font-size:var(--fs-badge);font-style:normal;color:var(--mute);line-height:1.3;font-family:var(--fb)}
653.svc-more{font-size:var(--fs-micro);color:var(--navy);text-align:center;display:block;text-decoration:underline;margin-bottom:.5rem}
654
655/* ── BOOKING FILTER CHIPS ────────────────────────────────── */
656.bk-filts{display:flex;gap:.4rem;overflow-x:auto;padding-bottom:.3rem;scrollbar-width:none;margin-bottom:.85rem}
657.bk-filts::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
658.bk-filt{flex-shrink:0;font-family:var(--fd);font-size:var(--fs-badge);font-weight:700;padding:.34rem .72rem;border-radius:var(--r-pill);border:1.5px solid var(--line);background:var(--white);color:var(--body);cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap;transition:all var(--tr)}
659.bk-filt:hover{border-color:var(--navy)}
660.bk-filt.on{background:var(--navy);border-color:var(--navy);color:var(--white)}
661.bk-filt.ck{background:var(--red);border-color:var(--red);color:var(--white)}
662
663/* ── RICH BOOKING CARD (customer) ────────────────────────── */
664.bkc{background:var(--white);border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r2);margin-bottom:.85rem;overflow:hidden}
665.bkc.cx{border-color:#F4CCCC}
666.bkc.ok{border-color:#B5DFC6}
667.bkc.up{border-color:var(--navy-l)}
668.bkc-h{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.65rem;padding:.8rem 1rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
669.bkc-h i{font-style:normal;font-size:var(--fs-body);flex-shrink:0}
670.bkc-h strong{flex:1;font-family:var(--fd);font-size:var(--fs-micro);font-weight:800;color:var(--ink)}
671.bkc-b{padding:.72rem 1rem}
672.bkc-r{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:.48rem;font-size:var(--fs-micro);color:var(--body);margin:.24rem 0;line-height:1.45}
673.bkc-r i{font-style:normal;width:17px;text-align:center;flex-shrink:0;margin-top:.06rem}
674.bkc-footer{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding-top:.52rem;margin-top:.52rem;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
675.bkc-op{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.45rem;font-size:var(--fs-micro);font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:600;color:var(--body)}
676.bkc-av{width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--navy);color:#fff;font-size:var(--fs-badge);font-weight:800;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-shrink:0}
677.bkc-acts{display:flex;gap:.45rem;padding:.58rem 1rem;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
678.bkc-acts .btn{flex:1;font-size:var(--fs-micro);padding:.48rem .35rem}
679
680/* ── OPS PORTAL ──────────────────────────────────────────── */
681.ops-top{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--navy-d),var(--navy));color:var(--white);padding:1rem 0 1.2rem}
682.ops-top .ap-in{padding-top:0;padding-bottom:0}
683.ops-topr{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;gap:.75rem;padding:.7rem 0}
684.ops-kpi{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:.65rem;margin-bottom:1rem}
685.kpi-c{background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r2);padding:.9rem 1rem}
686.kpi-c h4{font-family:var(--fd);font-size:var(--fs-4);font-weight:900;color:var(--navy);line-height:1}
687.kpi-c p{font-size:var(--fs-badge);color:var(--mute);margin-top:.13rem}
688.kpi-c.red h4{color:var(--red-d)}
689.kpi-c.ok h4{color:var(--ok)}
690.ops-otabs{display:flex;gap:.4rem;overflow-x:auto;padding-bottom:.3rem;scrollbar-width:none;margin-bottom:.85rem}
691.ops-otabs::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
692.ops-otab{flex-shrink:0;font-family:var(--fd);font-size:var(--fs-badge);font-weight:700;padding:.34rem .72rem;border-radius:var(--r);border:1.5px solid var(--line);background:var(--white);color:var(--body);cursor:pointer;transition:all var(--tr);white-space:nowrap}
693.ops-otab.on{background:var(--navy);color:var(--white);border-color:var(--navy)}
694.ops-c{background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r2);margin-bottom:.85rem;overflow:hidden}
695.ops-c.new{border-left:4px solid var(--red)}
696.ops-c.assigned{border-left:4px solid var(--navy-l)}
697.ops-c.collected{border-left:4px solid var(--warn)}
698.ops-c.invoiced{border-left:4px solid var(--ok)}
699.ops-ch{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;gap:.5rem;padding:.85rem 1rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
700.ops-ref{font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:900;font-size:var(--fs-body);color:var(--navy)}
701.ops-sub{font-size:var(--fs-badge);color:var(--mute);margin-top:.1rem;line-height:1.4}
702.ops-b{padding:.72rem 1rem}
703.ops-ln{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:.45rem;font-size:var(--fs-micro);color:var(--body);margin:.22rem 0;line-height:1.45}
704.ops-ln i{font-style:normal;width:17px;text-align:center;flex-shrink:0;margin-top:.05rem}
705.ops-ln a{color:var(--navy);text-decoration:underline}
706.ops-obar{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.55rem;padding-top:.5rem;margin-top:.5rem;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
707.ops-acts2{display:flex;gap:.4rem;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:.6rem 1rem;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
708.ops-acts2 .btn{font-size:var(--fs-micro);padding:.44rem .7rem}
709.op-av2{width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:var(--r);background:var(--navy);color:#fff;font-family:var(--fd);font-size:var(--fs-micro);font-weight:800;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-shrink:0}
710.inv-preview{background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r);padding:.85rem 1rem;font-size:var(--fs-micro)}
711.inv-preview pre{white-space:pre-wrap;font-family:var(--fb);font-size:var(--fs-badge);color:var(--body);margin-top:.5rem;line-height:1.5}
712.status-line{display:flex;gap:.55rem;align-items:center;overflow-x:auto;scrollbar-width:none;padding:.75rem 1rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
713.status-line::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
714.stnode{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:.2rem;flex-shrink:0}
715.stnode-ic{width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--bg2);border:1.5px solid var(--line);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:var(--fs-micro)}
716.stnode-ic.done{background:var(--ok);border-color:var(--ok);color:#fff}
717.stnode-ic.cur{background:var(--navy);border-color:var(--navy);color:#fff}
718.stnode-lbl{font-size:var(--fs-badge);font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:700;color:var(--mute);text-align:center;line-height:1.2;max-width:52px}
719.stnode-lbl.done,.stnode-lbl.cur{color:var(--ink)}
720.stline{width:28px;height:1.5px;background:var(--line);flex-shrink:0;margin-bottom:18px}
721.stline.done{background:var(--ok)}
722/* operator list */
723.op-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.75rem;background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r2);padding:.85rem 1rem;margin-bottom:.55rem}
724.op-row div{flex:1;min-width:0}
725.op-row strong{display:block;font-family:var(--fd);font-size:var(--fs-micro)}
726.op-row small{display:block;font-size:var(--fs-micro);color:var(--mute)}
727
728
729/* ============================================================
730   HOME REBUILD — clearer hierarchy, one action per band
731   ============================================================ */
732
733/* --- hero: stripped back to promise + one action --- */
734.hero-s{max-width:720px}
735.hero-s .hero-p{max-width:52ch;margin-bottom:1.9rem}
736.hero-ph{display:none}
737.hero-ph.live{display:flex}
738
739/* --- postcode gate band --- */
740.gate{max-width:620px;margin:0 auto;text-align:center}
741.gate h2{font-family:var(--fd);font-size:var(--fs-h3);font-weight:900;color:var(--navy);letter-spacing:var(--track-h2);margin-bottom:.45rem}
742.gate p{font-size:var(--fs-body);color:var(--body);max-width:46ch;margin:0 auto 1.5rem;line-height:1.6}
743.gate .cov-f{margin-top:0}
744
745/* --- 3 bookable services --- */
746.svc3{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:1rem}
747@media(max-width:820px){.svc3{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
748.svc-c{background:var(--white);border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r2);padding:1.5rem 1.35rem;display:flex;flex-direction:column;transition:all var(--tr)}
749.svc-c:hover{border-color:var(--navy-l);box-shadow:none}
750.svc-c.hl{border-color:var(--red);box-shadow:0 0 0 1px var(--red)}
751.svc-c-tag{display:inline-block;align-self:flex-start;background:var(--red);color:#fff;font-family:var(--fd);font-size:var(--fs-badge);font-weight:800;letter-spacing:var(--track-caps);padding:.22rem .55rem;border-radius:var(--r-pill);margin-bottom:.7rem}
752.svc-c h3{font-family:var(--fd);font-size:var(--fs-body);font-weight:800;color:var(--navy);letter-spacing:var(--track-h2);margin-bottom:.45rem}
753.svc-c p{font-size:var(--fs-body);color:var(--body);line-height:1.6;flex:1;margin-bottom:1rem}
754.svc-c .price{display:block;font-family:var(--fd);font-size:var(--fs-micro);font-weight:800;color:var(--ink);padding-top:.85rem;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
755.enq-line{margin-top:1.4rem;font-size:var(--fs-micro);color:var(--body);text-align:center;line-height:1.7}
756.enq-line a{color:var(--navy);font-weight:600;text-decoration:underline}
757
758/* --- compact trust strip --- */
759.tstrip{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:1.1rem}
760@media(max-width:820px){.tstrip{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:1rem}}
761@media(max-width:460px){.tstrip{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
762.tstrip .t{display:flex;gap:.65rem;align-items:flex-start}
763.tstrip .t i{font-style:normal;font-size:var(--fs-5);flex-shrink:0;line-height:1.2}
764.tstrip .t strong{display:block;font-family:var(--fd);font-size:var(--fs-micro);font-weight:700;color:var(--navy);margin-bottom:.12rem}
765.tstrip .t span{font-size:var(--fs-micro);color:var(--body);line-height:1.55}
766
767/* --- three segment doors --- */
768.doors{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:1rem}
769@media(max-width:820px){.doors{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
770.door{display:block;background:var(--white);border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r2);padding:1.4rem 1.3rem;transition:all var(--tr)}
771.door:hover{border-color:var(--navy);box-shadow:var(--e-hov);transform:translateY(-6px)}
772.door i{font-style:normal;font-size:var(--fs-4);display:block;margin-bottom:.6rem}
773.door h3{font-family:var(--fd);font-size:var(--fs-body);font-weight:800;color:var(--navy);margin-bottom:.3rem}
774.door p{font-size:var(--fs-body);color:var(--body);line-height:1.6;margin-bottom:.7rem}
775.door span{font-family:var(--fd);font-size:var(--fs-micro);font-weight:700;color:var(--red)}
776
777/* --- estimator framing --- */
778.est-wrap{max-width:540px;margin:0 auto}
779
780/* ============================================================
781   COVERAGE — legend + region grouping
782   ============================================================ */
783.legend{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:1.2rem;justify-content:center;padding:.85rem 1.1rem;background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r2);margin-bottom:2rem}
784.lg-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.5rem;font-family:var(--fd);font-size:var(--fs-micro);font-weight:700;color:var(--ink)}
785.lg-item em{font-style:normal;font-weight:400;color:var(--mute);font-family:var(--fb);font-size:var(--fs-micro)}
786.lg-item .dot{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;flex-shrink:0}
787.dot.live{background:var(--ok)}
788.dot.soon{background:var(--warn)}
789
790.rgrp{margin-bottom:1.9rem}
791.rgrp-h{display:flex;align-items:baseline;justify-content:space-between;gap:1rem;padding-bottom:.55rem;margin-bottom:.85rem;border-bottom:1.5px solid var(--line)}
792.rgrp-h h3{font-family:var(--fd);font-size:var(--fs-body);font-weight:800;color:var(--navy);letter-spacing:var(--track-h3)}
793.rgrp-h span{font-size:var(--fs-micro);color:var(--mute);font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:600;white-space:nowrap}
794.sub{cursor:pointer}
795.sub.is-soon{background:var(--bg2)}
796.sub-pc{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.45rem;color:var(--mute);font-weight:500;font-size:var(--fs-micro)}
797
798
799/* ============================================================
800   HOME v4 — colour discipline, hierarchy, real layout
801   Red = CTAs only. Navy for structure. Steps in navy circles.
802   ============================================================ */
803
804/* ── hero: 2-col with illustration right ─────────────────── */
805.hero-v4{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.06fr .94fr;gap:2.75rem;align-items:center;position:relative;z-index:1}
806@media(max-width:860px){.hero-v4{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:2rem}}
807.hero-v4 .hero-p{max-width:46ch;margin-bottom:1.7rem;font-size:var(--fs-5)}
808.hero-local{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.4rem;font-family:var(--fd);font-size:var(--fs-badge);font-weight:700;color:var(--on-navy-2);margin-top:1.4rem;letter-spacing:var(--track-micro)}
809.hero-local::before{content:'';width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--ok);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(15,123,79,.3)}
810@media(max-width:480px){.hero-acts .btn{flex:1;min-width:0}}
811
812/* right column: illustration + price teaser stacked */
813.hero-right{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:1rem}
814.hero-ill{background:transparent}
815@media(max-width:860px){.hero-ill{max-width:340px;margin:0 auto;order:-1}}
816.hero-pc{background:var(--white);border-radius:var(--r2);padding:1.25rem 1.35rem;box-shadow:var(--sh2);color:var(--ink)}
817.hero-pc-label{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;font-size:var(--fs-badge);color:var(--mute);font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:var(--track-caps);margin-bottom:.75rem}
818.hero-pc-label span{color:var(--ok);background:var(--ok-bg);padding:.15rem .5rem;border-radius:var(--r-pill);font-size:var(--fs-badge)}
819.hero-pc-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:var(--fs-micro);color:var(--body);padding:.24rem 0}
820.hero-pc-tot{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;border-top:1.5px solid var(--line);padding-top:.7rem;margin-top:.5rem}
821.hero-pc-tot-l{font-family:var(--fd);font-size:var(--fs-micro);color:var(--mute);font-weight:700}
822.hero-pc-tot-v{font-family:var(--fd);font-size:var(--fs-3);font-weight:900;color:var(--navy);line-height:1}
823.hero-pc-note{font-size:var(--fs-badge);color:var(--mute);margin-top:.7rem;line-height:1.55;text-align:center}
824.hero-pc .btn{margin-top:.9rem}
825
826/* ── trust band (position 2) ─────────────────────────────── */
827#trustband{background:var(--navy-w);border-top:1px solid #E1E7F5;border-bottom:1px solid #E1E7F5;padding:2.4rem 0}
828.trust-g{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:1rem}
829@media(max-width:720px){.trust-g{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
830@media(max-width:440px){.trust-g{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
831.trust-c{display:block;background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r2);padding:1.25rem 1.2rem;transition:border-color var(--tr),box-shadow var(--tr),transform var(--tr)}
832.trust-c:hover{border-color:var(--navy-l);box-shadow:var(--e-hov);transform:translateY(-6px)}
833.trust-ic{width:34px;height:34px;color:var(--navy);margin-bottom:.7rem}
834.trust-h{font-family:var(--fd);font-size:var(--fs-micro);font-weight:700;color:var(--navy);margin-bottom:.3rem;letter-spacing:var(--track-h3)}
835.trust-p{font-size:var(--fs-micro);color:var(--body);line-height:1.55;margin-bottom:.55rem}
836.trust-l{font-size:var(--fs-badge);color:var(--navy);font-weight:700;font-family:var(--fd)}
837.trust-c:hover .trust-l{text-decoration:underline}
838
839/* ── steps: navy numbers + connecting line ───────────────── */
840.steps-wrap{position:relative}
841.steps-line{position:absolute;top:22px;left:20%;right:20%;height:2px;background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,var(--navy-l) 0 6px,transparent 6px 12px);opacity:.35;pointer-events:none}
842@media(max-width:660px){.steps-line{display:none}}
843.step-n{width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--navy-w);color:var(--navy);border:2px solid var(--navy-l);font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:900;font-size:var(--fs-5);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;margin-bottom:1rem;position:relative;z-index:1}
844.step-ic{width:26px;height:26px;color:var(--navy-l);margin-bottom:.7rem;display:block}
845@media(max-width:660px){.steps{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
846
847/* ── services: navy middle card + per-card CTA ───────────── */
848/* minmax(0,...) rather than 1fr: a plain 1fr track will not shrink below
849   its min-content, so a long CTA label ("Book Wash, Fold & Premium")
850   widened the whole card past the viewport instead of wrapping. */
851.svc3{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:1rem}
852@media(max-width:860px){.svc3{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}}
853@media(max-width:580px){.svc3{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}}
854.svc-c{min-width:0}
855.svc-c .svc-cta{white-space:normal;text-align:center}
856.svc-c{display:flex;flex-direction:column}
857.svc-cta{margin-top:1rem;width:100%}
858.svc-c.hl{background:var(--navy);border-color:var(--navy);color:#fff}
859.svc-c.hl h3{color:#fff}
860.svc-c.hl p{color:var(--on-navy-2)}
861.svc-c.hl .price{color:var(--on-navy);border-top-color:rgba(255,255,255,.22)}
862.svc-c.hl .svc-cta{background:var(--red);color:#fff}
863.svc-c.hl .svc-cta:hover{background:var(--red-d)}
864
865/* ── legends club savings box ──────────────────────────────── */
866.kc-save{background:var(--navy-raised);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.28);border-radius:var(--r2);padding:.9rem 1.1rem;margin:1.1rem 0 1.6rem}
867.kc-save-t{font-family:var(--fd);font-size:var(--fs-badge);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:var(--track-caps);color:var(--on-navy-2);margin-bottom:.35rem}
868.kc-save-m{color:#fff;font-size:var(--fs-micro);line-height:1.5}
869.kc-save-m b{color:var(--on-navy);font-weight:800}
870.plan .amt small{display:block;margin-top:.35rem;font-size:var(--fs-badge);color:var(--on-navy-2);font-weight:500;font-family:var(--fb)}
871.plan-cap{font-size:var(--fs-micro);color:var(--on-navy-2);margin-top:.5rem;padding-top:.5rem;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12)}
872
873/* ── coverage: 2-col checker + live suburb chips ─────────── */
874.cov2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:2.5rem;align-items:start}
875@media(max-width:820px){.cov2{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:1.6rem}}
876.cov2-l .cov-f{margin-top:1.2rem}
877.cov-live{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.45rem}
878.cov-chip{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.4rem;background:var(--white);border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-pill);padding:.4rem .8rem;font-family:var(--fd);font-size:var(--fs-micro);font-weight:600;color:var(--navy);cursor:pointer;transition:border-color var(--tr),background var(--tr),box-shadow var(--tr),transform .15s var(--ease)}
879.cov-chip:hover{border-color:var(--ok);background:var(--ok-bg);box-shadow:var(--e-hov);transform:translateY(-2px)}
880.cov-chip:active{transform:translateY(0) scale(.96)}
881.cov-chip .d{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--ok);flex-shrink:0}
882.cov2-h{font-family:var(--fd);font-size:var(--fs-micro);font-weight:800;letter-spacing:var(--track-caps);color:var(--mute);margin-bottom:.9rem}
883
884/* ── early adopter red band (replaces empty reviews) ─────── */
885#adopt{background:var(--red);color:#fff;padding:var(--spy) 0}
886.adopt-in{text-align:center;max-width:640px;margin:0 auto}
887.adopt-in .eyebrow{color:var(--white)}
888.adopt-in h2{color:#fff;font-size:var(--fs-h2);margin:.6rem auto 1rem;max-width:26ch;letter-spacing:var(--track-h2);line-height:1.15}
889.adopt-in p{color:var(--on-navy);max-width:52ch;margin:0 auto 1.9rem;font-size:var(--fs-body);line-height:1.65}
890.btn-white{background:#fff;color:var(--red-d);padding:.9rem 2.2rem;font-size:var(--fs-body);font-weight:800}
891.btn-white:hover{background:#FCEFEC}
892
893/* ── segment doors: nav-style, no heading ────────────────── */
894.doors-lead{font-size:var(--fs-micro);color:var(--mute);text-align:center;margin-bottom:1.3rem;font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:600}
895.door{display:block;background:var(--white);border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r2);padding:1.35rem 1.3rem;transition:all var(--tr)}
896.door:hover{border-color:var(--navy);box-shadow:var(--e-hov);transform:translateY(-6px)}
897.door-ic{width:30px;height:30px;color:var(--navy);margin-bottom:.6rem;display:block}
898.door h3{font-family:var(--fd);font-size:var(--fs-body);font-weight:800;color:var(--navy);margin-bottom:.3rem}
899.door p{font-size:var(--fs-micro);color:var(--body);line-height:1.55;margin-bottom:.6rem}
900.door .go{font-family:var(--fd);font-size:var(--fs-micro);font-weight:700;color:var(--red)}
901
902
903/* ── skeleton loading states ─────────────────────────────── */
904@keyframes lkshimmer{0%{background-position:-420px 0}100%{background-position:420px 0}}
905.skel{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#EEF0F6 25%,#E1E5EE 50%,#EEF0F6 75%);background-size:840px 100%;animation:lkshimmer 1.35s ease-in-out infinite;border-radius:var(--r)}
906.skel-card{background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r2);padding:1rem 1.1rem;margin-bottom:.85rem}
907.skel-line{height:12px;margin:.4rem 0}
908.skel-line.w40{width:40%}.skel-line.w60{width:60%}.skel-line.w80{width:80%}.skel-line.w25{width:25%}
909.skel-kpi{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:.65rem;margin-bottom:1rem}
910.skel-kpi>div{height:76px}
911
912
913/* ── mobile audit fixes (KEA-9) ─────────────────────────── */
914/* nav overflow at phone widths: brand + CTA + burger ≈ 400px */
915@media(max-width:480px){
916  .brand-tag{display:none}
917  .brand-wm{font-size:var(--fs-body)}
918  .brand svg{width:30px;height:30px}
919  .nav-cta .btn-red{padding:.48rem .8rem;font-size:var(--fs-micro)}
920  .nav-cta{gap:.45rem}
921  /* The brand and the CTA were both flex-shrink:0, so when their natural
922     widths exceeded the bar neither could give and the burger was pushed
923     off-screen. The brand yields instead: the mark stays, the wordmark
924     truncates only if it has to. */
925  .nav-in{gap:.6rem}
926  .brand{flex-shrink:1;min-width:0}
927  .brand-wm{overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
928}
929/* 2.2rem of side padding on the closing CTA left its label wider than a
930   320px screen. Let it wrap and give back some of the padding. */
931@media(max-width:360px){
932  .btn-white{padding-left:1.1rem;padding-right:1.1rem;white-space:normal}
933}
934/* tap targets ≥ 40px on all chip/stepper/back controls */
935.bk-filt,.ops-otab,.cov-chip,.dtab{min-height:38px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center}
936.stepper button{min-width:44px;min-height:44px}
937.ap-back{width:40px;height:40px}
938.faq button{min-height:48px}
939/* hero on phones: decoration below the fold is wasted — keep the price card, drop the illustration */
940@media(max-width:600px){
941  .hero-ill{display:none}
942  .hero-pc{margin-top:.25rem}
943}
944/* long headings on phones */
945@media(max-width:400px){
946  .hero-h{font-size:var(--fs-3)}
947  .h2{font-size:var(--fs-5)}
948}
949/* sticky wizard bar must not sit under the bottom tab bar on very short viewports */
950@media(max-height:640px){.ap-bar{position:static;margin-top:1rem;box-shadow:none}}
951
952
953/* Prices and figures align on the decimal. */
954.amt,.price,.qtot-v,.qtot-n,.hero-pc-tot-v,.hero-pc-row,.sumr,.bd,.prow,.kpi-c h4,.ptab,.inv-preview,.card .price,.svc-c .price,.opt-p,.pchip strong,.plan .amt,.cov-chip,.chip,.bkc-r,.num{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;font-feature-settings:'tnum' 1}
955
956/* ---------- ICONS ----------
957   One set, 24px grid, 1.75 stroke, currentColor. No emoji anywhere. */
958.ic{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex:none;
959    width:24px;height:24px;font-style:normal;color:inherit}
960svg.ic{width:24px;height:24px}
961.ic>svg{width:100%;height:100%;display:block}
962.ic-inl{width:1.05em;height:1.05em;vertical-align:-.16em;margin-right:.34em}
963.ic-aft{margin:0 0 0 .4em}
964.ic-sm{width:18px;height:18px}
965.ic-lg{width:32px;height:32px}
966
967/* ---------- PHASE B ---------- */
968/* Mobile menu: one CTA, five primary, the rest behind More. */
969.mob-cta{display:flex!important;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
970  background:var(--red);color:var(--white)!important;border-radius:var(--r);
971  padding:.9rem 1rem!important;margin-bottom:1.1rem;border-bottom:none!important;
972  font-size:var(--fs-5);font-weight:800}
973.mob-cta:hover{background:var(--red-d);text-decoration:none!important}
974.mob-more{display:flex;align-items:center;width:100%;background:none;border:none;
975  border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);color:var(--on-navy-2);
976  font-family:var(--fd);font-size:var(--fs-5);font-weight:700;padding:.7rem 0;cursor:pointer}
977.mob-more.on .ic{transform:rotate(180deg)}
978.mob-more .ic{transition:transform var(--tr)}
979#mobRest a{color:var(--on-navy-2)}
980
981/* Footer: two link groups and a legal row. */
982/* nowrap kept the three legal links on one line, which is 339px — wider
983   than a 320px phone — so the footer alone scrolled every page sideways.
984   The separators still read correctly when the row wraps. */
985.foot-legal{display:block;white-space:normal}
986.foot-legal a{color:var(--on-navy-2);text-decoration:underline}
987.foot-legal a:hover{color:var(--white)}
988
989/* Coverage: the input leads, the button follows. */
990.cov-f .btn-out{flex:none;white-space:nowrap}
991
992/* What a load looks like — sets the expectation before the scales do. */
993.load-look{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.45rem;margin:.85rem 0 0;grid-column:1/-1}
994.load-look span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.4rem;line-height:1.3;
995  background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-pill);
996  padding:.3rem .75rem;font-size:var(--fs-micro);color:var(--body)}
997.load-look .ic{width:16px;height:16px;color:var(--navy)}
998
999@media(max-width:900px){
1000  /* The logo is the heaviest thing in the bar, not the CTA (D14). */
1001  .nav-cta .btn-red{padding:.5rem .8rem;font-size:var(--fs-micro);font-weight:700}
1002  .nav-cta .btn-ghost{display:none}
1003}
1004
1005/* ---------- PHASE C ---------- */
1006/* D5 — the stepper is one control, not three things at opposite edges. */
1007.stepper{max-width:150px;justify-content:space-between}
1008.stepper span{min-width:2.4ch;flex:0 1 auto;font-size:var(--fs-body);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
1009.stepper button{padding:.5rem .7rem;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
1010.stepper button .ic{width:18px;height:18px}
1011
1012/* D1 — the active tab wears a pill, not just red text. */
1013.tab{position:relative}
1014.tab i{filter:none;color:var(--mute);width:26px;height:26px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
1015.tab i .ic,.tab .ic{width:24px;height:24px}
1016.tab.on i{color:var(--red)}
1017.tab.on i::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:.38rem;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);
1018  width:46px;height:28px;border-radius:var(--r-pill);background:var(--red-w);z-index:-1}
1019.tab.on s{color:var(--red)}
1020
1021/* D10 — the wizard card header stacks rather than squeezing. */
1022@media(max-width:480px){
1023  .ap-card-h{flex-wrap:wrap;row-gap:.2rem}
1024  .ap-card-h span{flex-basis:100%}
1025}
1026
1027/* Status timeline. */
1028.bk-tl{list-style:none;display:flex;margin:.9rem 0 .2rem;padding:0;counter-reset:none}
1029.bk-tl li{flex:1;position:relative;text-align:center;font-size:var(--fs-badge);
1030  font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:700;color:var(--mute);letter-spacing:var(--track-micro)}
1031.bk-tl li::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:5px;left:-50%;width:100%;height:2px;background:var(--line)}
1032.bk-tl li:first-child::before{display:none}
1033.bk-tl li.done::before,.bk-tl li.now::before{background:var(--navy)}
1034.bk-tl-d{display:block;width:12px;height:12px;margin:0 auto .34rem;border-radius:50%;
1035  background:var(--white);border:2px solid var(--line);position:relative;z-index:1}
1036.bk-tl li.done .bk-tl-d{background:var(--navy);border-color:var(--navy)}
1037.bk-tl li.now .bk-tl-d{background:var(--red);border-color:var(--red);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--red-w)}
1038.bk-tl li.done,.bk-tl li.now{color:var(--navy)}
1039.bk-tl-l{display:block}
1040
1041/* Install offer. */
1042#lkInstall{position:fixed;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;z-index:180;display:none;gap:1rem;
1043  align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap;
1044  background:var(--white);border-top:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:var(--sh2);
1045  padding:1rem 1.15rem calc(1rem + env(safe-area-inset-bottom))}
1046#lkInstall.show{display:flex}
1047#lkInstall strong{display:block;font-family:var(--fd);font-size:var(--fs-body);color:var(--ink)}
1048#lkInstall small{display:block;font-size:var(--fs-micro);color:var(--mute);margin-top:.15rem}
1049.lk-inst-acts{display:flex;gap:.55rem;flex:none}
1050
1051/* Screen-reader-only text. */
1052.sr-only{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;padding:0;margin:-1px;overflow:hidden;
1053  clip:rect(0 0 0 0);white-space:nowrap;border:0}
1054
1055/* A visible focus ring everywhere, not only where someone remembered. */
1056:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--navy);outline-offset:2px;border-radius:2px}
1057.sec-navy :focus-visible,#foot :focus-visible,#mob :focus-visible,#nav :focus-visible{outline-color:var(--white)}
1058
1059/* Entry motion, off by default for anyone who asks for less. */
1060@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference){
1061  .reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(12px)}
1062  .reveal.in{opacity:1;transform:none;transition:opacity .32s ease-out,transform .32s ease-out}
1063}
1064
1065/* ── home v5 ── */
1066
1067/* ═════ HOME v5 ═════ */
1068.reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(18px);transition:opacity .6s var(--ease),transform .6s var(--ease)}
1069.reveal.in{opacity:1;transform:none}
1070@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.reveal{opacity:1;transform:none;transition:none}}
1071.sr-only{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;padding:0;margin:-1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0,0,0,0);border:0}
1072.hd-2c{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;gap:1.5rem;align-items:end;text-align:left}
1073.hd-2c .eyebrow{text-align:left}
1074.hd-2c .h2{text-align:left;margin-bottom:.4rem}
1075.h2-sub{color:var(--body);font-size:var(--fs-body);max-width:60ch;margin:0}
1076.hd-a{color:var(--navy);font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:700;font-size:var(--fs-micro);white-space:nowrap;padding:.55rem 0;border-bottom:1.5px solid var(--navy)}
1077.hd-a:hover{color:var(--red)}
1078.hd-note{color:var(--mute);font-size:var(--fs-micro);white-space:nowrap;align-self:end}
1079@media (max-width:720px){.hd-2c{grid-template-columns:1fr;text-align:left}.hd-a,.hd-note{white-space:normal}}
1080
1081/* ── Hero v5 ── */
1082.hero5{background:var(--navy);color:#fff;padding:2.6rem 0 1.8rem;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
1083.hero5::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 88% 8%,rgba(232,96,74,.18),transparent 55%),radial-gradient(circle at 10% 90%,rgba(43,75,170,.28),transparent 45%);pointer-events:none}
1084.h5-grid{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.15fr .95fr;gap:2.4rem;align-items:start}
1085.h5-l{padding-top:.5rem}
1086.h5-eyebrow{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.5rem;font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:700;font-size:var(--fs-micro);letter-spacing:var(--track-caps);color:#fff;background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15);padding:.35rem .75rem;border-radius:999px;text-transform:uppercase}
1087.h5-dot{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:#4ade80;box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(74,222,128,.7);animation:h5Pulse 2.4s var(--ease) infinite}
1088@keyframes h5Pulse{0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(74,222,128,.6)}70%{box-shadow:0 0 0 10px rgba(74,222,128,0)}100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(74,222,128,0)}}
1089.h5-h{font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:900;font-size:var(--fs-hero);line-height:1.05;letter-spacing:var(--track-hero);margin:1rem 0 .8rem;color:#fff}
1090.h5-h-em{display:block;font-weight:500;font-size:.58em;line-height:1.25;letter-spacing:normal;color:rgba(255,255,255,.82);margin-top:.7rem}
1091.h5-p{font-size:var(--fs-body);line-height:1.55;color:rgba(255,255,255,.9);max-width:52ch;margin:0 0 1.2rem}
1092.h5-cta{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.7rem;margin-bottom:1.2rem}
1093.btn-ghost-nv{background:transparent;color:#fff;border:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.35);padding:.85rem 1.7rem;font-size:var(--fs-body);border-radius:var(--r)}
1094.btn-ghost-nv:hover{border-color:#fff;background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);transform:translateY(var(--lift));box-shadow:var(--e-hov-dk)}
1095.h5-chips{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:0;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.4rem .9rem}
1096.h5-chips li{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.4rem;font-size:var(--fs-micro);color:rgba(255,255,255,.85)}
1097.ic-tk{width:14px;height:14px;color:#4ade80;flex-shrink:0}
1098
1099/* Hero quote widget */
1100.h5-r{background:#fff;color:var(--body);border-radius:var(--r-lg);padding:1.3rem 1.35rem 1.15rem;box-shadow:var(--e-sheet);border:1px solid rgba(12,38,95,.08)}
1101.h5-q-hd{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:.85rem;padding-bottom:.7rem;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(12,38,95,.1)}
1102.h5-q-lbl{font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:800;font-size:var(--fs-micro);letter-spacing:var(--track-caps);color:var(--navy);text-transform:uppercase}
1103.h5-q-gst{font-size:11px;color:var(--mute);font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.02em}
1104.h5-q-row{margin-bottom:.85rem}
1105.h5-q-l{display:block;font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:700;font-size:var(--fs-micro);color:var(--navy);margin-bottom:.45rem}
1106.h5-q-hint{font-weight:400;color:var(--mute);font-size:12px;margin-left:.35rem}
1107.h5-seg{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;background:var(--paper);border-radius:10px;padding:3px;gap:2px}
1108.h5-seg button{border:none;background:transparent;font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:700;font-size:var(--fs-micro);color:var(--navy);padding:.55rem .5rem;border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer;transition:background var(--tr),color var(--tr);text-align:center}
1109.h5-seg button.on{background:var(--navy);color:#fff}
1110.h5-stepper{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;background:var(--paper);border-radius:10px;padding:2px;width:150px}
1111.h5-st-b{width:44px;height:44px;border:none;background:transparent;color:var(--navy);font-weight:700;font-size:20px;cursor:pointer;border-radius:8px;transition:background var(--tr)}
1112.h5-st-b:hover{background:rgba(12,38,95,.08)}
1113.h5-st-v{flex:1;text-align:center;font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:800;font-size:var(--fs-4);color:var(--navy);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
1114.h5-st-v.bump{animation:stepBump .3s var(--ease-spring)}
1115.h5-lin{display:grid;gap:.55rem}
1116.h5-linrow{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:.6rem}
1117.h5-linrow span{font-size:var(--fs-micro);color:var(--body)}
1118.h5-linrow span em{font-style:normal;color:var(--mute);margin-left:.3rem;font-weight:600}
1119.h5-linrow .h5-stepper{width:130px}
1120.h5-linrow .h5-st-b{width:38px;height:38px;font-size:18px}
1121.h5-linrow .h5-st-v{font-size:var(--fs-5)}
1122.h5-q-break{height:1px;background:rgba(12,38,95,.1);margin:.55rem 0}
1123.h5-q-line{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:var(--fs-micro);color:var(--body);padding:.28rem 0}
1124.h5-q-tot{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;padding:.55rem 0 .1rem;border-top:1px solid rgba(12,38,95,.1);margin-top:.35rem}
1125.h5-q-tot span:first-child{font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:700;color:var(--navy);font-size:var(--fs-micro)}
1126.h5-q-tot span:last-child{font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:900;color:var(--navy);font-size:var(--fs-2);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
1127.h5-q-min{font-size:11px;color:var(--mute);margin:0 0 .8rem;min-height:14px}
1128.h5-q-cta{margin-top:.4rem}
1129.h5-q-note{font-size:11px;color:var(--mute);margin:.55rem 0 0;text-align:center;line-height:1.4}
1130.tab{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
1131
1132/* Hero live metrics strip */
1133.h5-metrics{position:relative;margin-top:1.8rem;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:0;background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);border-radius:var(--r);padding:0;overflow:hidden}
1134.h5-met{padding:.85rem 1rem;text-align:center;position:relative}
1135.h5-met+.h5-met::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:15%;bottom:15%;width:1px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.15)}
1136.h5-met-v{display:block;font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:900;font-size:var(--fs-4);color:#fff;line-height:1.1;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
1137.h5-met-l{display:block;font-size:11px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.7);margin-top:.15rem;letter-spacing:.02em}
1138
1139@media (max-width:900px){
1140  .h5-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:1.5rem}
1141  .h5-h{font-size:clamp(2rem,7vw,2.6rem)}
1142  .h5-h-em{font-size:.66em}
1143  .h5-metrics{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
1144  .h5-met:nth-child(3)::before{display:none}
1145  .h5-met:nth-child(3),.h5-met:nth-child(4){border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15)}
1146}
1147@media (max-width:520px){
1148  .hero5{padding:1.8rem 0 1.4rem}
1149  .h5-h{font-size:clamp(1.75rem,7.4vw,2.2rem)}
1150  .h5-r{padding:1.1rem 1rem}
1151  .h5-metrics{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
1152}
1153
1154/* ── Coverage map ── */
1155#mapband{background:var(--paper);padding:2.6rem 0}
1156.pc-inline{display:flex;gap:.45rem;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
1157.pc-inline input{width:170px;padding:.65rem .8rem;border:1.5px solid rgba(12,38,95,.15);background:#fff;border-radius:8px;font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:700;font-size:var(--fs-body);color:var(--navy);text-align:center;letter-spacing:.05em}
1158.pc-inline input:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--navy);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(12,38,95,.15)}
1159.pc-msg{font-size:var(--fs-micro);color:var(--navy);font-weight:600;padding-left:.4rem}
1160.pc-msg.ok{color:#0d7a3f}
1161.pc-msg.no{color:var(--red-d)}
1162.mapc{margin-top:1.4rem;background:#fff;border-radius:var(--r-lg);padding:1.5rem;border:1px solid rgba(12,38,95,.08);position:relative}
1163.map-svg{width:100%;max-width:440px;max-height:520px;height:auto;margin:0 auto;display:block}
1164.map-region{font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:800;font-size:14px;fill:rgba(12,38,95,.35);letter-spacing:3px}
1165.map-pin{cursor:pointer;transition:transform .18s var(--ease)}
1166.map-pin:hover,.map-pin:focus{transform:scale(1.25)}
1167.map-pin-c{transition:fill var(--tr)}
1168.map-pin.live .map-pin-c{fill:#D84330}
1169.map-pin.soon .map-pin-c{fill:#f7a94e;opacity:.7}
1170.map-pin.you .map-pin-c{fill:#0C265F}
1171.map-pin.you .map-pulse{fill:url(#gPulse);animation:mapPulse 2s ease-out infinite}
1172@keyframes mapPulse{0%{r:8;opacity:1}100%{r:26;opacity:0}}
1173.map-tt-t{fill:#fff;font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:700;font-size:11px}
1174.map-tt-s{fill:rgba(255,255,255,.75);font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:500;font-size:9.5px}
1175.map-legend{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:1.4rem;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:1rem;font-size:var(--fs-micro);color:var(--body)}
1176.ml-i{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.4rem}
1177.ml-d{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;display:inline-block}
1178.ml-live{background:#D84330}
1179.ml-soon{background:#f7a94e;opacity:.75}
1180.ml-you{background:#0C265F;box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(12,38,95,.2)}
1181.map-all{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.35rem;color:var(--navy);font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:700;font-size:var(--fs-micro);margin-top:.9rem;padding-top:.9rem;border-top:1px solid rgba(12,38,95,.08);width:100%;justify-content:center}
1182.map-all:hover{color:var(--red)}
1183
1184/* ── Bento ── */
1185#bento{padding:3rem 0;background:#fff}
1186.bento{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(6,1fr);grid-auto-rows:minmax(150px,auto);gap:1rem;margin-top:1.4rem}
1187.bn{background:var(--paper);border:1px solid rgba(12,38,95,.08);border-radius:var(--r-lg);padding:1.4rem;transition:transform .22s var(--ease),box-shadow .22s var(--ease),border-color var(--tr);position:relative;overflow:hidden}
1188.bn:hover{transform:translateY(var(--lift));box-shadow:var(--e-hov);border-color:rgba(12,38,95,.16)}
1189.bn-1{grid-column:span 3;grid-row:span 2;background:var(--navy);color:#fff}
1190.bn-1 .bn-num{color:rgba(255,255,255,.72)}
1191.bn-1 .bn-h{color:#fff}
1192.bn-1 .bn-s-n{background:rgba(255,255,255,.12);color:#fff}
1193.bn-1 .bn-steps li>div>strong{color:#fff}
1194.bn-1 .bn-steps li>div>span{color:rgba(255,255,255,.75)}
1195.bn-2{grid-column:span 3;background:var(--red);color:#fff}
1196.bn-2 .bn-ic,.bn-2 .bn-h-s{color:#fff}
1197.bn-2 .bn-p{color:rgba(255,255,255,.92)}
1198.bn-3{grid-column:span 3}
1199.bn-4{grid-column:span 2}
1200.bn-5{grid-column:span 2}
1201.bn-6{grid-column:span 2}
1202.bn-num{font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:900;font-size:var(--fs-micro);color:var(--mute);letter-spacing:.08em;margin-bottom:.5rem}
1203.bn-h{font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:900;font-size:var(--fs-3);color:var(--navy);line-height:1.15;margin:0 0 1rem;letter-spacing:var(--track-h1)}
1204.bn-h-s{font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:800;font-size:var(--fs-5);color:var(--navy);line-height:1.2;margin:.4rem 0 .35rem;letter-spacing:var(--track-h2)}
1205.bn-p{font-size:var(--fs-micro);line-height:1.5;color:var(--body);margin:0}

1233.s3-h{font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:800;font-size:var(--fs-4);color:var(--navy);letter-spacing:var(--track-h2);margin:.2rem 0 .5rem;line-height:1.15}
1234.s3-p{font-size:var(--fs-micro);line-height:1.5;color:var(--body);margin:0;flex:1}

1249#clubband .hd{position:relative}

1262.kc-perks li::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:.35rem;width:14px;height:14px;background:url("data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 24 24' fill='none' stroke='%234ade80' stroke-width='2.6' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'><path d='M20 7L9 18l-5-5'/></svg>") no-repeat center/contain}
1263.kc-calc{background:rgba(255,255,255,.94);color:var(--navy);border-radius:var(--r-lg);padding:1.6rem 1.5rem;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
1264.kc-calc-hd{font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:800;font-size:var(--fs-5);letter-spacing:.01em;color:var(--navy);margin-bottom:1rem;padding-bottom:.9rem;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(12,38,95,.1)}
1265.kc-calc-l{font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:600;font-size:var(--fs-micro);color:var(--body);margin-bottom:.7rem;line-height:1.5}
1266.kc-calc-l strong{font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:900;font-size:var(--fs-4);color:var(--navy);display:inline-block;margin-right:.2rem;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
1267.kc-range{width:100%;-webkit-appearance:none;appearance:none;height:24px;background:transparent;background-image:linear-gradient(to right,var(--navy) 0%,var(--navy) var(--kc-fill,25%),rgba(12,38,95,.15) var(--kc-fill,25%),rgba(12,38,95,.15) 100%);background-repeat:no-repeat;background-position:center;background-size:100% 6px;border-radius:3px;outline:none;margin:.6rem 0 1.2rem;padding:0;cursor:pointer}
1268.kc-range::-webkit-slider-runnable-track{height:6px;background:transparent;border-radius:3px}
1269.kc-range::-moz-range-track{height:6px;background:transparent;border-radius:3px}
1270.kc-range::-webkit-slider-thumb{-webkit-appearance:none;appearance:none;width:22px;height:22px;background:var(--red);border:3px solid #fff;border-radius:50%;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.2)}
1271.kc-range::-moz-range-thumb{width:22px;height:22px;background:var(--red);border:3px solid #fff;border-radius:50%;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.2)}
1272.kc-range:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--navy);outline-offset:4px}
1273.kc-calc-out{background:var(--paper);border-radius:12px;padding:1rem 1.15rem;margin-bottom:.8rem}
1274.kc-calc-line{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;padding:.28rem 0;font-size:var(--fs-micro);color:var(--body)}
1275.kc-calc-tot{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;padding:.6rem 0 .1rem;border-top:1px solid rgba(12,38,95,.1);margin-top:.4rem}

1277.kc-calc-tot span:last-child{font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:900;color:var(--red-d);font-size:var(--fs-3);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}

1281/* ── Voices marquee ── */
1282#voices{padding:2.6rem 0 .5rem;background:#fff}
1283.mq{overflow:hidden;padding:1.6rem 0 2.6rem;margin-top:1rem;position:relative;-webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(to right,transparent,#000 8%,#000 92%,transparent);mask-image:linear-gradient(to right,transparent,#000 8%,#000 92%,transparent)}
1284.mq-track{display:flex;gap:1rem;animation:mqScroll 45s linear infinite;width:max-content}
1285.mq:hover .mq-track{animation-play-state:paused}
1286@keyframes mqScroll{from{transform:translateX(0)}to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}
1287@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.mq-track{animation:none}}
1288.mq-c{flex-shrink:0;width:320px;background:var(--paper);border:1px solid rgba(12,38,95,.08);border-radius:var(--r-lg);padding:1.3rem;margin:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;min-height:150px}
1289.mq-c blockquote{margin:0 0 1rem;font-size:var(--fs-body);line-height:1.4;color:var(--navy);font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:500;letter-spacing:var(--track-h2)}

1292/* ── Segment strip ── */
1293#segband{padding:2rem 0;background:var(--paper)}
1294.segs{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:.9rem}

1296.seg:hover{transform:translateY(var(--lift));box-shadow:var(--e-hov);border-color:rgba(12,38,95,.2)}

1300.seg span{font-size:11px;color:var(--body);line-height:1.4}

1304/* ── Final compact CTA ── */

1306.fcta{background-color:var(--navy);background-image:linear-gradient(120deg,var(--navy) 0%,var(--navy-d) 100%);border-radius:var(--r-lg);padding:1.4rem 1.8rem;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:1.2rem;color:#fff}

1312/* ── Sticky mobile CTA ── */
1313.stickyCta{display:none;position:fixed;bottom:calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px) + .8rem);left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);background:var(--red);color:#fff;font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:800;font-size:var(--fs-micro);padding:.85rem 1.35rem;border-radius:999px;box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(196,56,40,.4);z-index:50;align-items:center;gap:.5rem;letter-spacing:.02em}
1314.stickyCta:hover{background:var(--red-d);transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(-2px)}
1315.stickyCta .ic{width:16px;height:16px}
1316/* The pill yields to any in-content booking CTA and to the footer, and to the
1317   assistant panel: a floating "Book a collection" over a real "Book a
1318   collection" is the collision the owner photographed. */
1319.stickyCta{transition:opacity .22s ease,transform .22s ease}
1320.stickyCta.is-hidden{opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(14px)}
1321/* Narrow phones: anchor to the left gutter and leave the FAB its 76px lane
1322   so the two bottom layers can never meet. */
1323@media(max-width:420px){
1324  body.route-home .stickyCta{left:16px;right:76px;transform:none;justify-content:center}
1325  body.route-home .stickyCta:hover{transform:translateY(-2px)}
1326  body.route-home .stickyCta.is-hidden{transform:translateY(14px)}
1327}
1328/* Lift the assistant clear of the app tab bar; --tabs-h is set from the
1329   bar's measured height when it goes live. */
1330body.has-tabs #aiFab{bottom:calc(var(--tabs-h,64px) + 12px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px))}
1331body.has-tabs #aiPanel{bottom:calc(var(--tabs-h,64px) + 74px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px))}
1332@media (max-width:720px){
1333  /* only show sticky CTA on the home route */
1334  body.route-home .stickyCta{display:inline-flex}
1335}

1340/* ═════ APP v5 ═════ */
1341.ap-top5{background-color:var(--navy);background-image:linear-gradient(160deg,var(--navy) 0%,#0e2054 100%);padding:1.3rem 0 1.35rem;position:relative;overflow:hidden}

1346.ap-hero-h{font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:900;font-size:var(--fs-3);color:#fff;line-height:1.15;margin:0 0 .3rem;letter-spacing:var(--track-h1)}
1347.ap-hero-p{font-size:var(--fs-micro);color:rgba(255,255,255,.78);margin:0;line-height:1.4}
1348.ap-sw{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.35rem;background-color:#0e2054;border:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.28);color:#fff;border-radius:999px;padding:.42rem .85rem;font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:700;font-size:var(--fs-micro);max-width:52%;flex-shrink:0}
1349.ap-sw-c{width:12px;height:12px;color:#fff;flex-shrink:0}
1350.ap-sw span{overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
1351
1352.ap-hs-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:0;margin-top:1.15rem;background-color:#0e2054;background-image:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,.03),rgba(255,255,255,.06),rgba(255,255,255,.03));border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;position:relative}
1353.ap-hs{padding:.7rem .5rem;text-align:center;position:relative}
1354.ap-hs+.ap-hs::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:20%;bottom:20%;width:1px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.15)}
1355.ap-hs-v{display:block;font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:900;font-size:var(--fs-4);color:#fff;line-height:1.05;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
1356.ap-hs-l{display:block;font-size:10px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.7);margin-top:.15rem;letter-spacing:.02em;line-height:1.2}

1358/* Timeline card */
1359.ap-tl{background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r2);padding:0;margin-bottom:1rem;overflow:hidden}
1360.ap-tl-hd{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;padding:1rem 1.15rem .8rem;gap:1rem}
1361.ap-tl-hd-l{flex:1;min-width:0}
1362.ap-tl-eyb{font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:800;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.12em;color:var(--red);text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:.25rem}
1363.ap-tl-when{font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:800;font-size:var(--fs-body);color:var(--navy);line-height:1.2}
1364.ap-tl-svc{font-size:11px;color:var(--mute);margin-top:.15rem;display:block}
1365.ap-tl-cd{text-align:right;background:var(--red-w);border:1px solid rgba(216,67,48,.25);color:var(--red-d);font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:800;font-size:var(--fs-micro);padding:.4rem .7rem;border-radius:8px;letter-spacing:.02em;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;white-space:nowrap;flex-shrink:0}
1366
1367.ap-tl-op{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.75rem;padding:.75rem 1.15rem;background:var(--paper);border-top:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
1368.ap-tl-av{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--navy);color:#fff;font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:900;font-size:var(--fs-micro);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;letter-spacing:.02em;flex-shrink:0}
1369.ap-tl-op-t{flex:1;min-width:0}
1370.ap-tl-op-t strong{display:block;font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:700;font-size:var(--fs-micro);color:var(--navy)}
1371.ap-tl-op-t small{display:block;font-size:11px;color:var(--mute);margin-top:.1rem;line-height:1.35}
1372
1373.ap-tl-steps{list-style:none;padding:1rem 1.15rem .6rem;margin:0;position:relative}
1374.ap-tl-steps::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:calc(1.15rem + 11px);top:1.5rem;bottom:1.6rem;width:2px;background:var(--line)}
1375.ap-tl-steps li{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:.75rem;padding:.35rem 0;position:relative}
1376.ap-tl-steps .d{flex-shrink:0;width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--white);border:2px solid var(--line);color:var(--mute);font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:700;font-size:11px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;position:relative;z-index:1;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;transition:all var(--tr)}
1377.ap-tl-steps li.done .d{background:var(--navy);border-color:var(--navy);color:#fff}
1378.ap-tl-steps li.on .d{background:var(--red);border-color:var(--red);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(216,67,48,.15);animation:apTlPulse 2s ease-out infinite}
1379@keyframes apTlPulse{0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(216,67,48,.3)}70%{box-shadow:0 0 0 10px rgba(216,67,48,0)}100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(216,67,48,0)}}
1380.ap-tl-steps li>div{flex:1;padding-top:.15rem;min-width:0}
1381.ap-tl-steps li>div>b{display:block;font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:700;font-size:var(--fs-micro);color:var(--navy)}
1382.ap-tl-steps li.done>div>b{color:var(--ink)}
1383.ap-tl-steps li:not(.done):not(.on)>div>b{color:var(--mute);font-weight:600}
1384.ap-tl-steps li>div>em{display:block;font-style:normal;font-size:11px;color:var(--mute);margin-top:.05rem;line-height:1.35}
1385@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ap-tl-steps li.on .d{animation:none}}
1386
1387.ap-tl-ft{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.55rem;padding:.75rem 1.15rem 1rem;border-top:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--paper)}
1388.ap-tl-est{font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:800;color:var(--navy);font-size:var(--fs-body);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;margin-right:auto}
1389.ap-tl-est small{display:block;font-family:var(--fb);font-weight:400;font-size:10px;color:var(--mute);letter-spacing:.04em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-top:-.05rem}
1390.ap-tl-btn{background:transparent;border:1.5px solid var(--line);color:var(--navy);font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:700;font-size:11px;padding:.5rem .85rem;border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer;transition:all var(--tr);white-space:nowrap}
1391.ap-tl-btn:hover{border-color:var(--navy);background:var(--navy-w)}
1392.ap-tl-btn-x{color:var(--red-d);border-color:rgba(216,67,48,.35)}
1393.ap-tl-btn-x:hover{background:var(--red-w);border-color:var(--red)}
