1395/* Quick actions grid */
1396.ap-qa{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:.65rem;margin-bottom:.5rem}
1397.ap-qa-b{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.15rem;padding:1rem 1rem 1.05rem;background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r2);color:var(--ink);text-align:left;cursor:pointer;transition:transform .18s var(--ease),box-shadow var(--tr),border-color var(--tr);font-family:inherit;font-size:inherit;position:relative;min-height:104px}
1398.ap-qa-b:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:var(--e-hov);border-color:rgba(12,38,95,.2)}
1399.ap-qa-i{width:22px;height:22px;color:var(--navy);margin-bottom:.4rem}
1400.ap-qa-b strong{font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:700;font-size:var(--fs-micro);color:var(--navy);letter-spacing:var(--track-h3)}
1401.ap-qa-b span{font-size:11px;color:var(--mute);line-height:1.35;margin-top:.1rem}
1402.ap-qa-red{background-color:var(--red);background-image:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--red) 0%,var(--red-d) 100%);border-color:var(--red-d);color:#fff}
1403.ap-qa-red .ap-qa-i,.ap-qa-red strong,.ap-qa-red span{color:#fff}
1404.ap-qa-red:hover{box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(216,67,48,.35);border-color:var(--red)}
1405
1406/* Recent activity */
1407.ap-recent{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.55rem;margin-bottom:1.2rem}
1408.ap-ract{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.85rem;padding:.85rem 1rem;background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r2);color:var(--ink);transition:border-color var(--tr),transform .18s var(--ease)}
1409.ap-ract:hover{border-color:rgba(12,38,95,.2);transform:translateY(-1px)}
1410.ap-ract-d{flex-shrink:0;width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:10px;background:var(--paper);display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:var(--navy);font-family:var(--fd);line-height:1}
1411.ap-ract-d s{font-size:9px;text-decoration:none;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.02em;color:var(--mute);text-transform:uppercase}
1412.ap-ract-d b{font-size:var(--fs-body);font-weight:900;color:var(--navy);margin:1px 0}
1413.ap-ract-m{flex:1;min-width:0}
1414.ap-ract-m strong{display:block;font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:700;font-size:var(--fs-micro);color:var(--ink);line-height:1.25}
1415.ap-ract-m small{display:block;font-size:11px;color:var(--mute);margin-top:.1rem;line-height:1.35}
1416.ap-ract-r{text-align:right;flex-shrink:0}
1417.ap-ract-r b{display:block;font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:800;color:var(--navy);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;font-size:var(--fs-micro)}
1418.ap-ract-r .pill{font-size:9px;padding:.15rem .45rem;margin-top:.2rem}
1419.ap-recent-empty{background:var(--white);border:1px dashed var(--line);border-radius:var(--r2);padding:1rem 1.1rem;font-size:var(--fs-micro);color:var(--mute);text-align:center}
1420
1421/* Tip card */
1422.ap-tip{background-color:var(--navy-w);border:1px solid var(--navy-l);border-radius:var(--r2);padding:1rem 1.15rem;margin-bottom:1rem;position:relative}
1423.ap-tip-eb{font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:800;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.12em;color:var(--navy);text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:.35rem}
1424.ap-tip p{font-size:var(--fs-micro);color:var(--ink);line-height:1.5;margin:0 0 .5rem}
1425.ap-tip-a{font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:700;font-size:var(--fs-micro);color:var(--navy);display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.3rem}
1426.ap-tip-a:hover{color:var(--red)}
1427
1428/* Referral sheet */
1429.ap-sheet{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(12,38,95,.45);display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:center;z-index:200}
1430.ap-sheet[hidden]{display:none}
1431.ap-sheet-in{width:100%;max-width:520px;background:#fff;border-radius:var(--r2) var(--r2) 0 0;padding:1.3rem 1.35rem calc(1.3rem + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));box-shadow:var(--e-sheet);animation:apSheetIn .3s var(--ease) both}
1432@keyframes apSheetIn{from{transform:translateY(20px);opacity:0}to{transform:none;opacity:1}}
1433.ap-sheet-hd{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:.8rem}
1434.ap-sheet-hd strong{font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:800;color:var(--navy);font-size:var(--fs-4);letter-spacing:var(--track-h2)}
1435.ap-sheet-x{background:none;border:none;font-size:26px;line-height:1;color:var(--mute);cursor:pointer;padding:.2rem .5rem}
1436.ap-sheet-p{font-size:var(--fs-micro);color:var(--body);line-height:1.5;margin:0 0 1rem}
1437.ap-sheet-code label{display:block;font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:700;font-size:var(--fs-micro);color:var(--navy);margin-bottom:.4rem}
1438.ap-sheet-code-row{display:flex;gap:.4rem}
1439.ap-sheet-code-row input{flex:1;padding:.7rem .85rem;border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;font-family:var(--fb);font-size:var(--fs-micro);color:var(--ink);background:var(--paper)}
1440.ap-sheet-msg{display:block;font-size:11px;color:#0d7a3f;margin-top:.5rem;min-height:14px;font-weight:600}
1441
1442@media (min-width:640px){
1443  .ap-qa{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}
1444  .ap-hs-v{font-size:var(--fs-3)}
1445}
1446@media (max-width:400px){
1447  .ap-hs-v{font-size:var(--fs-5)}
1448  .ap-hero-h{font-size:var(--fs-4)}
1449}
1450
1451
1452/* ── journey (bespoke) ── */
1453
1454/* ═════ JOURNEY (bespoke) ═════ */
1455.jn-band{background-color:var(--paper);background-image:radial-gradient(circle at 12% 10%,rgba(232,96,74,.06),transparent 40%),radial-gradient(circle at 92% 90%,rgba(43,75,170,.06),transparent 45%);padding:3.4rem 0 3rem;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
1456.jn-hd{text-align:left;max-width:820px;margin:0 auto 2.4rem}
1457.jn-eb{display:inline-block;font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:800;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.14em;color:var(--red);text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:.6rem}
1458.jn-h{font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:900;font-size:var(--fs-h2);line-height:1.1;color:var(--navy);letter-spacing:var(--track-h1);margin:0 0 .8rem}
1459.jn-sub{font-size:var(--fs-body);line-height:1.55;color:var(--body);margin:0;max-width:64ch}
1460
1461.jn-scene{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:1rem;align-items:start}
1462.jn-path{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:66px;width:100%;height:220px;pointer-events:none;z-index:0;opacity:0;transition:opacity 1s var(--ease)}
1463.reveal.in .jn-path{opacity:.35}
1464.jn-path-l{stroke-dashoffset:1200;animation:jnDraw 3s var(--ease) .3s forwards}
1465.reveal:not(.in) .jn-path-l{animation:none;stroke-dashoffset:0}
1466@keyframes jnDraw{to{stroke-dashoffset:0}}
1467
1468.jn-v{position:relative;z-index:1;background:#fff;border:1px solid rgba(12,38,95,.08);border-radius:var(--r-lg);padding:1rem 1rem 1.15rem;text-align:center;transition:transform .3s var(--ease),box-shadow .3s var(--ease),border-color var(--tr);opacity:0;transform:translateY(20px)}
1469.reveal.in .jn-v{opacity:1;transform:none;transition:opacity .55s var(--ease),transform .55s var(--ease),box-shadow .3s var(--ease),border-color var(--tr)}
1470.reveal.in .jn-v[data-jn="1"]{transition-delay:.05s}
1471.reveal.in .jn-v[data-jn="2"]{transition-delay:.18s}
1472.reveal.in .jn-v[data-jn="3"]{transition-delay:.31s}
1473.reveal.in .jn-v[data-jn="4"]{transition-delay:.44s}
1474.reveal.in .jn-v[data-jn="5"]{transition-delay:.57s}
1475.jn-v:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:var(--e-hov);border-color:rgba(12,38,95,.2)}
1476.jn-art{width:100%;aspect-ratio:1/1;max-width:150px;margin:0 auto .7rem}
1477.jn-art svg{width:100%;height:100%;display:block}
1478/* subtle drum tumble */
1479.jn-drum{animation:jnTumble 8s linear infinite;transform-origin:80px 82px;transform-box:fill-box}
1480@keyframes jnTumble{from{transform:rotate(0)}to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
1481@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.jn-drum{animation:none}.jn-path-l{animation:none;stroke-dashoffset:0}}
1482
1483.jn-n{display:inline-block;font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:900;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--red);background:var(--red-w);padding:.15rem .5rem;border-radius:6px;margin-bottom:.5rem}
1484.jn-txt h3{font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:800;font-size:var(--fs-body);color:var(--navy);letter-spacing:var(--track-h2);line-height:1.2;margin:0 0 .4rem}
1485.jn-txt p{font-size:var(--fs-micro);line-height:1.5;color:var(--body);margin:0 0 .5rem}
1486.jn-txt small{display:block;font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:700;font-size:11px;color:var(--mute);letter-spacing:.03em;text-transform:uppercase}
1487
1488.jn-ft{margin-top:2rem;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:1rem;padding:1.1rem 1.3rem;background:#fff;border:1px solid rgba(12,38,95,.1);border-radius:var(--r-lg);flex-wrap:wrap}
1489.jn-ft-l{font-size:var(--fs-micro);color:var(--body);line-height:1.5}
1490.jn-ft-l strong{font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:800;color:var(--navy)}
1491.jn-ft-a{font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:700;font-size:var(--fs-micro);color:var(--navy);display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.35rem;white-space:nowrap;padding-bottom:2px;border-bottom:1.5px solid var(--navy)}
1492.jn-ft-a:hover{color:var(--red);border-color:var(--red)}
1493
1494@media (max-width:1100px){
1495  .jn-scene{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}
1496  .jn-path{display:none}
1497}
1498@media (max-width:640px){
1499  .jn-scene{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
1500  .jn-band{padding:2.4rem 0}
1501  .jn-h{font-size:clamp(1.6rem,6vw,2.1rem)}
1502}
1503@media (max-width:420px){
1504  .jn-scene{grid-template-columns:1fr}
1505  .jn-v{display:grid;grid-template-columns:100px 1fr;gap:.9rem;text-align:left;padding:.85rem .95rem}
1506  .jn-art{margin:0}
1507  .jn-n{margin-bottom:.25rem}
1508}
1509
1510
1511/* ── operator portal preview ── */
1512
1513/* ═════ OPERATOR PORTAL PREVIEW ═════ */
1514.op5-band{background-color:var(--navy);background-image:linear-gradient(160deg,var(--navy) 0%,#0a1e4a 100%);padding:3rem 0;color:#fff;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
1515.op5-band::before{content:"";position:absolute;top:-40%;left:-10%;width:60%;height:80%;background:radial-gradient(ellipse,rgba(232,96,74,.18),transparent 60%);pointer-events:none}
1516.op5-hd{position:relative;max-width:820px;margin:0 auto 2rem;text-align:center}
1517.op5-eb{display:inline-block;font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:800;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.14em;color:#fff;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:.6rem}
1518.op5-h{font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:900;font-size:var(--fs-h2);line-height:1.1;color:#fff;letter-spacing:var(--track-h1);margin:0 0 .8rem}
1519.op5-sub{font-size:var(--fs-body);line-height:1.55;color:rgba(255,255,255,.85);margin:0 auto;max-width:60ch}
1520
1521/* frame */
1522.op5-frame{position:relative;background-color:#fff;border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 30px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.35),0 8px 22px rgba(0,0,0,.2);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15)}
1523.op5-frame-hd{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.6rem;padding:.6rem 1rem;background-color:#0e2054;color:#fff;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1)}
1524.op5-frame-l{display:flex;gap:.35rem}
1525.op5-dot{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;background:#333}
1526.op5-dot-r{background:#ff5f57}.op5-dot-y{background:#febc2e}.op5-dot-g{background:#28c840}
1527.op5-frame-t{flex:1;text-align:center;font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:600;font-size:11px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.85);letter-spacing:.02em}
1528.op5-frame-r{display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;min-width:60px}
1529.op5-live{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.35rem;font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:800;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.1em;color:#4ade80}
1530.op5-live-d{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:#4ade80;box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(74,222,128,.5);animation:op5Pulse 1.6s infinite}
1531@keyframes op5Pulse{0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(74,222,128,.6)}70%{box-shadow:0 0 0 6px rgba(74,222,128,0)}100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(74,222,128,0)}}
1532
1533/* tabs */
1534.op5-tabs{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);background-color:var(--paper);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(12,38,95,.1)}
1535.op5-tabs button{background:transparent;border:none;padding:.85rem .4rem;font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:700;font-size:var(--fs-micro);color:var(--mute);cursor:pointer;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:.4rem;border-bottom:3px solid transparent;transition:color var(--tr),border-color var(--tr),background-color var(--tr)}
1536.op5-tabs button svg{width:16px;height:16px}
1537.op5-tabs button:hover{color:var(--navy);background-color:rgba(12,38,95,.04)}
1538.op5-tabs button.on{color:var(--navy);border-bottom-color:var(--red)}
1539@media (max-width:640px){.op5-tabs button{flex-direction:column;gap:.2rem;padding:.65rem .3rem;font-size:10px}}
1540
1541/* body */
1542.op5-body{padding:0;background-color:#fff;color:var(--ink)}
1543.op5-pane{display:none;padding:1.35rem 1.35rem 1.5rem;animation:op5In .35s var(--ease) both}
1544.op5-pane.on{display:block}
1545@keyframes op5In{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(6px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
1546
1547/* Round today */
1548.op5-round{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:1.3rem}
1549.op5-round-map{background-color:var(--paper);border-radius:12px;border:1px solid rgba(12,38,95,.08);overflow:hidden}
1550.op5-round-map svg{width:100%;height:auto;display:block}
1551.op5-round-cap{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;padding:.55rem .85rem;border-top:1px solid rgba(12,38,95,.08);font-family:var(--fd);font-size:11px;color:var(--mute);letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase}
1552.op5-round-cap-r{color:var(--navy);font-weight:700}
1553.op5-stops{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.5rem}
1554.op5-stop{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.75rem;padding:.7rem .85rem;background-color:#fff;border:1px solid rgba(12,38,95,.1);border-radius:10px;position:relative}
1555.op5-stop.done{opacity:.55}
1556.op5-stop.on{border-color:var(--red);background-color:#fef7f5}
1557.op5-stop-n{width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:50%;background-color:var(--paper);color:var(--navy);font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:800;font-size:11px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-shrink:0}
1558.op5-stop.on .op5-stop-n{background-color:var(--red);color:#fff}
1559.op5-stop.done .op5-stop-n{background-color:var(--navy);color:#fff}
1560.op5-stop-b{flex:1;min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.1rem}
1561.op5-stop-b strong{font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:700;font-size:var(--fs-micro);color:var(--navy);line-height:1.2}
1562.op5-stop-b span{font-size:11px;color:var(--body);line-height:1.35}
1563.op5-stop-tag{font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:700;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.05em;color:var(--mute);padding:.28rem .5rem;border-radius:6px;background-color:var(--paper);white-space:nowrap;flex-shrink:0}
1564.op5-stop-tag.on{background-color:var(--red);color:#fff}
1565.op5-stop-tag.done{background-color:rgba(13,122,63,.12);color:#0d7a3f}
1566
1567/* At the door */
1568.op5-door{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:1.3rem}
1569.op5-door-l,.op5-door-r{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:1rem}
1570.op5-door-cust{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.8rem;padding:.85rem 1rem;background-color:var(--paper);border:1px solid rgba(12,38,95,.08);border-radius:10px}
1571.op5-av{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:50%;background-color:var(--navy);color:#fff;font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:800;font-size:12px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-shrink:0}
1572.op5-door-cust>div:not(.op5-av){flex:1;min-width:0}
1573.op5-door-cust strong{display:block;font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:700;font-size:var(--fs-micro);color:var(--navy)}
1574.op5-door-cust span{display:block;font-size:11px;color:var(--body);margin-top:.15rem;line-height:1.35}
1575.op5-scale{background-color:#0e2054;background-image:linear-gradient(160deg,#0e2054 0%,#0C265F 100%);color:#fff;border-radius:12px;padding:1.1rem 1.15rem;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
1576.op5-scale::before{content:"";position:absolute;top:-30%;right:-15%;width:60%;height:80%;background:radial-gradient(ellipse,rgba(232,96,74,.28),transparent 60%);pointer-events:none}
1577.op5-scale-hd{font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:700;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.1em;color:rgba(255,255,255,.65);text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:.4rem;position:relative}
1578.op5-scale-v{font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:900;font-size:44px;color:#fff;line-height:1;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;position:relative;letter-spacing:-.02em}
1579.op5-scale-v span{font-size:16px;font-weight:600;color:rgba(255,255,255,.65);margin-left:.35rem}
1580.op5-scale-bar{height:6px;background-color:rgba(255,255,255,.15);border-radius:3px;margin:.7rem 0 .35rem;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
1581.op5-scale-bar-f{height:100%;background-color:#E8604A;background-image:linear-gradient(90deg,#D84330,#E8604A);border-radius:3px}
1582.op5-scale-hint{font-size:11px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.7);position:relative}
1583.op5-door-lines{background-color:var(--paper);border-radius:12px;padding:.9rem 1.05rem;border:1px solid rgba(12,38,95,.08)}
1584.op5-dl{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto auto;gap:.6rem;font-size:var(--fs-micro);color:var(--body);padding:.32rem 0;align-items:baseline}
1585.op5-dl em{font-style:normal;color:var(--mute);font-size:11px}
1586.op5-dl b{font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:700;color:var(--navy);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
1587.op5-dl-min{color:var(--red-d);font-size:11px}
1588.op5-dl-min b{color:var(--red-d)}
1589.op5-dl-tot{border-top:1px solid rgba(12,38,95,.1);padding-top:.55rem;margin-top:.35rem}
1590.op5-dl-tot span,.op5-dl-tot b{font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:800;font-size:var(--fs-body);color:var(--navy)}
1591.op5-door-notes{background-color:var(--red-w);border:1px dashed rgba(216,67,48,.35);border-radius:10px;padding:.85rem 1rem}
1592.op5-door-notes label{display:block;font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:800;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--red-d);text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:.3rem}
1593.op5-door-notes p{font-size:var(--fs-micro);color:var(--ink);margin:0;line-height:1.45;font-style:italic}
1594.op5-door-prefs{display:grid;gap:.5rem}
1595.op5-pref{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:.6rem;padding:.55rem .85rem;background-color:#fff;border:1px solid rgba(12,38,95,.1);border-radius:8px;font-size:var(--fs-micro)}
1596.op5-pref span{color:var(--mute);font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:600}
1597.op5-pref strong{color:var(--navy);font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:700}
1598.op5-door-cta{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.4fr 1fr;gap:.5rem;margin-top:auto}
1599.op5-btn{border:none;border-radius:10px;font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:800;font-size:var(--fs-micro);padding:.85rem 1rem;cursor:pointer;transition:transform .15s var(--ease),box-shadow var(--tr),background-color var(--tr),border-color var(--tr);letter-spacing:.02em}
1600.op5-btn-p{background-color:var(--red);color:#fff}
1601.op5-btn-p:hover{background-color:var(--red-d);box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(216,67,48,.35);transform:translateY(-1px)}
1602.op5-btn-g{background-color:var(--paper);color:var(--navy);border:1px solid rgba(12,38,95,.15)}
1603.op5-btn-g:hover{border-color:var(--navy);background-color:#fff}
1604.op5-btn-out{background-color:transparent;color:var(--navy);border:1.5px solid rgba(12,38,95,.2);padding:.55rem .8rem;font-size:11px;border-radius:8px}
1605.op5-btn-out:hover{border-color:var(--navy);background-color:var(--paper)}
1606.op5-door-msg{display:block;font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:700;font-size:var(--fs-micro);color:#0d7a3f;margin-top:.3rem;min-height:16px}
1607
1608/* Wash room */
1609.op5-mach{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:.9rem}
1610.op5-m{background-color:#fff;border:1px solid rgba(12,38,95,.1);border-radius:12px;padding:.9rem 1rem;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.55rem}
1611.op5-m-hd{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center}
1612.op5-m-hd strong{font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:800;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--mute)}
1613.op5-tag{font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:800;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.1em;padding:.2rem .5rem;border-radius:6px}
1614.op5-tag-run{background-color:rgba(43,75,170,.12);color:var(--navy-l)}
1615.op5-tag-free{background-color:var(--paper);color:var(--mute)}
1616.op5-tag-done{background-color:rgba(13,122,63,.15);color:#0d7a3f}
1617.op5-m-drum{width:56px;height:56px;margin:.2rem auto}
1618.op5-m-drum svg{width:100%;height:100%;display:block}
1619.op5-m-turn{animation:op5Spin 3s linear infinite;transform-origin:30px 30px;transform-box:fill-box}
1620.op5-m-slow{animation-duration:5s}
1621@keyframes op5Spin{from{transform:rotate(0)}to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
1622@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.op5-m-turn{animation:none}}
1623.op5-m-b{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end;gap:.7rem}
1624.op5-m-b>div:first-child{flex:1;min-width:0}
1625.op5-m-b b{display:block;font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:700;font-size:var(--fs-micro);color:var(--navy);line-height:1.2}
1626.op5-m-b span{display:block;font-size:11px;color:var(--body);margin-top:.15rem;line-height:1.35}
1627.op5-m-t{text-align:right}
1628.op5-m-t-v{display:block;font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:900;color:var(--navy);font-size:var(--fs-4);line-height:1;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
1629.op5-m-t-l{display:block;font-size:9px;color:var(--mute);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.1em;margin-top:.15rem}
1630.op5-m-ready{background-color:rgba(74,222,128,.08)}
1631.op5-m-free{background-color:var(--paper)}
1632
1633/* Money */
1634.op5-money{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:1rem}
1635.op5-money-top{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1.4fr;gap:.7rem}
1636.op5-money-tile{background-color:#fff;border:1px solid rgba(12,38,95,.1);border-radius:12px;padding:1rem 1.1rem;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.2rem}
1637.op5-money-tile-nv{background-color:var(--navy);color:#fff;border-color:var(--navy)}
1638.op5-money-tile-r{background-color:var(--red);background-image:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--red) 0%,var(--red-d) 100%);color:#fff;border-color:var(--red-d)}
1639.op5-money-l{font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:800;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;opacity:.75}
1640.op5-money-v{font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:900;font-size:var(--fs-2);line-height:1.05;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;margin:.15rem 0 .25rem;letter-spacing:-.01em}
1641.op5-money-s{font-size:11px;line-height:1.4;opacity:.85}
1642.op5-money-chart{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(7,1fr);align-items:end;gap:.4rem;padding:1rem 1.15rem;background-color:var(--paper);border:1px solid rgba(12,38,95,.08);border-radius:12px;min-height:170px}
1643.op5-bar{display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:flex-end;align-items:center;gap:.35rem;height:100%;text-align:center}
1644.op5-bar::before{content:"";display:block;height:var(--h,10%);width:100%;background-color:var(--navy-l);background-image:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--navy-l) 0%,var(--navy) 100%);border-radius:6px 6px 0 0;transition:height .5s var(--ease)}
1645.op5-bar-on::before{background-image:linear-gradient(180deg,#E8604A 0%,var(--red-d) 100%)}
1646.op5-bar-nx::before{background-color:rgba(12,38,95,.1);background-image:none;height:8px}
1647.op5-bar span{font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:700;font-size:10px;color:var(--mute);letter-spacing:.06em}
1648.op5-bar em{font-style:normal;font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:800;font-size:11px;color:var(--navy);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
1649.op5-bar-nx em{color:var(--mute)}
1650.op5-money-perks{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:.6rem}
1651.op5-perk{background-color:#fff;border:1px solid rgba(12,38,95,.1);border-radius:10px;padding:.8rem 1rem;text-align:center}
1652.op5-perk strong{display:block;font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:900;font-size:var(--fs-3);color:var(--navy);letter-spacing:-.01em;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;line-height:1}
1653.op5-perk span{display:block;font-size:11px;color:var(--body);margin-top:.35rem;line-height:1.35}
1654.op5-star{width:.9em;height:.9em;color:var(--red);margin-left:.15em;vertical-align:baseline}
1655
1656/* footer */
1657.op5-ft{margin-top:1.6rem;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:1rem;padding:1.2rem 1.4rem;background-color:rgba(255,255,255,.06);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);border-radius:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;color:#fff}
1658.op5-ft-l{flex:1;min-width:260px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.2rem}
1659.op5-ft-l strong{font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:800;color:#fff;font-size:var(--fs-body)}
1660.op5-ft-l span{font-size:var(--fs-micro);color:rgba(255,255,255,.8);line-height:1.5}
1661
1662/* responsive */
1663@media (max-width:900px){
1664  .op5-round,.op5-door{grid-template-columns:1fr}
1665  .op5-money-top{grid-template-columns:1fr}
1666}
1667@media (max-width:640px){
1668  .op5-mach{grid-template-columns:1fr}
1669  .op5-money-perks{grid-template-columns:1fr}
1670  .op5-money-chart{padding:.8rem}
1671  .op5-h{font-size:clamp(1.55rem,6vw,2.1rem)}
1672}
1673
1674
1675/* ── legends club portal ── */
1676
1677/* ═════ Legends Club member portal ═════ */
1678.kc5{background-color:var(--navy);background-image:linear-gradient(155deg,var(--navy) 0%,#0a1e4a 60%,#0e2a6a 100%);color:#fff;border-radius:16px;padding:1.4rem 1.4rem 1.2rem;margin-bottom:1.35rem;position:relative;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 20px 50px -20px rgba(12,38,95,.4)}
1679.kc5::before{content:"";position:absolute;top:-40%;right:-20%;width:70%;height:80%;background:radial-gradient(ellipse,rgba(232,96,74,.22),transparent 60%);pointer-events:none}
1680.kc5-hd{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;gap:1rem;position:relative;margin-bottom:1.1rem;padding-bottom:1.1rem;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15)}
1681.kc5-hd-l{flex:1;min-width:0}
1682.kc5-plan-badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.4rem;font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:800;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.14em;color:#fff;background-color:var(--red);padding:.25rem .55rem;border-radius:6px;text-transform:uppercase}
1683.kc5-plan-badge svg{width:12px;height:12px}
1684.kc5-plan-name{display:block;font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:900;font-size:var(--fs-3);color:#fff;line-height:1.1;margin:.55rem 0 .15rem;letter-spacing:-.01em}
1685.kc5-plan-meta{font-size:var(--fs-micro);color:rgba(255,255,255,.75);line-height:1.4}
1686.kc5-price{text-align:right;flex-shrink:0}
1687.kc5-price-v{font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:900;font-size:var(--fs-2);color:#fff;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;line-height:1;letter-spacing:-.02em}
1688.kc5-price-per{display:block;font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:600;font-size:11px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.7);letter-spacing:.05em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-top:.15rem}
1689
1690.kc5-stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:0;position:relative;margin-bottom:1.1rem}
1691.kc5-st{padding:.5rem 0;text-align:center;position:relative}
1692.kc5-st+.kc5-st::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:20%;bottom:20%;width:1px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.15)}
1693.kc5-st-v{display:block;font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:900;font-size:var(--fs-3);color:#fff;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;line-height:1.05;letter-spacing:-.01em}
1694.kc5-st-l{display:block;font-size:10px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.7);margin-top:.2rem;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase}
1695
1696.kc5-streak{position:relative;background-color:rgba(255,255,255,.06);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15);border-radius:10px;padding:.85rem 1rem;margin-bottom:1.1rem;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.9rem}
1697.kc5-streak-dots{display:flex;gap:.35rem}
1698.kc5-streak-dot{width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:50%;background-color:rgba(255,255,255,.15);position:relative}
1699.kc5-streak-dot.on{background-color:#4ade80}
1700.kc5-streak-dot.on::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:50%;box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(74,222,128,.5)}
1701.kc5-streak-t{flex:1;min-width:0}
1702.kc5-streak-t strong{display:block;font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:700;font-size:var(--fs-micro);color:#fff}
1703.kc5-streak-t small{display:block;font-size:11px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.75);margin-top:.15rem;line-height:1.35}
1704
1705.kc5-prefs{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:.55rem;position:relative;margin-bottom:1.1rem}
1706.kc5-pref{background-color:rgba(255,255,255,.05);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);border-radius:10px;padding:.7rem .85rem;text-align:left}
1707.kc5-pref-l{display:block;font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:700;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.08em;color:rgba(255,255,255,.65);text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:.3rem}
1708.kc5-pref-v{display:block;font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:700;font-size:var(--fs-micro);color:#fff;line-height:1.3}
1709
1710.kc5-actions{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:.5rem;position:relative}
1711.kc5-a{background-color:rgba(255,255,255,.08);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18);color:#fff;font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:700;font-size:var(--fs-micro);padding:.65rem .5rem;border-radius:10px;cursor:pointer;text-align:center;transition:background-color var(--tr),border-color var(--tr),transform .15s var(--ease);text-decoration:none;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:.35rem}
1712.kc5-a:hover{background-color:rgba(255,255,255,.16);border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.35);transform:translateY(-1px)}
1713.kc5-a-red{background-color:var(--red);border-color:var(--red-d);color:#fff}
1714.kc5-a-red:hover{background-color:var(--red-d)}
1715.kc5-a svg{width:14px;height:14px}
1716
1717.kc5-ref{position:relative;margin-top:1.1rem;padding-top:1.1rem;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:1rem;flex-wrap:wrap}
1718.kc5-ref-l{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.1rem;flex:1;min-width:200px}
1719.kc5-ref-l strong{font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:800;font-size:var(--fs-micro);color:#fff}
1720.kc5-ref-l span{font-size:11px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.75);line-height:1.35}
1721.kc5-ref-pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.5rem;background-color:rgba(74,222,128,.15);border:1px solid rgba(74,222,128,.35);color:#4ade80;font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:800;font-size:var(--fs-micro);padding:.4rem .7rem;border-radius:8px}
1722.kc5-ref-pill b{color:#fff}
1723
1724/* Non-member (upsell) variant */
1725.kc5-up{background-color:var(--paper);background-image:none;color:var(--ink);border:1.5px solid rgba(12,38,95,.12);box-shadow:0 8px 24px -12px rgba(12,38,95,.15)}
1726.kc5-up::before{background:radial-gradient(ellipse,rgba(216,67,48,.1),transparent 65%);opacity:.6}
1727.kc5-up .kc5-hd{border-bottom-color:rgba(12,38,95,.1)}
1728.kc5-up .kc5-plan-badge{background-color:var(--red);color:#fff}
1729.kc5-up .kc5-plan-name,.kc5-up .kc5-price-v{color:var(--navy)}
1730.kc5-up .kc5-plan-meta,.kc5-up .kc5-price-per,.kc5-up .kc5-st-l,.kc5-up .kc5-pref-l,.kc5-up .kc5-ref-l span,.kc5-up .kc5-streak-t small{color:var(--mute)}
1731.kc5-up .kc5-st-v,.kc5-up .kc5-pref-v,.kc5-up .kc5-streak-t strong,.kc5-up .kc5-ref-l strong{color:var(--navy)}
1732.kc5-up .kc5-st+.kc5-st::before,.kc5-up .kc5-streak,.kc5-up .kc5-pref,.kc5-up .kc5-a,.kc5-up .kc5-ref{background-color:transparent}
1733.kc5-up .kc5-streak,.kc5-up .kc5-pref{background-color:#fff;border-color:rgba(12,38,95,.1)}
1734.kc5-up .kc5-a{background-color:#fff;border-color:rgba(12,38,95,.15);color:var(--navy)}
1735.kc5-up .kc5-a:hover{border-color:var(--navy);background-color:var(--paper)}
1736.kc5-up .kc5-a-red{background-color:var(--red);border-color:var(--red-d);color:#fff}
1737.kc5-up .kc5-a-red:hover{background-color:var(--red-d)}
1738.kc5-up .kc5-ref{border-top-color:rgba(12,38,95,.1)}
1739.kc5-up .kc5-streak-dot{background-color:rgba(12,38,95,.15)}
1740.kc5-up .kc5-streak-dot.on{background-color:var(--red)}
1741
1742@media (max-width:640px){
1743  .kc5-stats,.kc5-prefs{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
1744  .kc5-st:nth-child(3){grid-column:span 2}
1745  .kc5-actions{grid-template-columns:1fr}
1746  .kc5-price-v{font-size:var(--fs-3)}
1747  .kc5-plan-name{font-size:var(--fs-4)}
1748}
1749
1750</style>
1751</head>

2533    <h1>Investor enquiries</h1>
2534    <p>Laundrylegends is an owner-operated laundry pickup and delivery business across Brisbane, Logan and South East Queensland, building toward a multi-operator network.</p>
2535  </div></div>
2536  <div class="sec"><div class="wrap">
2537    <div class="g2c" style="gap:3rem;align-items:start">
2538      <div>

Any discussion happens under a signed non-disclosure agreement and through our adviser.</div>
2548      </div>

2550        <h3>Request the information pack</h3>
2551        <p class="fsub">Tell us who you are and we will come back to you. The pack is not sent automatically.</p>

2567        <button class="btn btn-red btn-full btn-lg" id="ivGo">Request the pack</button>

2660    <h1>Guest laundry, as a revenue line</h1>
2661    <p>Your guests already ask about laundry. Right now that is a concierge problem with no margin. We turn it into a commission your property earns for putting cards in rooms.</p>

2670          <li>Your guest scans and orders on a page co-branded with your property.</li>

2672          <li>You are paid commission monthly, with an itemised statement.</li>

2858<section class="page" id="p-operators">
2859  <div class="phead"><div class="wrap">
2860    <div class="crumb"><a href="#/">Home</a> / Become an Operator</div>
2861    <h1>Become a Laundrylegends operator</h1>
2862    <p>Run laundry collections in your own suburb, as your own business, with our customers, brand and systems behind you.</p>
2863  </div></div>
2864  <div class="sec"><div class="wrap">
2865    <div class="g2c" style="gap:3rem;align-items:start">
2866      <div>
2867        <h2 class="h2" style="font-size:var(--fs-5)">What the arrangement is</h2>
2868        <p class="lede" style="margin-bottom:1.2rem">You operate as an independent business with your own ABN. You use your own equipment and premises, choose your own hours, and decide how much work you take on. We route customers to you, handle the booking platform, brand and customer support, and pay you on an agreed revenue share.</p>
2869        <ul class="chk2" style="margin-bottom:1.8rem">
2870          <li>Your own ABN, your own business, your own hours</li>
2871          <li>Your own washing and drying equipment</li>
2872          <li>Jobs routed to you by suburb — no advertising or cold calling</li>
2873          <li>Booking, scheduling, invoicing and payment handled by our platform</li>
2874          <li>Onboarding, training and ongoing support provided</li>
2875          <li>No franchise purchase price and no territory buy-in</li>
2876        </ul>
2877
2878        <h2 class="h2" style="font-size:var(--fs-5)">What you need</h2>
2879        <ul class="chk2" style="margin-bottom:1.8rem">
2880          <li>An active ABN, or willingness to register one</li>
2881          <li>Reliable washing machine and dryer, and space to work</li>
2882          <li>A vehicle for collections and returns</li>
2883          <li>Willingness to complete identity and background screening</li>
2884          <li>Appropriate insurance — we will tell you exactly which policies before you start</li>
2885          <li>A smartphone for the operator app</li>
2886        </ul>
2887
2888        <div class="pnote"><strong>Before you apply, read this.</strong> This is an independent contracting arrangement, not employment. That has real consequences for your tax, superannuation and entitlements, and whether it is the correct classification depends on how the work is actually performed. We will give you the full written agreement to review before you commit, and we recommend you take independent advice on it. We will not pretend this is a decision to make casually.</div>
2889
2890        <h2 class="h2" style="font-size:var(--fs-5);margin-top:2rem">What we cannot tell you yet</h2>
2891        <div class="empty" style="text-align:left">
2892          <h3>Earnings figures</h3>
2893          <p style="margin:0 0 .8rem">We are not publishing income claims. We have not been operating long enough to have real operator earnings data, and quoting a range we cannot evidence would be misleading. Once we have genuine figures from active operators, they will be published here with the basis they were calculated on.</p>
2894          <p style="margin:0">What we can tell you is the revenue share percentage, the expected job volume in your suburb, and the current booking rate. We will give you all three in writing during the application conversation.</p>
2895        </div>
2896      </div>
2897
2898      <div class="fpanel">
2899        <h3>Register your interest</h3>
2900        <p class="fsub">We will be in touch to talk through the arrangement, answer your questions, and send you the agreement to review.</p>
2901        <div class="g2">
2902          <div class="fld"><label class="lbl" for="oFirst">First name</label><input class="inp" id="oFirst"></div>
2903          <div class="fld"><label class="lbl" for="oLast">Last name</label><input class="inp" id="oLast"></div>
2904        </div>
2905        <div class="fld"><label class="lbl" for="oEmail">Email</label><input class="inp" id="oEmail" type="email"></div>
2906        <div class="fld"><label class="lbl" for="oPhone">Phone</label><input class="inp" id="oPhone" type="tel"></div>
2907        <div class="fld"><label class="lbl" for="oSuburb">Suburb you would operate from</label><input class="inp" id="oSuburb"></div>

3155<!-- ================================================================
3156     ABOUT
3157     ================================================================ -->
3158<section class="page" id="p-about">
3159  <div class="phead"><div class="wrap">
3160    <div class="crumb"><a href="#/">Home</a> / About</div>
3161    <h1>About Laundrylegends</h1>
3162    <p>An Australian-owned laundry collection and delivery business built for South East Queensland.</p>
3163  </div></div>
3164  <div class="sec"><div class="wrap"><div class="prose">
3165    <h2>What we are</h2>
3166    <p>Laundrylegends collects your laundry, washes it properly, and brings it back. That is the whole proposition. We are not a laundromat you drive to, and we are not an app that disappears when something goes wrong.</p>
3167    <p>We operate through a network of local operators — independent small businesses running collections in their own suburbs — supported by a central booking, routing and customer service platform. That means the person handling your washing lives near you, and the systems behind them are run properly.</p>
3168
3169    <h2>Why we built it this way</h2>
3170    <p>Two things are broken in this category. Traditional laundries keep hours that working people cannot use, and publish no pricing at all. App-based services solved the convenience problem but treated the people doing the work as disposable, and most of them are gone.</p>
3171    <p>We have built for the middle: published pricing, proper scheduling, and operators who are treated as business partners rather than units of throughput. A round only opens when there is someone good enough to run it.</p>
3172
3173    <h2>How we are different</h2>
3174    <ul>
3175      <li><strong>Published pricing.</strong> Every rate is on this website. You never have to ring to find out what something costs.</li>
3176      <li><strong>Price confirmed before work starts.</strong> Your operator weighs and counts, then confirms the figure. Nothing proceeds until you have it.</li>
3177      <li><strong>Your wash is your wash.</strong> Processed on its own cycle, never combined with another household's items.</li>
3178      <li><strong>We say what we cannot do.</strong> If we are not accredited for something, or not registered for something, we say so on the relevant page rather than letting you find out later.</li>
3179    </ul>
3180
3181    <h2>Coverage</h2>
3182    <p>We are currently building out across Brisbane, Logan and South East Queensland, suburb by suburb. Our <a href="#/coverage" style="text-decoration:underline;color:var(--navy)">coverage page</a> shows where we are live and where we are opening next.</p>
3183
3184    <h2>Company details</h2>
3185    <p>Trading as Laundrylegends. Company and ABN details are published in the footer of every page and on our <a href="#/contact" style="text-decoration:underline;color:var(--navy)">contact page</a>.</p>
3186  </div></div></div>
3187</section>
3188
3189<!-- ================================================================
3190     GUARANTEE
3191     ================================================================ -->
3192<section class="page" id="p-guarantee">
3193  <div class="phead"><div class="wrap">
3194    <div class="crumb"><a href="#/">Home</a> / Service Guarantee</div>
3195    <h1>Our service guarantee</h1>
3196    <p>What we promise, what we will do if we get it wrong, and the limits of both — in plain language.</p>
3197  </div></div>
3198  <div class="sec"><div class="wrap"><div class="prose">
3199    <h2>If the wash is not right</h2>
3200    <p>Tell us within <strong>48 hours</strong> of delivery and we will re-wash the affected items at no charge, collected and returned at our cost. If a re-wash will not fix it, we will refund the charge for those items.</p>
3201
3202    <h2>If we are late</h2>
3203    <p>If we miss your agreed return date and have not contacted you in advance to reschedule, the delivery fee for that order is refunded automatically. You do not need to ask.</p>
3204
3205    <h2>If something is damaged or missing</h2>
3206    <p>Report it within <strong>7 days</strong> of delivery. We will investigate using the item count and weight recorded at collection, and respond within 5 business days with an outcome.</p>
3207    <p>Where we are at fault, we will settle the claim. Settlement is based on the item's current value taking reasonable account of age and condition, not its original purchase price. This is standard practice across the industry and we would rather state it here than argue about it later.</p>
3208
3209    <h3>What is not covered</h3>
3210    <ul>
3211      <li>Items where the manufacturer's care label was absent, illegible, or where following it caused the damage</li>
3212      <li>Pre-existing damage, wear or weakness not visible at collection</li>
3213      <li>Colour bleed from items not identified as at-risk at collection</li>
3214      <li>Items left in pockets — we check, but we cannot guarantee we catch everything</li>
3215      <li>Loss or damage to items we specifically advised against processing and you asked us to proceed with anyway</li>
3216    </ul>
3217
3218    <h2>High-value items</h2>
3219    <p>Tell us before collection if any item is worth more than <strong>$250</strong>. We will either handle it under a specific arrangement or tell you we are not the right service for it. Items above this value that were not declared at collection are covered only to the standard limit.</p>
3220
3221    <h2>Insurance</h2>
3222    <p>Our operators are required to hold current public liability cover, and the specific policy type and minimum sum insured are set out in the operator agreement. We will confirm the exact cover in place on request — email us and we will send you the detail rather than a vague assurance.</p>
3223
3224    <h2>Your rights under Australian Consumer Law</h2>
3225    <p>This guarantee sits <strong>on top of</strong> your rights under the Australian Consumer Law. Nothing on this page limits or replaces those rights. Our services come with guarantees that cannot be excluded under the ACL, including that services are provided with due care and skill. If you believe we have failed to meet those guarantees, you have remedies available to you regardless of what this page says.</p>
3226
3227    <h2>How to make a claim</h2>
3228    <p>Contact us through the <a href="#/contact" style="text-decoration:underline;color:var(--navy)">contact page</a> with your order reference, the affected items, and photographs where relevant. We will acknowledge within one business day.</p>
3229  </div></div></div>

3306<!-- ================================================================
3307     PRIVACY
3308     ================================================================ -->
3309<section class="page" id="p-privacy">
3310  <div class="phead"><div class="wrap">
3311    <div class="crumb"><a href="#/">Home</a> / Privacy Policy</div>
3312    <h1>Privacy policy</h1>
3313    <p>How we collect, use, store and disclose your personal information.</p>
3314  </div></div>
3315  <div class="sec"><div class="wrap"><div class="prose">
3316    <div class="updated">Draft for legal review — not yet in force. Date of effect to be inserted on approval.</div>
3317    <p>This policy explains how Laundrylegends handles personal information in accordance with the <strong>Privacy Act 1988 (Cth)</strong> and the Australian Privacy Principles.</p>
3318
3319    <h2>1. What we collect</h2>
3320    <ul>
3321      <li><strong>Identity and contact details</strong> — name, email, phone number, residential or business address.</li>
3322      <li><strong>Service information</strong> — collection addresses, access instructions, laundry preferences, order history, item counts and weights.</li>
3323      <li><strong>Payment information</strong> — processed by our third-party payment provider. We do not store full card numbers on our systems.</li>
3324      <li><strong>Communications</strong> — enquiries, messages and records of our correspondence with you.</li>
3325      <li><strong>Technical information</strong> — IP address, browser type and pages visited, collected when you use this website.</li>
3326      <li><strong>Operator applicants</strong> — additionally, ABN, equipment details, availability, and the results of identity and background screening.</li>
3327    </ul>
3328
3329    <h2>2. Why we collect it</h2>
3330    <ul>
3331      <li>To provide the service you have booked and to contact you about it</li>
3332      <li>To process payments and issue invoices</li>
3333      <li>To route your job to an operator in your area</li>
3334      <li>To handle enquiries, complaints and claims</li>
3335      <li>To meet our legal and tax record-keeping obligations</li>
3336      <li>To improve our service and plan where we open next</li>
3337    </ul>
3338
3339    <h2>3. Who we share it with</h2>
3340    <p>We disclose personal information only where necessary, to:</p>
3341    <ul>
3342      <li><strong>The operator assigned to your job</strong> — your name, collection address, access instructions and service preferences. Operators are bound by confidentiality obligations in their agreement with us.</li>
3343      <li><strong>Specialist partner cleaners</strong> — where your order includes dry cleaning.</li>
3344      <li><strong>Service providers</strong> — payment processing, SMS and email delivery, cloud hosting and customer support tooling.</li>
3345      <li><strong>Plan managers or support coordinators</strong> — only where you have engaged us through them, and only invoicing and service information.</li>
3346      <li><strong>Law enforcement or regulators</strong> — where we are legally required to do so.</li>
3347    </ul>
3348    <p>We do not sell personal information. We do not disclose it for third-party marketing.</p>
3349
3350    <h2>4. Overseas disclosure</h2>
3351    <p>Some of our technology providers store data outside Australia. Where that is the case we take reasonable steps to ensure the recipient handles the information consistently with the Australian Privacy Principles. The specific providers and their locations will be listed here before this policy takes effect.</p>
3352
3353    <h2>5. Security</h2>
3354    <p>We hold personal information in access-controlled systems and restrict access to those who need it to do their job. No system is perfectly secure. If a data breach occurs that is likely to result in serious harm, we will notify affected individuals and the Office of the Australian Information Commissioner as required under the Notifiable Data Breaches scheme.</p>
3355
3356    <h2>6. Retention</h2>
3357    <p>We keep personal information only as long as needed for the purpose it was collected, or as required by law — including tax and business record-keeping obligations, generally five years. Unsuccessful operator applications are destroyed within 12 months unless you ask us to keep them on file.</p>
3358
3359    <h2>7. Accessing and correcting your information</h2>
3360    <p>You may request access to the personal information we hold about you, and ask us to correct it. Contact us through the <a href="#/contact" style="text-decoration:underline;color:var(--navy)">contact page</a>. We will respond within 30 days. If we refuse access we will tell you why in writing.</p>
3361
3362    <h2>8. Marketing</h2>
3363    <p>We may send you service updates and offers by email or SMS. Every marketing message includes an unsubscribe method. Opting out of marketing does not stop operational messages about a booking you have made.</p>
3364
3365    <h2>9. Cookies</h2>
3366    <p>This website uses cookies and similar technologies for essential functionality and analytics. You can block cookies in your browser, though some parts of the site may not work correctly.</p>
3367
3368    <h2>10. Complaints</h2>
3369    <p>If you believe we have mishandled your personal information, contact us first and we will investigate. If you are not satisfied with our response, you may complain to the Office of the Australian Information Commissioner at oaic.gov.au.</p>
3370
3371    <h2>11. Changes</h2>
3372    <p>We may update this policy. The current version is always published here with its date of effect.</p>
3373  </div></div></div>
3374</section>

3377     TERMS
3378     ================================================================ -->
3379<section class="page" id="p-terms">
3380  <div class="phead"><div class="wrap">
3381    <div class="crumb"><a href="#/">Home</a> / Terms of Service</div>
3382    <h1>Terms of service</h1>
3383    <p>The terms on which we provide laundry collection, cleaning and delivery services.</p>
3384  </div></div>
3385  <div class="sec"><div class="wrap"><div class="prose">
3386    <div class="updated">Draft for legal review — not yet in force. Date of effect to be inserted on approval.</div>
3387
3388    <h2>1. These terms</h2>
3389    <p>These terms apply when you book any service from Laundrylegends. By placing a booking you agree to them. If you do not agree, do not book.</p>
3390
3391    <h2>2. Bookings and quotes</h2>
3392    <p>Prices shown on this website and in the online estimator are <strong>indicative</strong>. Your final price is determined after your items are weighed and counted at collection, and is confirmed to you before any cleaning begins. If you do not accept the confirmed price, your items are returned to you at no charge.</p>
3393
3394    <h2>3. Collection and delivery</h2>
3395    <p>Collection and delivery occur within the window agreed at booking. Where you have authorised unattended collection or delivery, items left at an agreed location are at your risk from the point they are left until they are collected by us, and from the point they are delivered until you retrieve them.</p>
3396    <p>If we cannot access your items at the agreed time through no fault of ours, a failed collection fee may apply. It will be disclosed to you before it is charged.</p>
3397
3398    <h2>4. Your items</h2>
3399    <p>You confirm that items you submit:</p>
3400    <ul>
3401      <li>Are yours, or you are authorised to submit them</li>
3402      <li>Are suitable for the service selected</li>
3403      <li>Do not contain hazardous materials, biohazards, sharps, or contaminated waste</li>
3404      <li>Have been emptied of valuables, cash, keys and electronics</li>
3405    </ul>
3406    <p>We are not liable for items left in pockets. We may refuse to process any item at our discretion, and will tell you why.</p>
3407
3408    <h2>5. Care labels and risk</h2>
3409    <p>We process items in accordance with their manufacturer care labels. Where a label is missing, illegible or incorrect, we process according to reasonable professional judgement and are not liable for resulting damage. Where we assess an item as high-risk we will contact you and proceed only with your instruction, at your risk.</p>
3410
3411    <h2>6. Payment</h2>
3412    <p>Payment is due once your final price is confirmed and before return delivery, unless you hold an approved account. Legends Club memberships are billed in advance on your nominated cycle. We may suspend service on overdue accounts after written notice.</p>
3413
3414    <h2>7. Legends Club</h2>
3415    <p>Legends Club has no minimum term. You may pause or cancel with notice before your next scheduled collection; billing stops from that point. Fees already paid for a completed billing period are not refunded. We may change plan pricing with written notice before your next billing date, and you may cancel rather than accept the change.</p>
3416
3417    <h2>8. Liability and claims</h2>
3418    <p>Claims must be made within the timeframes set out in our <a href="#/guarantee" style="text-decoration:underline;color:var(--navy)">Service Guarantee</a>. Our liability for loss or damage is limited as described there, and is based on an item's current value taking reasonable account of age and condition.</p>
3419    <p>Nothing in these terms excludes, restricts or modifies any guarantee, right or remedy you have under the <strong>Australian Consumer Law</strong> that cannot lawfully be excluded. Where our liability can be limited under the ACL, it is limited to resupplying the service or paying the cost of resupply.</p>
3420
3421    <h2>9. Unclaimed items</h2>
3422    <p>Where we cannot deliver items and cannot contact you, we will hold them for 90 days and make reasonable attempts to reach you. After 90 days we may dispose of or donate them, and recover reasonable storage costs.</p>
3423
3424    <h2>10. Our operators</h2>
3425    <p>Services are performed by independent operators engaged by us. We remain responsible to you for the service under these terms and under the Australian Consumer Law.</p>
3426
3427    <h2>11. Suspension and termination</h2>
3428    <p>We may decline or discontinue service where items are unsuitable, where an account is overdue, or where an operator's safety is at risk. We will tell you why.</p>
3429
3430    <h2>12. Governing law</h2>
3431    <p>These terms are governed by the laws of Queensland, Australia, and the courts of Queensland have jurisdiction.</p>
3432
3433    <h2>13. Changes</h2>
3434    <p>We may update these terms. The version published here at the time you place a booking is the version that applies to it.</p>
3435  </div></div></div>
3436</section>

4147<script>
4148/* ============================================================
4149   LAUNDRYLEGENDS — APPLICATION
4150   Backend: claude.use("db") — real persistence.
4151   Nothing on this page is fabricated. Prices live in db
4152   config/pricing and are editable without a rebuild.
4153   ============================================================ */
4154
4155/* ---------- DEFAULT PRICING (launch placeholders) ----------
4156   These are LAUNCH ASSUMPTIONS, not confirmed rates.
4157   Basis: benchmarked against comparable AU home-operator
4158   laundry services. Variable: real operator cost per load,
4159   fuel/vehicle cost per stop, and target margin.
4160   Owner can overwrite these in db at config/pricing.        */
4161const DEFAULT_PRICING = {
4162  load: 32.00,          // per ~5kg load, wash & fold
4163  premium: 15.00,       // Premium Clean add-on, per load (replaces ironing)
4164  bag: 12.00,           // branded bag, optional paid line item
4165  delivery: 13.50,      // collection + return, one flat fee
4166  minimum: 73.50,   // Laundry Lady $70 min +5% — decision 18 Sep 2026
4167  dcJacket: 18.50,
4168  dcDress: 16.50,
4169  dcSuit: 32.00,
4170  bulkDoona: 45.00,
4171  bulkDoonaKing: 75.00,
4172  bulkCurtain: 38.00,
4173  linenSheetSet: 24.00,   // sheet set, per set — large-linen service, not by weight
4174  linenBlanket: 32.00,    // single/double blanket or quilt cover, per item
4175  linenRug: 42.00,        // rug or floor mat, per item, subject to size
4176  ecoAddon: 3.50,
4177  // Legends Club, +30% on the launch rate, effective 19 Sep 2026
4178  plan1: 63.70, plan2: 89.70, plan3: 115.70
4179};
4180let PX = Object.assign({}, DEFAULT_PRICING);
4181let DB = null, USER = null, CAN_EDIT = false;
4182
4183const money = n => { const v = Number(n) || 0; return '$' + (Math.abs(v - Math.round(v)) < 0.005 ? String(Math.round(v)) : v.toFixed(2)); };
4184/* Whole dollars with thousands separators — annual projections run to six
4185   figures, where cents are noise and an unseparated run of digits is hard
4186   to read at a glance. */
4187const bigMoney = n => '$' + Math.round(Number(n) || 0).toLocaleString('en-AU');
4188
4189/* ---------- SUBURB DATA ---------- */
4190const LIVE_PC = {
4191  '4131':'Meadowbrook','4127':'Springwood','4128':'Shailer Park','4129':'Loganholme',
4192  '4130':'Cornubia','4132':'Marsden','4133':'Waterford','4207':'Beenleigh',
4193  '4118':'Browns Plains','4119':'Kuraby','4109':'Sunnybank','4122':'Mansfield',
4194  '4121':'Holland Park','4120':'Greenslopes','4151':'Coorparoo','4152':'Camp Hill'
4195};
4196const SOON_PC = {

4230/* ---------- SCROLL REVEAL ----------
4231   Runs only where the viewer has not asked for reduced motion, and only once
4232   per element. Everything is visible without it. */
4233(() => {
4234  if (!window.matchMedia || window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) return;
4235})();
4236function wireReveal(){
4237  if (!window.IntersectionObserver) return;
4238  if (window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) return;
4239  const targets = document.querySelectorAll('.page.live .sec > .wrap > *, .page.live .trust-c, .page.live .card');
4240  if (!targets.length) return;
4241  const io = new IntersectionObserver(es => {
4242    es.forEach(e => { if (e.isIntersecting){ e.target.classList.add('in'); io.unobserve(e.target); } });
4243  }, { rootMargin: '0px 0px -8% 0px', threshold: 0.05 });
4244  targets.forEach(t => { t.classList.add('reveal'); io.observe(t); });
4245}

4247function route(){
4248  const h = (location.hash || '#/').replace('#/','').split('?')[0] || 'home';
4249  const id = PAGES.includes(h) ? h : 'home';
4250  document.querySelectorAll('.page').forEach(p => p.classList.remove('live'));
4251  const el = document.getElementById('p-' + id);
4252  if (el) el.classList.add('live');
4253  document.querySelectorAll('[data-nav]').forEach(a => a.classList.toggle('on', a.dataset.nav === id));
4254  window.scrollTo(0,0);
4255  document.getElementById('mob').classList.remove('open');
4256  setTitle(id);
4257  try { wireReveal(); } catch(e){}
4258  if (id === 'dash') loadDash();
4259  try { appRoute(id); } catch(e){}
4260}

4370function paintSubs(){
4371  const host = document.getElementById('subsAll');
4372  if (!host) return;
4373
4374  /* one flat list, each entry carrying its own status */
4375  const all = []
4376    .concat(Object.entries(LIVE_PC).map(([pc,nm]) => ({pc, nm, st:'live'})))
4377    .concat(Object.entries(SOON_PC).map(([pc,nm]) => ({pc, nm, st:'soon'})));
4378
4379  const lgL = document.getElementById('lgLive');
4380  const lgS = document.getElementById('lgSoon');
4381  if (lgL) lgL.textContent = '(' + all.filter(s=>s.st==='live').length + ' suburbs)';
4382  if (lgS) lgS.textContent = '(' + all.filter(s=>s.st==='soon').length + ' suburbs)';
4383
4384  /* group by region, ordered */
4385  const groups = {};
4386  all.forEach(s => { const r = PC_REGION[s.pc] || 'Other'; (groups[r] = groups[r] || []).push(s); });
4387  const order = REGION_ORDER.filter(r => groups[r]).concat(Object.keys(groups).filter(r => !REGION_ORDER.includes(r)));
4388
4389  host.innerHTML = order.map(r => {
4390    const list = groups[r].sort((a,b) => a.nm.localeCompare(b.nm));
4391    const nLive = list.filter(s=>s.st==='live').length;
4392    const note = nLive === list.length ? 'All collecting now'
4393               : nLive === 0 ? 'Opening next'
4394               : nLive + ' of ' + list.length + ' collecting now';
4395    return '<div class="rgrp">'
4396      + '<div class="rgrp-h"><h3>' + r + '</h3><span>' + note + '</span></div>'
4397      + '<div class="subs">' + list.map(s =>
4398          '<button class="sub' + (s.st==='soon'?' is-soon':'') + '" data-pc="' + s.pc + '">'
4399          + '<span>' + s.nm + '</span>'
4400          + '<span class="sub-pc">' + s.pc + '<span class="dot ' + s.st + '"></span></span>'
4401          + '</button>').join('')
4402      + '</div></div>';
4403  }).join('');
4404
4405  /* tapping a suburb runs it through the checker */
4406  host.querySelectorAll('[data-pc]').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => {
4407    const f = document.getElementById('covPc2');
4408    if (!f) return;
4409    f.value = b.dataset.pc;
4410    document.getElementById('covGo2').click();
4411    document.querySelector('#p-coverage .cov').scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth', block:'center'});
4412  });
4413}

4416function checkPc(inp, res, showForm){
4417  const v = (document.getElementById(inp).value || '').trim();
4418  const el = document.getElementById(res);
4419  el.className = 'cov-r show';
4420  if (!/^\d{4}$/.test(v)){ el.classList.add('soon'); el.textContent = 'Please enter a valid four-digit Australian postcode.'; return; }
4421  if (LIVE_PC[v]){
4422    el.classList.add('ok');
4423    el.innerHTML = 'We are running collections in ' + LIVE_PC[v] + ' (' + v + '). <a href="#quote">Get a quote and book a collection.</a>';
4424  } else if (SOON_PC[v]){
4425    el.classList.add('soon');
4426    el.innerHTML = SOON_PC[v] + ' (' + v + ') is next on our list — we are recruiting an operator for that round now. Register below and we will contact you before we launch.';
4427  } else {
4428    el.classList.add('no');
4429    el.innerHTML = 'We are not in ' + v + ' yet. Register your interest below — we open new rounds where registered demand is highest.';
4430  }
4431  el.dataset.pc = v;
4432}
4433document.getElementById('covGo2').onclick = () => checkPc('covPc2','covRes2', false);

4436/* ---------- FAQ ---------- */
4437const FAQS = [
4438  ['Do I need to be home for collection?','No. Most customers are not. Leave your bag at an agreed spot — front door, gate, or wherever you nominate — and we will collect it. Once our messaging system is live you will get a notification when your operator is on the way. Items left unattended are at your risk until collected, which is set out in our terms.'],
4439  ['How is the final price worked out?','Your operator weighs and counts your items at collection, then confirms the exact price before any washing starts. The estimator on this site gives you an indicative figure so you are not going in blind, but the confirmed number always comes before the work.'],
4440  ['Will my clothes be washed with someone else\'s?','No. Every household\'s laundry is processed on its own cycle. Your items are tagged, kept together, and returned in your own bag. This is a firm operating rule, not a premium upgrade.'],
4441  ['What detergent do you use?','A commercial-grade standard detergent by default. Sensitive-skin and fragrance-free options are available at no extra charge — just note it at booking. An eco formulation is available as a paid add-on. If you have a specific allergy, tell us and we will confirm exactly what will be used before we collect.'],
4442  ['Can you separate lights and darks?','Yes, and we do it as standard. Because they are washed on separate cycles this counts as two loads and is priced accordingly. It is shown on your quote so there is no surprise.'],
4443  ['What is your turnaround time?','Standard turnaround is confirmed at booking based on your service type and your operator\'s current capacity. Dry cleaning and bulky items take longer. We tell you the return date before you commit rather than promising a headline figure we cannot always hit.'],
4444  ['What happens if something is damaged or lost?','Report it within seven days. We investigate using the count and weight recorded at collection and respond within five business days. Full detail, including what is and is not covered, is on our Service Guarantee page.'],
4445  ['Do you handle NDIS participants?','We can be engaged directly by self-managed and plan-managed participants and by coordinators purchasing on a participant\'s behalf. We are not currently a registered NDIS provider, so we cannot invoice the NDIA directly for agency-managed plans. Our Supported Living page sets this out in full.'],
4446  ['How do I pay?','Payment is processed once your final price is confirmed, before return delivery. Legends Club members are billed on their nominated cycle. Approved business accounts can be invoiced monthly.'],
4447  ['Can I cancel Legends Club?','Yes, any time, with notice before your next scheduled collection. No minimum term, no exit fee. Fees already paid for a completed period are not refunded.'],
4448  ['Do you clean healthcare or clinical linen?','Not currently. We do not hold AS/NZS 4146 accreditation, so we will not quote for work that legally requires it. If you need accredited healthcare laundry we will say so rather than take the job.'],
4449  ['How do I become an operator?','Through the Become an Operator page. It sets out what the arrangement is, what you need, and what we cannot yet tell you — including why we are not publishing earnings figures.']
4450];

4468function say(id, ok, txt){ const e = document.getElementById(id); e.className = 'fmsg show ' + (ok?'ok':'err'); e.textContent = txt; e.setAttribute('role','status'); e.setAttribute('aria-live','polite'); }

4470async function save(coll, data, msgId, okTxt){
4471  const rec = Object.assign({ createdAt: new Date().toISOString(), status: 'new' }, data);
4472  if (!DB){
4473    say(msgId, false, 'The enquiry system is not connected in this view. Please use the contact details in the footer.');
4474    console.warn('[LL] db unavailable — record not saved:', coll, rec);
4475    return false;
4476  }
4477  try {
4478    await DB.collection(coll).add(rec);
4479    say(msgId, true, okTxt);
4480    return true;
4481  } catch (e){
4482    say(msgId, false, e.code === 'quota_exceeded'
4483      ? 'Our enquiry store is full. Please contact us directly.'
4484      : 'Could not send that. Please try again, or contact us directly.');
4485    console.error('[LL]', e);
4486    return false;
4487  }
4488}

4529async function loadDash(){

4531  if (!DB || !CAN_EDIT){
4532    gate.style.display = ''; body.style.display = 'none';
4533    gate.innerHTML = '<h3>Not available in this view</h3><p>This dashboard is visible only to Laundrylegends editors signed in to Claude. If that is you and you are seeing this, the data layer has not loaded.</p>';
4534    return;
4535  }
4536  gate.style.display = 'none'; body.style.display = '';
4537  document.getElementById('dashTabs').innerHTML = COLLS.map(([k,l]) =>
4538    '<button class="dtab' + (k===dashTab?' on':'') + '" data-tab="' + k + '">' + l + '</button>').join('');
4539  document.querySelectorAll('.dtab').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => { dashTab = b.dataset.tab; loadDash(); });
4540  const list = document.getElementById('dashList');
4541  list.innerHTML = '<p style="color:var(--mute);font-size:var(--fs-micro)">Loading…</p>';
4542  try {
4543    const snap = await DB.collection(dashTab).orderBy('createdAt','desc').limit(100).get();
4544    if (snap.empty){ list.innerHTML = '<div class="empty"><h3>Nothing here yet</h3><p>Submissions to this form will appear here as they come in.</p></div>'; return; }
4545    list.innerHTML = snap.docs.map(d => {
4546      const v = d.data();
4547      const when = v.createdAt ? new Date(v.createdAt).toLocaleString('en-AU') : '';
4548      const rows = Object.entries(v).filter(([k]) => !['createdAt','status','pricingSnapshot'].includes(k))
4549        .map(([k,val2]) => '<dt>' + k + '</dt><dd>' + String(val2 ?? '') + '</dd>').join('');
4550      return '<div class="rec"><div class="rec-h"><strong>' + (v.name || v.business || v.suburb || v.email || d.id) + '</strong><time>' + when + '</time></div><dl>' + rows + '</dl></div>';
4551    }).join('');
4552  } catch(e){
4553    list.innerHTML = '<div class="empty"><h3>Could not load</h3><p>' + (e.message || 'Unknown error') + '</p></div>';
4554  }
4555}

4729function aiAnswer(text){
4730  const hit = AI_INTENTS.find(i => i.re.test(text));
4731  return hit ? { handled:true, intent:hit.id, html:hit.reply(text) } : { handled:false };
4732}

4737function aiPush(who, html){
4738  AI_LOG.push({ who, html });
4739  const log = document.getElementById('aiLog'); if (!log) return;
4740  const d = document.createElement('div');
4741  d.className = 'ai-m ' + who;
4742  d.innerHTML = html;
4743  log.appendChild(d);
4744  log.scrollTop = log.scrollHeight;
4745}
4746
4747async function aiSend(text){
4748  const q = String(text || '').trim(); if (!q) return;
4749  aiPush('you', esc(q));
4750  const local = aiAnswer(q);
4751  if (local.handled){ aiPush('bot', local.html); return; }
4752
4753  /* Anything not covered above goes to the worker, which runs the model
4754     with the same refusals in its system prompt. If it is unreachable we
4755     say so rather than inventing an answer. */
4756  aiPush('bot', '<span id="aiThinking">Thinking...</span>');
4757  try {
4758    const res = await fetch(AI_ENDPOINT, {
4759      method:'POST', headers:{ 'Content-Type':'application/json' },
4760      body: JSON.stringify({ message:q, history: AI_LOG.slice(-8) })
4761    });
4762    if (!res.ok) throw new Error('status ' + res.status);
4763    const data = await res.json();
4764    const t = document.getElementById('aiThinking');
4765    if (t) t.parentElement.innerHTML = esc(data.reply || '').replace(/\n/g,'<br>');
4766  } catch (e){
4767    const t = document.getElementById('aiThinking');
4768    if (t) t.parentElement.innerHTML = 'I cannot reach our assistant right now, and I would rather '
4769      + 'say that than guess. <a href="#/contact">Send us a message</a> and someone will answer properly.';
4770  }
4771}

4773/* The pill is route-gated by CSS (body.route-home). This adds the second
4774   gate: hide it while #hero, #finalcta or the footer is on screen, or the
4775   assistant is open, so it never covers a control that does the same job. */
4776let AI_OPEN = false;
4777const STICKY_VIS = new Set();
4778function syncStickyCta(){
4779  const pill = document.querySelector('.stickyCta'); if (!pill) return;
4780  pill.classList.toggle('is-hidden', STICKY_VIS.size > 0 || AI_OPEN);
4781}
4782function wireStickyCta(){
4783  const pill = document.querySelector('.stickyCta');
4784  if (!pill || !('IntersectionObserver' in window)) return;
4785  const covers = ['#hero', '#finalcta', '#foot'].map(q => document.querySelector(q)).filter(Boolean);
4786  const io = new IntersectionObserver(entries => {
4787    entries.forEach(e => e.isIntersecting ? STICKY_VIS.add(e.target) : STICKY_VIS.delete(e.target));
4788    syncStickyCta();
4789  }, { threshold: 0.02 });
4790  covers.forEach(el => io.observe(el));
4791  syncStickyCta();
4792}

4794function wireAI(){

4796  if (!fab || !panel) return;
4797  const open = on => {
4798    panel.hidden = !on;
4799    fab.setAttribute('aria-expanded', on ? 'true' : 'false');
4800    AI_OPEN = on; syncStickyCta();
4801    if (on){
4802      if (!AI_LOG.length) aiPush('bot', 'Hello. I can tell you what things cost, check your collections '
4803        + 'and point you to the right page. What do you need?');
4804      const tx = document.getElementById('aiTx'); if (tx) tx.focus();
4805    }
4806  };
4807  fab.onclick = () => open(panel.hidden);
4808  const x = document.getElementById('aiX'); if (x) x.onclick = () => open(false);
4809  document.addEventListener('keydown', e => { if (e.key === 'Escape' && !panel.hidden) open(false); });
4810
4811  const chips = document.getElementById('aiChips');
4812  if (chips){
4813    chips.innerHTML = AI_CHIPS.map(c => '<button type="button" class="ai-chip">' + esc(c) + '</button>').join('');
4814    chips.querySelectorAll('.ai-chip').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => aiSend(b.textContent));
4815  }
4816
4817  const form = document.getElementById('aiForm');
4818  if (form) form.onsubmit = e => {

4826/* ============================================================
4827   PAYMENT METHODS
4828   Laundry is priced by weight, and the weight is not known until the
4829   operator has the bags. So nothing here charges the estimate: each
4830   method either holds it, takes a deposit against it, or defers
4831   entirely, and the balance settles once the real figure exists.
4832   depositPct 0 means nothing is taken up front.
4833   ============================================================ */
4834const PAY_METHODS = [
4835  { id:'payid',  name:'PayID',            depositPct:0,   fee:0.20,
4836    blurb:'Bank transfer from your banking app. Cheapest for us, so it is the one we ask for first.',
4837    settle:'We send a PayID request for the real amount once your laundry is weighed.' },
4838  { id:'card',   name:'Card',             depositPct:0,   fee:null, hold:true,
4839    blurb:'Visa, Mastercard, Apple Pay or Google Pay.',
4840    settle:'We place a hold for the estimate now and charge only the actual amount after weighing. If the real figure is lower, the difference is never taken.' },
4841  { id:'deposit',name:'Deposit and balance', depositPct:30, fee:null,
4842    blurb:'Pay part now, the rest when the job is done.',
4843    settle:'We take 30% of the estimate now. The balance is charged once your laundry is weighed and confirmed.' },
4844  { id:'paypal', name:'PayPal',           depositPct:0,   fee:null,
4845    blurb:'If you would rather not give us a card directly.',
4846    settle:'We send a PayPal request for the real amount once your laundry is weighed.' },
4847  { id:'bpay',   name:'BPAY invoice',     depositPct:0,   fee:null, b2bOnly:true,
4848    blurb:'Business accounts only. Invoiced on 14-day terms.',
4849    settle:'Invoiced after the job with 14 days to pay. Available on approved business accounts.' }
4850];
4851
4852/* A deposit is only meaningful above the minimum order: below it the
4853   estimate barely exceeds the floor and splitting it creates two
4854   trivial charges instead of one. */
4855function payPlan(methodId, estimateTotal){
4856  const m = PAY_METHODS.find(x => x.id === methodId) || PAY_METHODS[0];
4857  const est = Number(estimateTotal) || 0;
4858  const pct = m.depositPct && est > PX.minimum ? m.depositPct : 0;
4859  const now = Math.round(est * (pct / 100) * 100) / 100;
4860  return { method: m, now, later: Math.round((est - now) * 100) / 100, pct,
4861           held: m.hold ? est : 0 };
4862}

4886/* Fair Work multi-factor test. No single answer decides it: the courts
4887   weigh the whole relationship, so this scores the factors and flags
4888   anything that needs a person to look at it. An ABN on its own never
4889   makes someone a contractor, and getting this wrong is what triggers
4890   superannuation and payroll tax exposure. */
4891const OB_FACTORS = [
4892  { id:'control',   q:'Who decides how the work is done?',
4893    a:[['You decide your own method and order of work','c'],['Laundrylegends directs the method step by step','e']] },
4894  { id:'hours',     q:'Who sets your hours?',
4895    a:[['You choose which jobs to accept and when','c'],['Laundrylegends rosters you onto set shifts','e']] },
4896  { id:'equipment', q:'Whose equipment is used?',
4897    a:[['Mine — my own machines, vehicle and supplies','c'],['Laundrylegends supplies the equipment','e']] },
4898  { id:'delegate',  q:'Could you pay someone else to do a job for you?',
4899    a:[['Yes, I can subcontract or delegate','c'],['No, I must do the work personally','e']] },
4900  { id:'risk',      q:'Who carries the commercial risk if a job goes wrong?',
4901    a:[['I do — I fix defects at my own cost','c'],['Laundrylegends carries the cost','e']] },
4902  { id:'exclusive', q:'Do you work for others as well?',
4903    a:[['Yes, or I am free to','c'],['No, I work only for Laundrylegends','e']] },
4904  { id:'pay',       q:'How are you paid?',
4905    a:[['Per job completed, against my invoice','c'],['An hourly or weekly wage','e']] }
4906];
4907
4908function contractorTest(answers){
4909  const vals = OB_FACTORS.map(f => answers[f.id]).filter(Boolean);
4910  const answered = vals.length;
4911  const employeeMarks = vals.filter(v => v === 'e').length;
4912  const complete = answered === OB_FACTORS.length;
4913  /* Any employee-leaning answer at all is worth a look, because the
4914     factors are not equally weighted in law and we are not the ones
4915     who get to decide the balance. */
4916  let outcome = 'contractor', why = 'Every factor points to an independent contracting arrangement.';
4917  if (!complete){ outcome = 'incomplete'; why = 'Answer every question so the result can be recorded.'; }
4918  else if (employeeMarks >= 4){ outcome = 'employee'; why = 'Most factors point to employment. This role should be engaged as an employee.'; }
4919  else if (employeeMarks > 0){ outcome = 'review'; why = employeeMarks + ' of ' + OB_FACTORS.length
4920      + ' factors point toward employment. A person needs to look at this before you are engaged.'; }
4921  return { outcome, why, employeeMarks, answered, complete,
4922           superFlag: outcome !== 'contractor' };
4923}
