4935/* ============================================================
4936   HOTEL PARTNER PROGRAM
4937   Guest pricing is separate from the residential rate card: a hotel
4938   guest buys a finished bag, not a weighed household collection.
4939   Commission rises with portfolio size so a group has a reason to
4940   bring every property across rather than trialling one.
4941   All figures LAUNCH ASSUMPTIONS pending Max's sign-off.
4942   ============================================================ */
4943const HOTEL_PX = {
4944  standard: 40.00,   // one bag, up to 5 kg
4945  double:   70.00,   // two bags, couples and families
4946  package: 159.00,   // unlimited for the stay, from the 5th bag
4947  premium:  15.00    // Premium Clean add-on, per bag
4948};
4949/* Blend assumes most guests buy a standard bag, a smaller share the
4950   double, and a few long stays tip into the package. */
4951const HOTEL_BLEND = 48.00;
4952
4953/* minProps is null on the first two tiers: below Premium a single
4954   property qualifies on room count alone, so treating "1 property" as a
4955   portfolio qualifier would push every small hotel straight past
4956   Standard. */
4957const HOTEL_TIERS = [
4958  { name:'Standard',   pct:8,  minRooms:0,    minProps:null, note:'Single property under 100 rooms' },
4959  { name:'Partner',    pct:10, minRooms:100,  minProps:null, note:'Single property, 100 to 200 rooms' },
4960  { name:'Premium',    pct:12, minRooms:200,  minProps:2,    note:'200+ rooms, or 2 to 3 properties' },
4961  { name:'Portfolio',  pct:15, minRooms:400,  minProps:3,    note:'3 to 5 properties, or 400+ rooms' },
4962  { name:'Enterprise', pct:18, minRooms:800,  minProps:5,    note:'5 to 10 properties, or 800+ rooms' },
4963  { name:'Exclusive',  pct:20, minRooms:1500, minProps:10,   note:'10+ properties, or an exclusive contract' }
4964];
4965
4966/* Whichever of rooms or property count reaches higher wins. */
4967function hotelTier(totalRooms, props){
4968  return HOTEL_TIERS.reduce((best, t) => {
4969    const byRooms = totalRooms >= t.minRooms;
4970    const byProps = t.minProps != null && props >= t.minProps;
4971    return (byRooms || byProps) && t.pct > best.pct ? t : best;
4972  }, HOTEL_TIERS[0]);
4973}
4974
4975function hotelModel(rooms, occPct, convPct, props){
4976  const r = Math.max(1, Number(rooms) || 0);
4977  const p = Math.max(1, Number(props) || 1);
4978  const occupied = r * (Math.min(100, Math.max(0, Number(occPct) || 0)) / 100);
4979  const ordersPerDay = occupied * (Math.min(100, Math.max(0, Number(convPct) || 0)) / 100);
4980  const perProperty = ordersPerDay * HOTEL_BLEND * 365;
4981  const annual = perProperty * p;
4982  const tier = hotelTier(r * p, p);
4983  const commission = annual * (tier.pct / 100);
4984  return {
4985    tier, occupied, ordersPerDay, annual, commission,
4986    monthly: commission / 12,
4987    perRoomNight: (r * p * 365) > 0 ? commission / (r * p * 365) : 0
4988  };
4989}

4991const tierFor = spend => TIERS.reduce((t,x)=> spend >= x.min ? x : t, TIERS[0]);
4992const nextTier = spend => TIERS.find(t => t.min > spend) || null;
4993const crownsToAud = c => Math.round(c * CROWN_VALUE * 100) / 100;
4994
4995/* Crowns earned by one order, at the tier the customer held when it ran. */
4996function crownsFor(amount, tierId){
4997  const t = TIERS.find(x=>x.id===tierId) || TIERS[0];
4998  return Math.floor(Number(amount||0) * t.mult);
4999}
5000
5001/* Rolling 12-month spend drives tier; lifetime spend sets a floor so a
5002   long-standing customer never drops back to Member after a quiet patch. */
5003const LIFETIME_FLOOR_SPEND = 3000;
5004const LIFETIME_FLOOR_TIER  = 'silver';
5005
5006function rewardsState(){
5007  const r = S.acct.rewards || {};
5008  const now = Date.now();
5009  const yearAgo = now - CROWN_EXPIRY_DAYS*864e5;
5010  const orders = (S.bookings||[]).filter(b => b.status==='complete' && b.paidAmount);
5011  const rolling = orders.filter(b => (b.completedAt||0) >= yearAgo)
5012                        .reduce((s,b)=> s + Number(b.paidAmount||0), 0);
5013  const lifetime = orders.reduce((s,b)=> s + Number(b.paidAmount||0), 0);
5014  let tier = tierFor(rolling);
5015  if (lifetime >= LIFETIME_FLOOR_SPEND){
5016    const floor = TIERS.find(t=>t.id===LIFETIME_FLOOR_TIER);
5017    if (floor && floor.min > tier.min) tier = floor;
5018  }
5019  const balance = Math.max(0, Number(r.balance || SIGNUP_CROWNS));
5020  const lastOrder = orders.reduce((m,b)=> Math.max(m, b.completedAt||0), 0);
5021  return {
5022    balance, tier, rolling, lifetime,
5023    next: nextTier(rolling),
5024    lapsesAt: lastOrder ? lastOrder + CROWN_EXPIRY_DAYS*864e5 : null,
5025    referralCode: r.referralCode || '',
5026    redeemed: r.redeemed || []
5027  };
5028}

5053      if (snap.exists) S.acct = Object.assign(S.acct, snap.data(), { comms: Object.assign({}, S.acct.comms, (snap.data()||{}).comms) });
5054      PERSISTED = true;

5057      try { S.profiles  = (await sub('profiles').get()).docs.map(d => Object.assign({id:d.id}, d.data())); } catch(e){}
5058      try { S.bookings  = (await sub('bookings').orderBy('date','desc').limit(100).get()).docs.map(d => Object.assign({id:d.id}, d.data())); } catch(e){}
5059      try { S.messages  = (await sub('messages').orderBy('at','desc').limit(100).get()).docs.map(d => Object.assign({id:d.id}, d.data())); } catch(e){}
5060    }
5061  }
5062  if (!PERSISTED){
5063    if (MEM.acct) S.acct = MEM.acct;
5064    S.profiles = MEM.profiles; S.bookings = MEM.bookings; S.messages = MEM.messages;
5065  }
5066  if (!S.profiles.length){
5067    const p = { id:'p'+uid4(), name:'My home', contact:'', email:'', phone:'', type:'Household',
5068                line1:'', suburb:'', postcode:'', state:'QLD', access:'', care:'', del:'', svc:'wf',
5069                eco:false, preferred:true, createdAt:Date.now() };
5070    S.profiles.push(p); S.acct.activeId = p.id;
5071    if (!PERSISTED) MEM.profiles = S.profiles;
5072  }

5097/* ---- pricing estimate ----
5098   bagQty is optional; when supplied each bag is added as a one-off line item. */
5099function estimate(svc, a, b, bagQty){
5100  if (svc === 'comm') return null;
5101  let lines = [], subtot = 0;
5102  if (svc === 'wf'   ){ const v=a*PX.load; subtot+=v; lines.push([a+' × wash & fold load'+(a>1?'s':''), v]); }
5103  if (svc === 'wfi'  ){ const pc=Math.min(b,a), w=a*PX.load, i=pc*PX.premium; subtot+=w+i;
5104                        lines.push([a+' × wash & fold load'+(a>1?'s':''), w]);
5105                        if (pc) lines.push([pc+' × Premium Clean load'+(pc>1?'s':''), i]); }
5106  if (svc === 'premium' ){ const v=a*PX.premium; subtot+=v; lines.push([a+' × Premium Clean load'+(a>1?'s':''), v]); }
5107  if (svc === 'linen'){ const v=a*PX.linenSheetSet; subtot+=v; lines.push([a+' × blanket, rug or sheet set'+(a>1?'s':''), v]); }
5108  if (svc === 'dc'   ){ const v=a*PX.dcDress; subtot+=v; lines.push([a+' × garment'+(a>1?'s':'')+' (indicative average)', v]); }
5109  const p = activeP();
5110  if (p && p.eco){ const v = PX.ecoAddon; subtot += v; lines.push(['Fragrance-free / sensitive detergent', v]); }
5111  const nb = Number(bagQty) || 0;
5112  if (nb > 0){ const v = nb * PX.bag; subtot += v; lines.push([nb + ' × Laundrylegends bag' + (nb>1?'s':'') + ' (yours to keep)', v]); }
5113  lines.push(['Collection & return', PX.delivery]); subtot += PX.delivery;
5114  const total = Math.max(PX.minimum, subtot);
5115  if (total > subtot + 0.001) lines.push(['Minimum order adjustment', total - subtot]);
5116  return { lines, total };
5117}
5118const sumRows = est => est.lines.map(([l,v]) => '<div class="sumr"><span>'+esc(l)+'</span><span>'+money(v)+'</span></div>').join('')
5119  + '<div class="sumr tot"><span>Estimated total</span><span>'+money(est.total)+'</span></div>';

5302/* ============================================================
5303   WIZARD + SETTINGS WIRING
5304   appBoot calls both of these. They were referenced but never
5305   defined, so appBoot threw on its second statement and every
5306   later line — renderHome, renderAccount, appRoute — never ran,
5307   leaving the whole portal inert. Defining them restores boot and
5308   connects the controls that had no handler.
5309   ============================================================ */
5310function wireWizard(){
5311  const on = (id, fn) => { const e = document.getElementById(id); if (e) e.onclick = fn; };
5312
5313  /* step 1 -> 2. Commercial work is a written quote, not a booking,
5314     so that choice is diverted to the enquiry form instead. */
5315  on('bkN1', () => {
5316    if (W.svc === 'comm'){ location.hash = '#/business'; return; }
5317    wizStep(2); renderWizard();
5318  });
5319  on('bkN2', () => {
5320    if (!W.win){ say('bkMsg', false, 'Choose a collection window to continue.'); return; }
5321    wizStep(3); renderWizard();
5322  });
5323  on('bkP2', () => { wizStep(1); renderWizard(); });
5324  on('bkP3', () => { wizStep(2); renderWizard(); });
5325  on('bkBack', () => { wizStep(Math.max(1, W.step - 1)); renderWizard(); });
5326
5327  const dt = document.getElementById('bkDate');
5328  if (dt) dt.onchange = () => { W.date = dt.value; W.win = ''; renderWizard(); };
5329
5330  const rec = document.getElementById('bkRec');
5331  if (rec) rec.onclick = () => {
5332    W.rec = !W.rec;
5333    rec.classList.toggle('on', W.rec);
5334    const o = document.getElementById('bkRecOpts');
5335    if (o) o.style.display = W.rec ? '' : 'none';
5336    renderWizard();
5337  };
5338  document.querySelectorAll('[data-freq]').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => {
5339    W.freq = b.dataset.freq;
5340    document.querySelectorAll('[data-freq]').forEach(x => x.classList.toggle('on', x === b));
5341  });
5342
5343  on('bkGo', submitBooking);
5344}
5345
5346async function submitBooking(){
5347  const p = activeP();
5348  if (!p || !addrLine(p)){ say('bkMsg', false, 'Add a collection address in your profile first.'); return; }
5349  if (!W.win){ say('bkMsg', false, 'Choose a collection window.'); return; }
5350  const tos = document.getElementById('bkTos');
5351  if (tos && !tos.checked){ say('bkMsg', false, 'Please accept the terms to confirm.'); return; }
5352
5353  const est = estimate(W.svc, W.a, W.b, W.bag ? W.bagQty : 0);
5354  const care = val('bkCare'), del = val('bkDel');
5355  const b = {
5356    id: 'b' + uid4(), ref: REF(), status: 'requested',
5357    svc: W.svc, loads: W.a, premiumLoads: W.b,
5358    bags: W.bag ? W.bagQty : 0,
5359    date: W.date, window: W.win,
5360    recurring: W.rec ? W.freq : '',
5361    profileId: p.id, address: addrLine(p), suburb: p.suburb,
5362    care, del,
5363    estimate: est ? est.total : null,
5364    payMethod: W.pay,
5365    depositDue: payPlan(W.pay, est ? est.total : 0).now,
5366    createdAt: Date.now()
5367  };
5368  S.bookings.unshift(b);
5369  await pushDoc('bookings', b);
5370
5371  /* Opt-in saves back to the profile so the next booking is prefilled. */
5372  const saveCare = document.getElementById('bkCareSave');
5373  const saveDel  = document.getElementById('bkDelSave');
5374  if ((saveCare && saveCare.checked && care) || (saveDel && saveDel.checked && del)){
5375    if (saveCare && saveCare.checked && care) p.care = care;
5376    if (saveDel && saveDel.checked && del) p.del = del;
5377    await saveProfile(p);
5378  }
5379
5380  addMessage(b.ref, 'Collection ' + b.ref + ' requested',
5381    'We have your request for ' + longDate(b.date) + ', ' + b.window + '. '
5382    + 'Your operator will confirm shortly. The final price is set after weighing, before any work begins.');
5383
5384  const done = document.getElementById('bkDoneTx');
5385  if (done) done.textContent = b.ref + ' — ' + longDate(b.date) + ', ' + b.window;
5386  wizStep(4);
5387  renderBookings(); renderMessages(); renderTabs('book');
5388}

5435    await save('feedback', { type: val('fbType'), ref: val('fbRef'), text: val('fbTx') },
5436      'fbMsg', 'Thank you. Your feedback has been logged and we will follow it up.');

5469/* ---- helpers ---- */
5470function gcalUrl(b){
5471  if (!b.date||!b.window) return '';
5472  const d = b.date.replace(/-/g,'');
5473  const wm = { '9am':['090000','120000'], '12pm':['120000','150000'], '4pm':['160000','190000'] };
5474  const key = Object.keys(wm).find(k => b.window.startsWith(k));
5475  const [st,en] = wm[key]||['090000','120000'];
5476  const t = encodeURIComponent(`Laundrylegends — ${b.service||'Collection'} — ${b.contact||b.profile||''}`);
5477  const l = encodeURIComponent(b.address||b.suburb||'');
5478  const dt = encodeURIComponent(`Ref: ${b.ref}\nCustomer: ${b.contact||b.profile||''}\nPhone: ${b.phone||''}\nCare: ${b.care||'Standard'}\nDelivery: ${b.delivery||'Safe place'}`);
5479  return `https://calendar.google.com/calendar/render?action=TEMPLATE&text=${t}&dates=${d}T${st}/${d}T${en}&location=${l}&details=${dt}`;
5480}
5481function mailtoConfirm(b, extra=''){
5482  const subj = encodeURIComponent(`Laundrylegends — Collection confirmed · ${b.ref||''}`);
5483  const bod  = encodeURIComponent(
5484    `Hi ${b.contact||'there'},\n\nYour Laundrylegends collection is confirmed!\n\n`
5485    +`Reference: ${b.ref||''}\nService: ${b.service||''}\nDate: ${b.date||''} · ${b.window||''}\nAddress: ${b.address||b.suburb||''}\n`
5486    +(b.operatorName?`Operator: ${b.operatorName}\n`:'')
5487    +`\nPlease have your laundry bagged and ready at the door before the start of your window.\n`
5488    +`Your operator will weigh and count everything, then confirm the final price before starting.\n`
5489    +(extra?`\n${extra}\n`:'')
5490    +`\nQuestions? Reply to this email or message us through the app.\n\nThank you!\nThe Laundrylegends Team`);
5491  return `mailto:${encodeURIComponent(b.email||'')}?subject=${subj}&body=${bod}`;
5492}

5494/* ---- ops data load ---- */
5495async function opsLoad(){
5496  if (!DB||!CAN_EDIT) return;
5497  try { OPS.jobs = (await DB.collection('bookings_inbox').orderBy('createdAt','desc').limit(300).get()).docs.map(d=>Object.assign({id:d.id},d.data())); } catch(e){ OPS.jobs=[]; }
5498  try { OPS.operators = (await DB.collection('operators').get()).docs.map(d=>Object.assign({id:d.id},d.data())).filter(o=>o.active!==false); } catch(e){ OPS.operators=[]; }
5499  try {
5500    const pc = await DB.doc('config/payment').get();
5501    if (pc.exists){
5502      const pd = pc.data();
5503      if (pd.payid) document.getElementById('invPayId').textContent = `PayID: ${pd.payid}${pd.bsb?' · BSB: '+pd.bsb+' Acct: '+pd.account:''}`;
5504      if (pd.stripeLink){ const a=document.getElementById('invStripe'); a.innerHTML = `Stripe payment link: <a href="${esc(pd.stripeLink)}" target="_blank" style="color:var(--navy);text-decoration:underline">${esc(pd.stripeLink)}</a>`; }
5505    }
5506  } catch(e){}
5507}

5543function opsCard(b){
5544  const stCls = {requested:'new',assigned:'assigned',collected:'collected',invoiced:'invoiced',complete:'',cancelled:''}[b.status]||'';
5545  const pill = `<span class="pill ${({requested:'pd',assigned:'up',collected:'pd',invoiced:'ok',complete:'ok',cancelled:'cx'}[b.status]||'pd')}">${OPS_LABELS[b.status]||b.status}</span>`;
5546  const cal = gcalUrl(b);
5547  const opEl = b.operatorName
5548    ? `<div class="bkc-op"><div class="bkc-av">${esc(initials(b.operatorName))}</div>${esc(b.operatorName)}</div>`
5549    : OPS.operators.length
5550      ? `<div class="selw" style="min-width:150px"><select class="sel" style="font-size:var(--fs-micro);padding:.34rem .6rem" data-opassign="${b.id}"><option value="">Assign operator…</option>${OPS.operators.map(o=>`<option value="${o.id}">${esc(o.first+' '+o.last)}</option>`).join('')}</select></div>`
5551      : `<a href="#/opsops" style="font-size:var(--fs-micro);color:var(--navy);text-decoration:underline">Add operators <svg class="ic ic-inl ic-aft" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#ic-arrow-right"/></svg></a>`;
5552
5553  const acts = [];
5554  if (b.status==='requested')  acts.push(['btn-red','confirm|'+b.id,'<svg class="ic ic-inl" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#ic-check"/></svg> Confirm']);
5555  if (b.status==='assigned')   acts.push(['btn-nv','collect|'+b.id,'Mark collected']);
5556  if (b.status==='collected')  acts.push(['btn-red','invoice|'+b.id,'<svg class="ic ic-inl" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#ic-receipt"/></svg> Invoice']);
5557  if (b.status==='invoiced')   acts.push(['btn-ok','paid|'+b.id,'<svg class="ic ic-inl" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#ic-check-circle"/></svg> Mark paid']);
5558  acts.push(['btn-out','detail|'+b.id,'Detail <svg class="ic ic-sm" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#ic-chevron-right"/></svg>']);
5559
5560  return `<div class="ops-c ${stCls}">
5561    <div class="ops-ch"><div><div class="ops-ref">${esc(b.ref||b.id)}</div><div class="ops-sub">${esc(b.service||'')}${b.recurring?' · recurring':''}${b.estimate?' · est. '+money(b.estimate):''}</div></div>${pill}</div>
5562    <div class="ops-b">
5563      <div class="ops-ln"><i class="ic"><svg class="ic" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#ic-user"/></svg></i><span><strong>${esc(b.contact||b.profile||'Customer')}</strong>${b.email?` · ${esc(b.email)}`:''}${b.phone?` · ${esc(b.phone)}`:''}</span></div>
5564      <div class="ops-ln"><i class="ic"><svg class="ic" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#ic-calendar"/></svg></i><span>${esc(b.date||'')} · ${esc(b.window||'')}${cal?' · <a href="'+cal+'" target="_blank">+ Calendar</a>':''}</span></div>
5565      <div class="ops-ln"><i class="ic"><svg class="ic" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#ic-pin"/></svg></i><span>${esc(b.address||b.suburb||'')}</span></div>
5566      ${b.care?`<div class="ops-ln"><i class="ic"><svg class="ic" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#ic-shirt"/></svg></i><span style="color:var(--mute)">${esc(b.care)}</span></div>`:''}
5567      ${b.delivery?`<div class="ops-ln"><i class="ic"><svg class="ic" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#ic-truck"/></svg></i><span style="color:var(--mute)">${esc(b.delivery)}</span></div>`:''}
5568      <div class="ops-obar">${opEl}<a href="${mailtoConfirm(b)}" style="font-size:var(--fs-micro);color:var(--navy);text-decoration:underline"><svg class="ic ic-inl" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#ic-mail"/></svg> Email customer</a></div>
5569    </div>
5570    <div class="ops-acts2">${acts.map(([cls,act,lbl])=>`<button class="btn ${cls}" data-opact="${act}">${lbl}</button>`).join('')}</div>
5571  </div>`;
5572}

5574function wireOpsActions(){
5575  document.querySelectorAll('[data-opact]').forEach(btn=>{
5576    btn.onclick=()=>{
5577      const [act,id]=btn.dataset.opact.split('|');
5578      const job=OPS.jobs.find(b=>b.id===id); if(!job) return;
5579      if(act==='detail') { opsCurJob=job; location.hash='#/opsbook'; }
5580      if(act==='confirm') confirmOpsJob(job);
5581      if(act==='collect') collectOpsJob(job);
5582      if(act==='paid')    paidOpsJob(job);
5583      if(act==='invoice') { opsCurJob=job; renderInvPage(job); location.hash='#/opsinv'; }
5584    };
5585  });
5586  document.querySelectorAll('[data-opassign]').forEach(sel=>{
5587    sel.onchange=()=>{
5588      const job=OPS.jobs.find(b=>b.id===sel.dataset.opassign); if(!job) return;
5589      const op=OPS.operators.find(o=>o.id===sel.value); if(!op) return;
5590      assignOpsOperator(job,op);
5591    };
5592  });
5593}

5595async function confirmOpsJob(job){ job.status='assigned'; job.confirmedAt=Date.now(); await saveJob(job); await opsLoad(); renderOps(); }
5596async function collectOpsJob(job){ job.status='collected'; job.collectedAt=Date.now(); await saveJob(job); await opsLoad(); renderOps(); }
5597async function paidOpsJob(job){ job.status='complete'; job.paidAt=Date.now(); await saveJob(job); await opsLoad(); renderOps(); }
5598async function assignOpsOperator(job,op){
5599  Object.assign(job,{operatorId:op.id,operatorName:op.first+' '+op.last,operatorEmail:op.email||'',operatorPhone:op.phone||''});
5600  if(job.status==='requested') job.status='assigned';
5601  job.confirmedAt=Date.now();
5602  await saveJob(job); await opsLoad(); renderOps();
5603}

5605/* ---- job detail ---- */
5606function renderOpsBook(){
5607  const job=opsCurJob;
5608  if(!job){ document.getElementById('ojBody').innerHTML='<div class="ap-note warn"><i class="ic"><svg class="ic" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#ic-alert"/></svg></i><span>Job not found.</span></div>'; return; }
5609  document.getElementById('ojRef').textContent=job.ref||job.id;
5610  document.getElementById('ojStatus').textContent=OPS_LABELS[job.status]||job.status;
5611  const cal=gcalUrl(job);
5612  const STAGES=['requested','assigned','collected','invoiced','complete'];
5613  const cur=STAGES.indexOf(job.status);
5614  const timeline=STAGES.map((st,i)=>{
5615    const done=i<cur, active=i===cur;
5616    return `<div class="stnode"><div class="stnode-ic ${done?'done':active?'cur':''}">${done?'<svg class="ic ic-inl" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#ic-check"/></svg>':i+1}</div><div class="stnode-lbl ${done?'done':active?'cur':''}">${OPS_LABELS[st]}</div></div>`+(i<STAGES.length-1?`<div class="stline ${i<cur?'done':''}"></div>`:'');
5617  }).join('');
5618  const opSel=OPS.operators.length
5619    ?`<div class="fld"><label class="lbl">Assign / change operator</label><div class="selw"><select class="sel" id="ojOpSel" aria-label="Assign / change operator"><option value="">Select operator…</option>${OPS.operators.map(o=>`<option value="${o.id}"${job.operatorId===o.id?' selected':''}>${esc(o.first+' '+o.last)} · ${esc(o.suburb||'')}</option>`).join('')}</select></div></div><button class="btn btn-nv btn-full" id="ojAssign" style="margin-top:.55rem">Assign selected</button>`
5620    :`<p class="ap-fine">No operators registered. <a href="#/opsops" style="color:var(--navy)">Add operators <svg class="ic ic-inl ic-aft" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#ic-arrow-right"/></svg></a></p>`;
5621  const acts=[];
5622  if(job.status==='requested')  acts.push(['btn-red','confirm','<svg class="ic ic-inl" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#ic-check"/></svg> Confirm booking']);
5623  if(job.status==='assigned')   acts.push(['btn-nv','collect','Mark collected']);
5624  if(job.status==='collected')  acts.push(['btn-red','invoice','<svg class="ic ic-inl" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#ic-receipt"/></svg> Generate invoice']);
5625  if(job.status==='invoiced')   acts.push(['btn-ok','paid','<svg class="ic ic-inl" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#ic-check-circle"/></svg> Mark paid']);
5626  if(['requested','assigned'].includes(job.status)) acts.push(['btn-out','cancel','Cancel job']);
5627
5628  document.getElementById('ojBody').innerHTML=`
5629    <div class="ap-card"><div class="status-line">${timeline}</div>
5630      <div class="ops-b">
5631        <div class="ops-ln"><i class="ic"><svg class="ic" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#ic-user"/></svg></i><span><strong>${esc(job.contact||job.profile||'Customer')}</strong></span></div>
5632        <div class="ops-ln"><i class="ic"><svg class="ic" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#ic-mail"/></svg></i><span>${esc(job.email||'—')}</span></div>
5633        <div class="ops-ln"><i class="ic"><svg class="ic" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#ic-phone"/></svg></i><span>${esc(job.phone||'—')}</span></div>
5634        <div class="ops-ln"><i class="ic"><svg class="ic" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#ic-basket"/></svg></i><span>${esc(job.service||'')}${job.recurring?' (recurring '+job.recurring+')':''}</span></div>
5635        <div class="ops-ln"><i class="ic"><svg class="ic" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#ic-calendar"/></svg></i><span>${esc(job.date||'')} · ${esc(job.window||'')}${cal?' <a href="'+cal+'" target="_blank">Open in Calendar</a>':''}</span></div>
5636        <div class="ops-ln"><i class="ic"><svg class="ic" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#ic-pin"/></svg></i><span>${esc(job.address||job.suburb||'')}</span></div>
5637        ${job.care?`<div class="ops-ln"><i class="ic"><svg class="ic" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#ic-shirt"/></svg></i><span>${esc(job.care)}</span></div>`:''}
5638        ${job.delivery?`<div class="ops-ln"><i class="ic"><svg class="ic" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#ic-truck"/></svg></i><span>${esc(job.delivery)}</span></div>`:''}
5639        ${job.operatorName?`<div class="ops-ln"><i class="ic"><svg class="ic" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#ic-worker"/></svg></i><span>${esc(job.operatorName)} · ${esc(job.operatorEmail||'')} · ${esc(job.operatorPhone||'')}</span></div>`:''}
5640        ${job.invoiceRef?`<div class="ops-ln"><i class="ic"><svg class="ic" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#ic-receipt"/></svg></i><span>Invoice: ${esc(job.invoiceRef)} · ${job.invoiceTotal?money(job.invoiceTotal):''}</span></div>`:''}
5641        <div class="ops-ln" style="margin-top:.4rem"><i class="ic"><svg class="ic" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#ic-mail"/></svg></i><a href="${mailtoConfirm(job)}">Send confirmation email</a></div>
5642      </div>
5643    </div>
5644    <div class="ap-card"><div class="ap-card-b">${opSel}<div class="fmsg" id="ojMsg"></div></div></div>
5645    <div class="ops-acts2">${acts.map(([cls,act,lbl])=>`<button class="btn ${cls}" data-ojact="${act}">${lbl}</button>`).join('')}</div>`;
5646
5647  if(document.getElementById('ojAssign')){
5648    document.getElementById('ojAssign').onclick=async()=>{
5649      const op=OPS.operators.find(o=>o.id===document.getElementById('ojOpSel').value);
5650      if(!op){ say('ojMsg',false,'Select an operator.'); return; }
5651      await assignOpsOperator(job,op); say('ojMsg',true,'Assigned: '+op.first+' '+op.last);
5652    };
5653  }
5654  document.querySelectorAll('[data-ojact]').forEach(btn=>{
5655    btn.onclick=()=>{
5656      const act=btn.dataset.ojact;
5657      if(act==='confirm') { confirmOpsJob(job); history.back(); }
5658      if(act==='collect') { collectOpsJob(job); history.back(); }
5659      if(act==='paid')    { paidOpsJob(job); history.back(); }
5660      if(act==='invoice') { renderInvPage(job); location.hash='#/opsinv'; }
5661      if(act==='cancel')  { if(confirm('Cancel this job? This cannot be undone.')){ job.status='cancelled'; job.cancelledAt=Date.now(); saveJob(job).then(()=>{ opsLoad().then(()=>{ location.hash='#/ops'; }); }); } }
5662    };
5663  });

5686/* ---- invoice page ---- */
5687function renderInvPage(job){
5688  document.getElementById('invBack').onclick=()=>history.back();
5689  document.getElementById('invRef').textContent='Job '+esc(job.ref||job.id);
5690  document.getElementById('invWt').value='';
5691  document.getElementById('invLinen').value=job.linenItems||0;
5692  document.getElementById('invNotes').value='';
5693  document.getElementById('invAdj').value='';
5694  document.getElementById('invPreview').style.display='none';
5695  document.getElementById('invCalc').onclick=()=>calcInvoice(job);
5696  document.getElementById('invConfirm').onclick=()=>confirmInvoice(job);
5697}
5698function calcInvoice(job){
5699  const kg=parseFloat(document.getElementById('invWt').value)||0;
5700  const linenCount=parseInt(document.getElementById('invLinen').value)||0;
5701  const adj=parseFloat(document.getElementById('invAdj').value)||0;
5702  const svc=job.svc||'wf';
5703  if(!kg&&svc!=='linen'){ say('invMsg',false,'Enter the actual weight to calculate.'); return; }
5704  let lines=[],sub=0;
5705  if(svc==='wf'){
5706    const loads=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(kg/5)), v=loads*PX.load; sub+=v;
5707    lines.push([`${loads} × wash & fold load${loads>1?'s':''} (${kg} kg)`,v]);
5708  } else if(svc==='dc'){
5709    const items=Math.max(1,Math.round(kg/0.5)), v=items*PX.dcDress; sub+=v;
5710    lines.push([`${items} × garment${items>1?'s':''} (dry cleaned)`,v]);
5711  }
5712  if((svc==='wfi'||svc==='premium')&&premiumLoads){ const v=premiumLoads*PX.premium; sub+=v; lines.push([`${premiumLoads} × Premium Clean load${premiumLoads>1?'s':''}`,v]); }
5713  if(svc==='linen'&&linenCount){ const v=linenCount*PX.linenSheetSet; sub+=v; lines.push([`${linenCount} × linen item at sheet set rate — use adj. field for blankets/rugs`,v]); }
5714  lines.push(['Collection & return',PX.delivery]); sub+=PX.delivery;
5715  if(adj){ lines.push([adj>=0?'Adjustment (surcharge)':'Adjustment (discount)',adj]); sub+=adj; }
5716  const total=Math.max(PX.minimum,sub);
5717  if(total>sub+0.001) lines.push(['Minimum order adjustment',total-sub]);
5718  const invNum='INV-'+Date.now().toString(36).slice(-5).toUpperCase();
5719  document.getElementById('invNum').textContent=invNum;
5720  document.getElementById('invLines').innerHTML=lines.map(([l,v])=>`<div class="sumr"><span>${esc(l)}</span><span>${money(v)}</span></div>`).join('');
5721  document.getElementById('invTotAmt').textContent=money(total);
5722  const notes=document.getElementById('invNotes').value.trim();
5723  const body=`Hi ${esc(job.contact||'there')},\n\nYour laundry is ready — here is your invoice.\n\nInvoice: ${invNum}\nBooking: ${job.ref||''}\nService: ${job.service||''}\nDate: ${job.date||''}\n${notes?'Notes: '+notes+'\n':''}\n${lines.map(([l,v])=>l.padEnd(42)+money(v)).join('\n')}\n${'─'.repeat(50)}\nTOTAL DUE: ${money(total)} (GST incl.)\n\nPay online before we can return your laundry:\n[ADD PAYMENT LINK HERE]\n\nVisual, Mastercard, Amex, Google Pay and Apple Pay accepted.\n\nQuestions? Reply to this email.\n\nThank you!\nThe Laundrylegends Team`;
5724  document.getElementById('invEmailBox').innerHTML=`<strong>To:</strong> ${esc(job.email||'[email]')}<br><strong>Subject:</strong> Laundrylegends — Invoice ${invNum} — ${money(total)}<br><pre>${esc(body)}</pre>`;
5725  document.getElementById('invMailto').href=`mailto:${encodeURIComponent(job.email||'')}?subject=${encodeURIComponent(`Laundrylegends — Invoice ${invNum} — ${money(total)}`)}&body=${encodeURIComponent(body)}`;
5726  document.getElementById('invConfirm').dataset.invNum=invNum;
5727  document.getElementById('invConfirm').dataset.total=total;
5728  document.getElementById('invPreview').style.display='';
5729  say('invMsg','','');
5730}
5731async function confirmInvoice(job){
5732  const invNum=document.getElementById('invConfirm').dataset.invNum;
5733  const total=parseFloat(document.getElementById('invConfirm').dataset.total)||0;
5734  job.status='invoiced'; job.invoicedAt=Date.now(); job.invoiceRef=invNum; job.invoiceTotal=total;
5735  const ok=await saveJob(job);
5736  if(ok){
5737    if(DB) try{ await DB.collection('invoices').doc(invNum).set({jobRef:job.ref,contact:job.contact||job.profile,email:job.email,service:job.service,date:job.date,total,createdAt:Date.now()}); }catch(e){}
5738    say('invMsg',true,'Invoice recorded. Job updated to awaiting payment.');
5739    await opsLoad();
5740    setTimeout(()=>{ location.hash='#/ops'; },1500);
5741  } else { say('invMsg',false,'Could not save — try again.'); }
5742}

5772  { const bn = document.getElementById('bkNumA'); if (bn){ bn.textContent = W.a; bn.classList.remove('bump'); void bn.offsetWidth; bn.classList.add('bump'); } }
5773  document.getElementById('bkN1').innerHTML=(W.svc==='comm'?'Commercial enquiry':'Continue')+'<svg class="ic ic-inl ic-aft" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#ic-arrow-right"/></svg>';
5774  if(document.getElementById('bkFldB')) document.getElementById('bkFldB').style.display=W.svc==='wfi'?'':'none';
5775  if(document.getElementById('bkNumB')) document.getElementById('bkNumB').textContent=W.b;

5779    btn.onclick=()=>{
5780      const [k,d]=btn.dataset.bstep.split(',');

5782      const floor = (k==='a'||k==='bag') ? 1 : 0;
5783      W[key]=Math.max(floor, Math.min(40, (W[key]||0) + Number(d)));
5784      if(k==='a' && W.b>W.a) W.b=W.a;
5785      renderWizard();

5789  /* bag choice: hide for commercial enquiries */

5797    bagYes.onclick=()=>{ W.bag=1; renderWizard(); };

5807    :`<div class="ap-note warn" style="margin:0"><i class="ic"><svg class="ic" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#ic-alert"/></svg></i><span>No collection address saved — add one in your profile.</span></div>`;

5810  /* step 2 — date + slots */
5811  const min=new Date(); min.setDate(min.getDate()+BK.leadDays);
5812  const max=new Date(); max.setDate(max.getDate()+BK.horizonDays);

5818  document.getElementById('bkDateLbl').textContent=longDate(W.date);

5823      <div class="opt-m"><strong>${w.label}</strong><small>${w.note} · operator assigned on confirmation</small></div>
5824    </button>`).join('');
5825  document.querySelectorAll('[data-win]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{ W.win=b.dataset.win; renderWizard(); });
5826
5827  /* step 3 summary */
5828  const win=BK.windows.find(w=>w.id===W.win);

5831    ?`<div class="opt" style="margin:0;border:none;padding:0;background:none">
5832        <div class="opt-d"><s>${dayName(d)}</s><b>${d.getDate()}</b><s>${monName(d)}</s></div>
5833        <div class="opt-m"><strong>${win.label}</strong><small>${longDate(W.date)}</small></div>
5834      </div>`:'' ;
5835  const est=estimate(W.svc,W.a,W.b,W.bag?W.bagQty:0);
5836  renderPayOpts(est);
5837  document.getElementById('bkSum').innerHTML=est?sumRows(est):'';
5838  document.getElementById('bkMinNote').textContent=`Minimum service charge of ${money(PX.minimum)} (incl GST) applies per collection, including pickup and return delivery.`;
5839  document.getElementById('bkRecSub').textContent=win
5840    ?`Repeat on ${fromIso(W.date).toLocaleDateString('en-AU',{weekday:'long'})}s in the ${win.label} window.`
5841    :'Repeat on the same day and window each week.';
5842  if(p){
5843    if(!document.getElementById('bkCare').value&&p.care) document.getElementById('bkCare').value=p.care;
5844    if(!document.getElementById('bkDel').value&&p.del)   document.getElementById('bkDel').value=p.del;

5848/* ================================================================
5849   UPDATED renderBookings — filter tabs + rich cards + rebook/support
5850   ================================================================ */
5851const BK_FILTERS=[
5852  { id:'all',       label:'All',          fn:()=>true },
5853  { id:'upcoming',  label:'Upcoming',     fn:b=>['requested','confirmed','assigned'].includes(b.status) },
5854  { id:'complete',  label:'Complete',     fn:b=>b.status==='complete' },
5855  { id:'cancelled', label:'Cancelled',    fn:b=>b.status==='cancelled' }
5856];
5857let bkFilter='all';
5858
5859function renderBookings(){
5860  const container=document.getElementById('bkList');
5861  const all=S.bookings;
5862  const chips=`<div class="bk-filts">${BK_FILTERS.map(f=>`<button class="bk-filt${bkFilter===f.id?' on':''}${f.id==='cancelled'&&bkFilter===f.id?' ck':''}" data-bkf="${f.id}">${f.label} <span style="opacity:.62">(${all.filter(f.fn).length})</span></button>`).join('')}</div>`;
5863  const cur=BK_FILTERS.find(f=>f.id===bkFilter);
5864  const filtered=all.filter(cur.fn);
5865  container.innerHTML=chips+(filtered.length?filtered.map(richBookingCard).join('')
5866    :`<div class="ap-card"><div class="ap-card-b ap-empty"><i class="ic"><svg class="ic" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#ic-calendar"/></svg></i><h3>Nothing here</h3><p>Bookings in this category appear here.</p></div></div>`);
5867  document.querySelectorAll('[data-bkf]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{ bkFilter=b.dataset.bkf; renderBookings(); });
5868  document.querySelectorAll('[data-bkcancel]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>cancelBooking(b.dataset.bkcancel));
5869  document.querySelectorAll('[data-bkrebook]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{
5870    const bk=S.bookings.find(x=>x.id===b.dataset.bkrebook);
5871    if(bk){ W.svc=bk.svc||'wf'; W.win=''; W.date=''; W.step=1; location.hash='#/book'; }
5872  });
5873  document.querySelectorAll('[data-bksupport]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{
5874    const bk=S.bookings.find(x=>x.id===b.dataset.bksupport);
5875    if(bk){ document.getElementById('fbRef').value=bk.ref||''; location.hash='#/feedback'; }

5879/* A booking is a promise with stages. Show where it is, not just a word. */
5880const BK_STAGES = [
5881  ['requested','Booked'], ['assigned','Assigned'], ['collected','Collected'],
5882  ['invoiced','Washed'], ['complete','Returned']
5883];
5884function bkTimeline(b){
5885  if (b.status === 'cancelled') return '';
5886  const at = BK_STAGES.findIndex(s => s[0] === b.status);
5887  const done = at < 0 ? 0 : at;
5888  return '<ol class="bk-tl" aria-label="Progress of this collection">' + BK_STAGES.map(([k,label],i) =>
5889    '<li class="' + (i < done ? 'done' : i === done ? 'now' : '') + '">'
5890    + '<span class="bk-tl-d" aria-hidden="true"></span>'
5891    + '<span class="bk-tl-l">' + label + '</span>'
5892    + (i === done ? '<span class="sr-only"> — current stage</span>' : '')
5893    + '</li>').join('') + '</ol>';
5894}
5895
5896function richBookingCard(b){
5897  const d=fromIso(b.date||isoDate(new Date()));
5898  const stMap={requested:'pd',confirmed:'up',assigned:'up',complete:'ok',cancelled:'cx',invoiced:'pd'};
5899  const stLbl={requested:'AWAITING OPERATOR',confirmed:'CONFIRMED',assigned:'CONFIRMED',complete:'COMPLETE',cancelled:'CANCELLED',invoiced:'AWAITING PAYMENT'};
5900  const pill=`<span class="pill ${stMap[b.status]||'pd'}">${stLbl[b.status]||b.status.toUpperCase()}</span>`;
5901  const borderCls=b.status==='cancelled'?'cx':b.status==='complete'?'ok':['assigned','confirmed'].includes(b.status)?'up':'';
5902  const opName=b.operatorName||'Operator TBC';
5903  const acts=[];
5904  if(['requested','assigned'].includes(b.status)) acts.push(`<button class="btn btn-out" data-bkcancel="${b.id}">Cancel</button>`);
5905  if(b.status==='cancelled') acts.push(`<button class="btn btn-out" data-bkrebook="${b.id}"><svg class="ic ic-inl" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#ic-refresh"/></svg> Rebook</button>`);
5906  acts.push(`<button class="btn btn-out" data-bksupport="${b.id}"><svg class="ic ic-inl" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#ic-headset"/></svg> Support</button>`);
5907  return `<div class="bkc ${borderCls}">
5908    <div class="bkc-h"><i class="ic"><svg class="ic" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#ic-basket"/></svg></i><strong>${esc(SVCNAME(b.svc))}</strong>${pill}</div>
5909    <div class="bkc-b">${bkTimeline(b)}
5910      <div class="bkc-r"><i class="ic"><svg class="ic" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#ic-calendar"/></svg></i><span>${d.toLocaleDateString('en-AU',{weekday:'short',day:'numeric',month:'short'})} · ${esc(b.window||'')}</span></div>
5911      <div class="bkc-r"><i class="ic"><svg class="ic" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#ic-pin"/></svg></i><span>${esc(b.address||b.suburb||'')}</span></div>
5912      ${b.recurring?`<div class="bkc-r"><i class="ic"><svg class="ic" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#ic-refresh"/></svg></i><span>Repeats ${esc(b.recurring)}</span></div>`:''}
5913      <div class="bkc-footer">
5914        <div class="bkc-op"><div class="bkc-av">LL</div>${esc(opName)}</div>
5915        <span class="opt-p" style="font-size:var(--fs-micro)">${b.invoiceTotal?money(b.invoiceTotal):b.estimate?'~'+money(b.estimate):'—'}</span>
5916      </div>
5917    </div>
5918    ${acts.length?`<div class="bkc-acts">${acts.join('')}</div>`:''}
5919  </div>`;
5920}

5922/* ---------------- LEGENDS REWARDS RENDER ---------------- */
5923function renderRewards(){
5924  const r = rewardsState();
5925  const set = (id,v)=>{ const e=document.getElementById(id); if(e) e.textContent=v; };
5926
5927  set('rwCrowns', r.balance.toLocaleString('en-AU'));
5928  set('rwWorth', 'worth ' + money(crownsToAud(r.balance)));
5929  set('rwTier', r.tier.name);
5930  set('rwMult', 'earning ' + r.tier.mult + ' Crown' + (r.tier.mult===1?'':'s') + ' per $1');
5931
5932  /* progress toward the next tier, measured on rolling 12-month spend */
5933  const bar = document.getElementById('rwProgBar');
5934  if (r.next){
5935    const span = r.next.min - r.tier.min;
5936    const pct = span > 0 ? Math.max(0, Math.min(100, ((r.rolling - r.tier.min) / span) * 100)) : 0;
5937    if (bar) bar.style.width = pct.toFixed(1) + '%';
5938    set('rwProgTx', money(Math.max(0, r.next.min - r.rolling)) + ' more in the next 12 months to reach ' + r.next.name + '.');
5939  } else {
5940    if (bar) bar.style.width = '100%';
5941    set('rwProgTx', 'You are at our highest tier. Thank you.');
5942  }
5943
5944  /* redemption menu — a row dims until the balance covers it */
5945  const host = document.getElementById('rwRewards');
5946  if (host){
5947    host.innerHTML = REWARDS.map(x => {
5948      const ok = r.balance >= x.crowns;
5949      return '<div class="rw-row' + (ok?'':' off') + '">'
5950        + '<div class="rw-c">' + x.crowns.toLocaleString('en-AU') + '</div>'
5951        + '<div class="rw-l"><strong>' + esc(x.label) + '</strong>'
5952        + '<small>Value capped at ' + money(x.cap) + '</small></div>'
5953        + '<button class="btn btn-out" data-redeem="' + x.id + '"' + (ok?'':' disabled') + '>'
5954        + (ok ? 'Redeem' : 'Locked') + '</button></div>';
5955    }).join('');
5956    host.querySelectorAll('[data-redeem]').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => redeemCrowns(b.dataset.redeem));
5957  }
5958
5959  const perks = document.getElementById('rwPerks');
5960  if (perks) perks.innerHTML = r.tier.perks.map(p => '<li>' + esc(p) + '</li>').join('');
5961
5962  set('rwRefGive', money(REFERRAL_CREDIT));
5963  set('rwRefGet', money(REFERRAL_CREDIT));
5964  const code = document.getElementById('rwRefCode');
5965  if (code) code.value = r.referralCode || referralCode();
5966
5967  const lapse = document.getElementById('rwLapse');
5968  if (lapse){
5969    lapse.textContent = r.lapsesAt
5970      ? 'Crowns lapse on ' + longDate(isoDate(new Date(r.lapsesAt))) + ' unless you book again before then. Any collection resets the clock.'
5971      : 'Crowns lapse 12 months after your last completed collection.';
5972  }
5973}

5975/* ---------------- PAYMENT CHOICE ON THE BOOKING ---------------- */
5976function renderPayOpts(est){
5977  const host = document.getElementById('bkPayOpts'); if (!host) return;
5978  const p = activeP();
5979  const isBusiness = !!(p && /business|commercial/i.test(p.type || ''));
5980  const avail = PAY_METHODS.filter(m => !m.b2bOnly || isBusiness);
5981  if (!avail.some(m => m.id === W.pay)) W.pay = avail[0].id;
5982
5983  host.innerHTML = avail.map(m =>
5984    '<button type="button" class="payopt' + (W.pay === m.id ? ' on' : '') + '" data-pay="' + m.id + '">'
5985    + '<strong>' + esc(m.name) + (m.depositPct ? ' <em>' + m.depositPct + '% now</em>' : '') + '</strong>'
5986    + '<span>' + esc(m.blurb) + '</span></button>').join('');
5987  host.querySelectorAll('[data-pay]').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => { W.pay = b.dataset.pay; renderWizard(); });
5988
5989  const expl = document.getElementById('bkPayExpl'); if (!expl) return;
5990  const total = est ? est.total : 0;
5991  const plan = payPlan(W.pay, total);
5992  let rows = '<p>' + esc(plan.method.settle) + '</p>';
5993  if (plan.now > 0){
5994    rows += '<div class="prow"><div><strong>Due now</strong><em>' + plan.pct + '% of the estimate</em></div><b>' + money(plan.now) + '</b></div>'
5995          + '<div class="prow"><div><strong>Due after weighing</strong><em>Adjusted to the real amount</em></div><b>' + money(plan.later) + '</b></div>';
5996  } else if (plan.held > 0){
5997    rows += '<div class="prow"><div><strong>Held now</strong><em>Not a charge — released if unused</em></div><b>' + money(plan.held) + '</b></div>'
5998          + '<div class="prow"><div><strong>Charged after weighing</strong><em>The actual amount, up to the hold</em></div><b>at cost</b></div>';
5999  } else {
6000    rows += '<div class="prow"><div><strong>Due now</strong></div><b>Nothing</b></div>'
6001          + '<div class="prow"><div><strong>Due after weighing</strong><em>The actual amount</em></div><b>' + money(total) + ' est.</b></div>';
6002  }
6003  expl.innerHTML = rows + '<p class="ap-fine">Every figure here is the estimate. Your operator confirms the real price after weighing and before any work starts, and you can decline at that point at no cost.</p>';
6004}

6006/* ---------------- INVESTOR + FRANCHISE ---------------- */
6007function wireLeads(){
6008  const go = (btn, fn) => { const e = document.getElementById(btn); if (e) e.onclick = fn; };
6009
6010  go('ivGo', async () => {
6011    if (!val('ivFirst') || !val('ivEmail')){ say('ivMsg', false, 'We need a name and an email to reply to.'); return; }
6012    await save('investorEnquiries', {
6013      first: val('ivFirst'), last: val('ivLast'), email: val('ivEmail'), phone: val('ivPhone'),
6014      org: val('ivOrg'), type: val('ivType'), range: val('ivRange'), notes: val('ivNotes')
6015    }, 'ivMsg', 'Thank you. We will come back to you directly — the pack is sent by a person, not automatically.');
6016  });
6017
6018  go('frGo', async () => {
6019    if (!val('frFirst') || !val('frEmail')){ say('frMsg', false, 'We need a name and an email to reply to.'); return; }
6020    await save('franchiseEnquiries', {
6021      first: val('frFirst'), last: val('frLast'), email: val('frEmail'), phone: val('frPhone'),
6022      area: val('frArea'), experience: val('frExp'), capital: val('frCap'), notes: val('frNotes')
6023    }, 'frMsg', 'Thank you. We will be in touch to talk through the territory and the numbers.');
6024  });
6025
6026  go('frCheck', () => {
6027    const pc = val('frPc');
6028    const res = document.getElementById('frRes'); if (!res) return;
6029    if (!/^\d{4}$/.test(pc)){
6030      res.innerHTML = '<div class="pnote">Enter a four-digit Australian postcode.</div>';
6031      return;
6032    }
6033    /* A postcode we already service is not available to franchise: we run
6034       it ourselves. The pipeline postcodes are the ones worth talking about. */
6035    if (LIVE_PC[pc]){
6036      res.innerHTML = '<div class="pnote"><strong>' + esc(LIVE_PC[pc]) + ' (' + pc + ') is already ours.</strong> '
6037        + 'We operate here directly, so it is not available as a territory. Nearby postcodes may be.</div>';
6038    } else if (SOON_PC[pc]){
6039      res.innerHTML = '<div class="pnote" style="border-left-color:var(--navy)"><strong>' + esc(SOON_PC[pc]) + ' (' + pc + ') is next on our list.</strong> '
6040        + 'This is exactly the kind of territory we are opening. Worth a conversation.</div>';
6041    } else {
6042      res.innerHTML = '<div class="pnote"><strong>' + pc + ' is outside our current footprint.</strong> '
6043        + 'We can still talk, but we would be honest that support is thinner this far out until we have operators nearby.</div>';
6044    }
6045    const area = document.getElementById('frArea');
6046    if (area && !area.value) area.value = pc;
6047  });
6048}

6050/* ---------------- OPERATOR ONBOARDING ---------------- */
6051function obDone(id){
6052  if (id === 'details') return !!(OB.details.first && OB.details.last && OB.details.email && OB.details.phone);
6053  if (id === 'status')  return contractorTest(OB.answers).complete;
6054  if (id === 'identity')return OB.checks.identity === 'verified';
6055  if (id === 'police')  return OB.checks.police === 'cleared';
6056  if (id === 'tax')     return !!(OB.details.tfn && OB.details.superFund && OB.details.bsb);
6057  if (id === 'whs')     return OB.whs.length === OB_WHS.length;
6058  if (id === 'insurance') return OB.details.ownVehicle === 'no' || !!OB.details.policyNo;
6059  return false;
6060}
6061
6062function renderOnboard(){
6063  const steps = document.getElementById('obSteps'); if (!steps) return;
6064
6065  steps.innerHTML = OB_STEPS.map((s,i) => {
6066    const done = obDone(s.id), cur = OB.step === s.id;
6067    return '<button class="ob-step' + (cur?' on':'') + (done?' done':'') + '" data-obstep="' + s.id + '">'
6068      + '<span class="ob-n">' + (done ? '&#10003;' : (i+1)) + '</span>'
6069      + '<span class="ob-t"><strong>' + s.label + '</strong><small>' + s.blurb + '</small></span></button>';
6070  }).join('');
6071  steps.querySelectorAll('[data-obstep]').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => { OB.step = b.dataset.obstep; renderOnboard(); });
6072
6073  const done = OB_STEPS.filter(s => obDone(s.id)).length;
6074  const status = document.getElementById('obStatus');
6075  if (status){
6076    status.innerHTML = OB_STEPS.map(s =>
6077      '<div class="prow"><div><strong>' + s.label + '</strong></div><b style="color:'
6078      + (obDone(s.id) ? 'var(--navy)' : 'var(--mute)') + '">'
6079      + (obDone(s.id) ? 'Done' : 'Waiting') + '</b></div>').join('');
6080  }
6081  const note = document.getElementById('obNote');
6082  if (note) note.textContent = done === OB_STEPS.length
6083    ? 'Everything is in. Max signs off your engagement status, then you are live.'
6084    : done + ' of ' + OB_STEPS.length + ' complete. You can finish these in any order.';
6085
6086  const costs = document.getElementById('obCosts');
6087  if (costs){
6088    const total = OB_VENDORS.id.cost + OB_VENDORS.police.cost;
6089    costs.innerHTML =
6090        '<div class="prow"><div><strong>' + OB_VENDORS.id.name + '</strong><em>Identity, ' + OB_VENDORS.id.turnaround + '</em></div><b>' + money(OB_VENDORS.id.cost) + '</b></div>'
6091      + '<div class="prow"><div><strong>' + OB_VENDORS.police.name + '</strong><em>Police check, ' + OB_VENDORS.police.turnaround + '</em></div><b>' + money(OB_VENDORS.police.cost) + '</b></div>'
6092      + '<div class="prow"><div><strong>Total per operator</strong></div><b style="color:var(--navy)">' + money(total) + '</b></div>';
6093  }
6094
6095  obPanel();
6096}

6098function obPanel(){
6099  const el = document.getElementById('obPanel'); if (!el) return;
6100  const d = OB.details;
6101  const f = (id,label,val,type) => '<div class="fld"><label class="lbl" for="'+id+'">'+label+'</label>'
6102    + '<input class="inp" id="'+id+'" type="'+(type||'text')+'" value="'+esc(val||'')+'"></div>';
6103
6104  if (OB.step === 'details'){
6105    el.innerHTML = '<h3 style="margin-top:0">Your details</h3>'
6106      + '<div class="g2">' + f('obFirst','First name',d.first) + f('obLast','Last name',d.last) + '</div>'
6107      + f('obEmail','Email',d.email,'email') + f('obPhone','Mobile',d.phone,'tel')
6108      + f('obDob','Date of birth',d.dob,'date')
6109      + f('obAddr','Residential address',d.addr)
6110      + f('obAbn','ABN (if you have one)',d.abn)
6111      + '<p class="ap-fine">An ABN does not by itself make you a contractor. The next step works that out properly.</p>'
6112      + '<button class="btn btn-nv btn-full" style="margin-top:1rem" id="obSaveDetails">Save and continue</button>'
6113      + '<p class="pnote" id="obMsg" style="margin-top:.8rem"></p>';
6114    document.getElementById('obSaveDetails').onclick = () => {
6115      ['first','last','email','phone','dob','addr','abn'].forEach(k => {
6116        OB.details[k] = val('ob' + k.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + k.slice(1));
6117      });
6118      if (!OB.details.first || !OB.details.email){ say('obMsg', false, 'We need at least your name and email.'); return; }
6119      OB.step = 'status'; renderOnboard();
6120    };
6121    return;
6122  }
6123
6124  if (OB.step === 'status'){
6125    const t = contractorTest(OB.answers);
6126    el.innerHTML = '<h3 style="margin-top:0">Engagement check</h3>'
6127      + '<p>This is the Fair Work multi-factor test. It decides whether the law treats this role as contracting or employment, which in turn decides superannuation and payroll tax. No single answer settles it.</p>'
6128      + OB_FACTORS.map(q =>
6129          '<div class="ob-q"><strong>' + q.q + '</strong>'
6130          + q.a.map(([label,v]) =>
6131              '<button type="button" class="ob-a' + (OB.answers[q.id]===v?' on':'') + '" data-obq="' + q.id + '" data-obv="' + v + '">'
6132              + esc(label) + '</button>').join('')
6133          + '</div>').join('')
6134      + '<div class="ob-out ' + t.outcome + '"><strong>' + ({
6135            contractor:'Independent contractor', employee:'Employee', review:'Needs review', incomplete:'Not finished'
6136          })[t.outcome] + '</strong><p>' + t.why + '</p>'
6137      + (t.superFlag && t.complete ? '<p class="ap-fine"><strong>Flagged:</strong> superannuation is likely payable and this may count toward payroll tax grouping. Max signs this off before engagement.</p>' : '')
6138      + '</div>';
6139    el.querySelectorAll('[data-obq]').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => {
6140      OB.answers[b.dataset.obq] = b.dataset.obv; renderOnboard();
6141    });
6142    return;
6143  }
6144
6145  if (OB.step === 'identity' || OB.step === 'police'){
6146    const isId = OB.step === 'identity';
6147    const v = isId ? OB_VENDORS.id : OB_VENDORS.police;
6148    const state = isId ? OB.checks.identity : OB.checks.police;
6149    const target = isId ? 'verified' : 'cleared';
6150    el.innerHTML = '<h3 style="margin-top:0">' + (isId ? 'Identity' : 'Police check') + '</h3>'
6151      + '<p>' + (isId
6152          ? 'You photograph your licence or passport and take a short selfie. The match is done by ' + v.name + ' and takes about a minute.'
6153          : 'A National Police Certificate through ' + v.name + '. Most come back the same day; some take up to three.') + '</p>'
6154      + '<div class="prow"><div><strong>Provider</strong></div><b>' + v.name + '</b></div>'
6155      + '<div class="prow"><div><strong>Status</strong></div><b style="color:' + (state===target?'var(--navy)':'var(--mute)') + '">' + state + '</b></div>'
6156      + (state === 'not started'
6157          ? '<button class="btn btn-red btn-full" style="margin-top:1rem" id="obStart">Start ' + (isId?'identity check':'police check') + '</button>'
6158          : state === target
6159            ? '<p class="pnote" style="margin-top:1rem">This check is complete. Nothing further needed.</p>'
6160            : '<p class="pnote" style="margin-top:1rem">Submitted. We will email you the moment it clears — you do not need to wait on this page.</p>')
6161      + '<p class="ap-fine">We pay for this check. Your documents go straight to the provider and are not stored by Laundrylegends.</p>';
6162    const btn = document.getElementById('obStart');
6163    if (btn) btn.onclick = () => {
6164      /* The real handoff runs through the legends-api worker, which holds
6165         the vendor credentials and receives the result by webhook. */
6166      if (isId) OB.checks.identity = 'in progress'; else OB.checks.police = 'submitted';
6167      renderOnboard();
6168    };
6169    return;
6170  }
6171
6172  if (OB.step === 'tax'){
6173    el.innerHTML = '<h3 style="margin-top:0">Tax, super and bank</h3>'
6174      + f('obTfn','Tax file number',d.tfn)
6175      + f('obSuper','Superannuation fund',d.superFund)
6176      + f('obSuperNo','Member number',d.superNo)
6177      + '<div class="g2">' + f('obBsb','BSB',d.bsb) + f('obAcct','Account number',d.acct) + '</div>'
6178      + '<p class="ap-fine">Your TFN is sent straight to our accountant and is never displayed back in this portal.</p>'
6179      + '<button class="btn btn-nv btn-full" style="margin-top:1rem" id="obSaveTax">Save</button>';
6180    document.getElementById('obSaveTax').onclick = () => {
6181      OB.details.tfn = val('obTfn'); OB.details.superFund = val('obSuper');
6182      OB.details.superNo = val('obSuperNo'); OB.details.bsb = val('obBsb'); OB.details.acct = val('obAcct');
6183      renderOnboard();
6184    };
6185    return;
6186  }
6187
6188  if (OB.step === 'whs'){
6189    el.innerHTML = '<h3 style="margin-top:0">Safety</h3>'
6190      + '<p>Tick each one to confirm you have read and understood it. These are the obligations that come with handling chemicals and driving for work.</p>'
6191      + OB_WHS.map((w,i) =>
6192          '<label class="ob-chk"><input type="checkbox" data-obwhs="' + i + '"'
6193          + (OB.whs.includes(i)?' checked':'') + '><span>' + esc(w) + '</span></label>').join('')
6194      + '<p class="ap-fine">Safety data sheets and the manual handling guide are in the operator portal once you are live.</p>';
6195    el.querySelectorAll('[data-obwhs]').forEach(c => c.onchange = () => {
6196      const i = Number(c.dataset.obwhs);
6197      OB.whs = c.checked ? OB.whs.concat([i]).filter((x,n,a)=>a.indexOf(x)===n) : OB.whs.filter(x => x !== i);
6198      renderOnboard();
6199    });
6200    return;
6201  }
6202
6203  if (OB.step === 'insurance'){
6204    const own = OB.details.ownVehicle || '';
6205    el.innerHTML = '<h3 style="margin-top:0">Insurance</h3>'
6206      + '<p>Only needed if you drive your own vehicle for collections.</p>'
6207      + '<div class="ap-g2">'
6208      + '<button type="button" class="bagopt' + (own==='yes'?' on':'') + '" data-obveh="yes"><strong>I use my own vehicle</strong><span>Comprehensive motor cover required</span></button>'
6209      + '<button type="button" class="bagopt' + (own==='no'?' on':'') + '" data-obveh="no"><strong>I do not drive for collections</strong><span>No motor cover needed</span></button>'
6210      + '</div>'
6211      + (own === 'yes'
6212          ? f('obInsurer','Insurer',d.insurer) + f('obPolicy','Policy number',d.policyNo) + f('obExpiry','Expiry date',d.expiry,'date')
6213            + '<button class="btn btn-nv btn-full" style="margin-top:1rem" id="obSaveIns">Save</button>'
6214          : own === 'no' ? '<p class="pnote" style="margin-top:1rem">Nothing further needed here.</p>' : '');
6215    el.querySelectorAll('[data-obveh]').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => {
6216      OB.details.ownVehicle = b.dataset.obveh; renderOnboard();
6217    });
6218    const s = document.getElementById('obSaveIns');
6219    if (s) s.onclick = () => {
6220      OB.details.insurer = val('obInsurer'); OB.details.policyNo = val('obPolicy'); OB.details.expiry = val('obExpiry');
6221      renderOnboard();
6222    };
6223  }
6224}

6245function calcHotel(){
6246  const host = document.getElementById('htResult'); if (!host) return;
6247  const v = id => { const e = document.getElementById(id); return e ? Number(e.value) : 0; };
6248  const m = hotelModel(v('htRooms'), v('htOcc'), v('htConv'), v('htProps'));
6249  const props = Math.max(1, v('htProps') || 1);
6250  host.innerHTML =
6251      '<div class="prow"><div><strong>Your commission tier</strong>'
6252    + '<em>' + esc(m.tier.note) + '</em></div><b>' + m.tier.pct + '%</b></div>'
6253    + '<div class="prow"><div><strong>Rooms occupied each night</strong>'
6254    + '<em>Across ' + props + ' propert' + (props === 1 ? 'y' : 'ies') + '</em></div><b>'
6255    + Math.round(m.occupied * props).toLocaleString('en-AU') + '</b></div>'
6256    + '<div class="prow"><div><strong>Guest orders per day</strong></div><b>'
6257    + (m.ordersPerDay * props).toFixed(1) + '</b></div>'
6258    + '<div class="prow"><div><strong>Laundry revenue a year</strong>'
6259    + '<em>At a ' + money(HOTEL_BLEND) + ' blended order</em></div><b>'
6260    + bigMoney(m.annual) + '</b></div>'
6261    + '<div class="prow" style="border-top:2px solid var(--navy)"><div><strong>Your commission a year</strong>'
6262    + '<em>' + bigMoney(m.monthly) + ' a month, or ' + money(m.perRoomNight)
6263    + ' per available room-night</em></div><b style="font-size:1.15rem;color:var(--navy)">'
6264    + bigMoney(m.commission) + '</b></div>';
6265}

6288function wireRewards(){
6289  const btn = document.getElementById('rwRefCopy');
6290  if (!btn) return;
6291  btn.onclick = async () => {
6292    const code = referralCode();
6293    const link = location.origin + location.pathname + '#/book?ref=' + encodeURIComponent(code);
6294    let copied = false;
6295    try { await navigator.clipboard.writeText(link); copied = true; } catch(e){}
6296    say('rwRefMsg', true, copied ? 'Referral link copied. Send it to anyone.' : 'Copy this link: ' + link);
6297    await saveAcct();
6298  };
6299}

6301/* A stable per-account code. Derived from the account ref so it survives
6302   a reload without needing another round trip to the database. */
6303function referralCode(){
6304  S.acct.rewards = S.acct.rewards || {};
6305  if (!S.acct.rewards.referralCode){
6306    const seed = (S.acct.first || 'GUEST').replace(/[^a-z]/gi,'').slice(0,5).toUpperCase() || 'GUEST';
6307    S.acct.rewards.referralCode = seed + '-' + uid4().toUpperCase();
6308  }
6309  return S.acct.rewards.referralCode;
6310}

6312async function redeemCrowns(id){
6313  const x = REWARDS.find(w => w.id === id); if (!x) return;
6314  const r = rewardsState();
6315  if (r.balance < x.crowns){ say('rwRefMsg', false, 'Not enough Crowns for that reward yet.'); return; }
6316  S.acct.rewards = S.acct.rewards || {};
6317  S.acct.rewards.balance = r.balance - x.crowns;
6318  S.acct.rewards.redeemed = (S.acct.rewards.redeemed || []).concat([{ id:x.id, crowns:x.crowns, at:Date.now() }]);
6319  await saveAcct();
6320  addMessage('REWARDS', 'Reward applied: ' + x.label,
6321    x.label + ' has been added to your account and will be applied to your next collection. '
6322    + x.crowns.toLocaleString('en-AU') + ' Crowns were deducted. Value capped at ' + money(x.cap) + '.');
6323  renderRewards(); renderMessages();
6324}

6368/* ---------- INSTALL PROMPT ----------
6369   Web-first is the promise, so the app is installable without an app store.
6370   Offered once, after a booking, and never again if dismissed. */
6371let LK_INSTALL = null;
6372window.addEventListener('beforeinstallprompt', e => { e.preventDefault(); LK_INSTALL = e; });
6373function offerInstall(){
6374  try {
6375    if (!LK_INSTALL || localStorage.getItem('lk-install') === 'done') return;
6376  } catch(e){ if (!LK_INSTALL) return; }
6377  const bar = document.getElementById('lkInstall');
6378  if (!bar) return;
6379  bar.classList.add('show');
6380  bar.querySelector('[data-install]').onclick = async () => {
6381    bar.classList.remove('show');
6382    try { localStorage.setItem('lk-install','done'); } catch(e){}
6383    LK_INSTALL.prompt(); LK_INSTALL = null;
6384  };
6385  bar.querySelector('[data-install-no]').onclick = () => {
6386    bar.classList.remove('show');
6387    try { localStorage.setItem('lk-install','done'); } catch(e){}
6388  };
6389}

6391function wireWizard(){
6392  const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);
6393  if (!$('bkGo')) return;
6394
6395  /* approximate quantity */
6396  document.querySelectorAll('[data-bstep]').forEach(btn => {
6397    btn.onclick = () => {
6398      const [k, d] = btn.dataset.bstep.split(',');
6399      W[k] = Math.max(k === 'a' ? 1 : 0, Math.min(40, W[k] + Number(d)));
6400      renderWizard();
6401    };
6402  });
6403
6404  const di = $('bkDate');
6405  if (di) di.onchange = () => { W.date = di.value; W.win = ''; renderWizard(); };
6406
6407  $('bkBack').onclick = () => { if (W.step > 1 && W.step < 4) wizStep(W.step - 1); else location.hash = '#/app'; };
6408  $('bkP2').onclick   = () => wizStep(1);
6409  $('bkP3').onclick   = () => wizStep(2);
6410
6411  $('bkN1').onclick = () => {
6412    if (W.svc === 'comm'){ location.hash = '#/business'; return; }
6413    const p = activeP();
6414    if (!p || !addrLine(p)){ say('bkMsg', false, 'Add a collection address to this profile before booking.'); return; }
6415    renderWizard(); wizStep(2);
6416  };
6417
6418  $('bkN2').onclick = () => {
6419    if (!W.date){ say('bkMsg', false, 'Choose a collection date to continue.'); return; }
6420    if (!W.win){  say('bkMsg', false, 'Choose a collection window to continue.'); return; }
6421    renderWizard(); wizStep(3);
6422  };
6423
6424  /* recurring collection */
6425  const rec = $('bkRec');
6426  rec.onclick = () => {
6427    W.rec = !W.rec;
6428    rec.classList.toggle('on', W.rec);
6429    rec.setAttribute('aria-pressed', W.rec ? 'true' : 'false');
6430    $('bkRecOpts').style.display = W.rec ? '' : 'none';
6431  };
6432  const rf = $('bkRecFreq'); if (rf) rf.onchange = () => { W.freq = rf.value; };
6433
6434  /* terms gate the confirm button */
6435  const tos = $('bkTos'), go = $('bkGo');
6436  const syncTos = () => { go.disabled = !tos.checked; go.setAttribute('aria-disabled', tos.checked ? 'false' : 'true'); };
6437  tos.onchange = syncTos; syncTos();
6438
6439  go.onclick = async () => {
6440    const p = activeP();
6441    if (!tos.checked){ say('bkMsg', false, 'Please accept the terms to confirm this booking.'); return; }
6442    if (!p || !addrLine(p)){ say('bkMsg', false, 'Add a collection address before confirming.'); return; }
6443    if (!W.win){ say('bkMsg', false, 'Choose a collection window.'); return; }
6444    go.disabled = true;
6445    try {
6446      const win  = BK.windows.find(w => w.id === W.win) || { label:'' };
6447      const est  = estimate(W.svc, W.a, W.b);
6448      const care = ($('bkCare').value || '').trim();
6449      const del  = ($('bkDel').value  || '').trim();
6450      const b = {
6451        id: 'b' + uid4(),
6452        ref: REF(),
6453        status: 'requested',
6454        svc: W.svc,
6455        service: SVCNAME(W.svc),
6456        date: W.date,
6457        window: win.label,
6458        a: W.a, b: W.b,
6459        linenItems: W.svc === 'linen' ? W.a : 0,
6460        estimate: est ? est.total : 0,
6461        care: care,
6462        delivery: del,
6463        recurring: W.rec ? W.freq : '',
6464        profile: p.name,
6465        contact: p.contact || p.name,
6466        email: p.email || S.acct.email || '',
6467        phone: p.phone || S.acct.phone || '',
6468        address: addrLine(p),
6469        suburb: p.suburb || '',
6470        postcode: p.postcode || '',
6471        createdAt: new Date().toISOString()
6472      };
6473
6474      S.bookings.unshift(b);
6475      await pushDoc('bookings', b);
6476
6477      /* hand the job to operations */
6478      if (DB){
6479        try { const { id, ...rest } = b; await DB.collection('bookings_inbox').doc(id).set(rest); }
6480        catch(e){ console.error('[LL] bookings_inbox', e); }
6481      }
6482
6483      /* optionally keep the notes on the profile */
6484      if ($('bkCareSave').checked || $('bkDelSave').checked){
6485        if ($('bkCareSave').checked) p.care = care;
6486        if ($('bkDelSave').checked)  p.del  = del;
6487        await saveProfile(p);
6488      }
6489
6490      addMessage(b.ref, b.ref + ' received',
6491        'We have your collection request for ' + longDate(b.date) + ', ' + b.window + '. '
6492        + 'Your operator is assigned before the day and will message you ahead of arrival. '
6493        + 'The final price is confirmed after weighing and counting, before any work begins.');
6494
6495      const tx = $('bkDoneTx');
6496      if (tx) tx.textContent = 'Reference ' + b.ref + '. We have your request for ' + longDate(b.date)
6497        + ', ' + b.window + '. You will get a message here once an operator is assigned.';
6498
6499      renderBookings(); renderMessages(); renderHome(); renderTabs('book');
6500      offerInstall();
6501      say('bkMsg', true, 'Booking ' + b.ref + ' requested.');
6502      wizStep(4);
6503    } catch(e){
6504      console.error('[LL] booking', e);
6505      say('bkMsg', false, 'Could not confirm that booking. Please try again.');
6506    } finally {
6507      go.disabled = false;
6508    }
6509  };
6510}

6512function wireSettings(){
6513  const $  = id => document.getElementById(id);
6514  const v  = id => { const e = $(id); return e ? String(e.value || '').trim() : ''; };
6515  const on = (id, fn) => { const e = $(id); if (e) e.onclick = fn; };
6516
6517  /* profile switcher sheet */
6518  ['apSw','apSw2'].forEach(id => on(id, openSheet));
6519  on('sheetX', closeSheet);
6520  on('sheetUser', closeSheet);
6521  on('sheetHelp', closeSheet);
6522  const sh = $('sheet');
6523  if (sh) sh.onclick = e => { if (e.target === sh) closeSheet(); };
6524  document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
6525    if (e.key === 'Escape' && sh && sh.classList.contains('open')) closeSheet();
6526  });
6527  on('sheetNew', async () => {
6528    const p = { id: 'p' + uid4(), name: 'New profile', type: 'Household', preferred: false, state: 'QLD' };
6529    S.profiles.push(p);
6530    S.acct.activeId = p.id;
6531    await saveProfile(p); await saveAcct();
6532    closeSheet();
6533    renderAccount(); renderForms(); renderHome(); renderWizard();
6534    location.hash = '#/pdetails';
6535  });
6536
6537  /* profile and contact details */
6538  on('pdGo', async () => {
6539    const p = activeP(); if (!p){ say('pdMsg', false, 'No profile selected.'); return; }
6540    if (!v('pdName')){ say('pdMsg', false, 'A profile name is required.'); return; }
6541    Object.assign(p, { name: v('pdName'), contact: v('pdContact'), email: v('pdEmail'),
6542                       phone: v('pdPhone'), type: v('pdType'), preferred: $('pdPref').checked });
6543    let ok = await saveProfile(p);
6544    if (p.preferred){
6545      for (const o of S.profiles) if (o.id !== p.id && o.preferred){ o.preferred = false; ok = (await saveProfile(o)) && ok; }
6546    }
6547    say('pdMsg', ok, ok ? 'Profile saved.' : 'Saved for this session only — sign in to keep it.');
6548    renderAccount(); renderHome(); renderWizard();
6549  });
6550
6551  /* service preferences */
6552  on('pfGo', async () => {
6553    const p = activeP(); if (!p){ say('pfMsg', false, 'No profile selected.'); return; }
6554    Object.assign(p, { care: v('pfCare'), del: v('pfDel'), svc: v('pfSvc'), eco: $('pfEco').checked });
6555    const ok = await saveProfile(p);
6556    say('pfMsg', ok, ok ? 'Service preferences saved.' : 'Saved for this session only — sign in to keep them.');
6557    renderWizard();
6558  });
6559
6560  /* pick up address, with a live coverage answer */
6561  on('adGo', async () => {
6562    const p = activeP(); if (!p){ say('adMsg', false, 'No profile selected.'); return; }
6563    if (!v('adLine1') || !v('adSub') || !v('adPc')){
6564      say('adMsg', false, 'Street address, suburb and postcode are all required.'); return;
6565    }
6566    Object.assign(p, { line1: v('adLine1'), suburb: v('adSub'), postcode: v('adPc'),
6567                       state: v('adState') || 'QLD', access: v('adAccess') });
6568    const ok = await saveProfile(p);
6569    const cov = $('adCov'), pc = v('adPc');
6570    if (cov){
6571      cov.style.display = '';
6572      if (LIVE_PC[pc]){
6573        cov.className = 'ap-note ok';
6574        cov.innerHTML = '<i class="ic"><svg class="ic" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#ic-check-circle"/></svg></i><span>We collect in ' + esc(LIVE_PC[pc]) + ' (' + esc(pc) + ').</span>';
6575      } else if (SOON_PC[pc]){
6576        cov.className = 'ap-note warn';
6577        cov.innerHTML = '<i class="ic"><svg class="ic" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#ic-clock"/></svg></i><span>' + esc(SOON_PC[pc]) + ' (' + esc(pc) + ') is opening next. Register interest on the coverage page and we will tell you when it is live.</span>';
6578      } else {
6579        cov.className = 'ap-note warn';
6580        cov.innerHTML = '<i class="ic"><svg class="ic" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#ic-pin"/></svg></i><span>We are not collecting in ' + esc(pc) + ' yet. The address is saved — register interest on the <a href="#/coverage" style="text-decoration:underline">coverage page</a>.</span>';
6581      }
6582    }
6583    say('adMsg', ok, ok ? 'Address saved.' : 'Saved for this session only — sign in to keep it.');
6584    renderAccount(); renderHome(); renderWizard();
6585  });
6586
6587  /* account-level user details */
6588  on('udGo', async () => {
6589    if (!v('udFirst')){ say('udMsg', false, 'A first name is required.'); return; }
6590    Object.assign(S.acct, { first: v('udFirst'), last: v('udLast'), email: v('udEmail'), phone: v('udPhone') });
6591    const ok = await saveAcct();
6592    say('udMsg', ok, ok ? 'Your details are saved.' : 'Saved for this session only — sign in to keep them.');
6593    renderAccount();
6594  });
6595
6596  /* communication settings */
6597  on('cmGo', async () => {
6598    document.querySelectorAll('[data-cm]').forEach(b => { S.acct.comms[b.dataset.cm] = b.classList.contains('on'); });
6599    const ok = await saveAcct();
6600    say('cmMsg', ok, ok ? 'Communication settings saved.' : 'Saved for this session only — sign in to keep them.');
6601  });
6602}

6604async function appBoot(){
6605  await appLoad();
6606  try { wireWizard(); } catch(e){ console.error('[LL] wireWizard', e); }
6607  try { wireSettings(); } catch(e){ console.error('[LL] wireSettings', e); }

6609  ['apVer','apVer2'].forEach(i=>{ const e=document.getElementById(i); if(e) e.textContent='v1.0 · '+(PERSISTED?'signed in':'session only'); });
6610  renderHome(); renderAccount(); renderForms(); renderWizard(); renderBookings(); renderMessages();
6611  appRoute(curId);
6612  if(!PERSISTED){
6613    const udSecEl=document.getElementById('udSec'); if(udSecEl) udSecEl.textContent='This view is not signed in, so anything you enter is held for this session only and is cleared when you close the page.';

6615  if(DB){
6616    try{ DB.doc('config/booking').onSnapshot(s=>{ if(s.exists){ BK=Object.assign({},DEFAULT_BOOKING,s.data()); renderWizard(); } },()=>{}); }catch(e){}
6617    try{ DB.doc('config/contact').onSnapshot(s=>{
6618      if(!s.exists) return; const c=s.data();
6619      if(c.email) document.getElementById('helpEmail').textContent=c.email;
6620      if(c.phone) document.getElementById('helpPhone').textContent=c.phone;
6621    },()=>{}); }catch(e){}
6622  }
6623  if(CAN_EDIT){ opsLoad(); }
6624}

6721    lS:   px.linenSheetSet ?? 24,
6722    lB:   px.linenBlanket ?? 32,
6723    lR:   px.linenRug ?? 42
6724  };
6725  let subtotal, lineL, lineV;
6726  if(H5Q.svc==='wf'){
6727    subtotal = H5Q.loads * P.load;
6728    lineL = `${H5Q.loads} × wash & fold load${H5Q.loads>1?'s':''}`;
6729    lineV = money(subtotal);
6730  } else {
6731    subtotal = H5Q.sh*P.lS + H5Q.bl*P.lB + H5Q.rg*P.lR;
6732    const parts = [];
6733    if(H5Q.sh) parts.push(`${H5Q.sh} sheet set${H5Q.sh>1?'s':''}`);
6734    if(H5Q.bl) parts.push(`${H5Q.bl} blanket${H5Q.bl>1?'s':''}`);
6735    if(H5Q.rg) parts.push(`${H5Q.rg} rug${H5Q.rg>1?'s':''}`);
6736    lineL = parts.length ? parts.join(', ') : 'Add at least one item';
6737    lineV = money(subtotal);
6738  }
6739  const total = Math.max(subtotal + P.del, P.min);
6740  const belowMin = (subtotal + P.del) < P.min;
6741  const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);
6742  if($('h5LineL')) $('h5LineL').textContent = lineL;
6743  if($('h5LineV')) $('h5LineV').textContent = lineV;
6744  if($('h5Tot'))  $('h5Tot').textContent  = money(total);
6745  if($('h5MinNote')) $('h5MinNote').textContent = belowMin ? `Below the ${money(P.min)} minimum — the minimum applies.` : '';
6746}

6748  const seg = document.querySelectorAll('.h5-seg button');
6749  seg.forEach(b => b.addEventListener('click', () => {

6751    b.classList.add('on'); b.setAttribute('aria-selected','true');

6756  }));
6757  document.querySelectorAll('.h5-stepper').forEach(st => {
6758    st.querySelectorAll('.h5-st-b').forEach(b => b.addEventListener('click', () => {
6759      const d = +b.dataset.d;
6760      const key = st.dataset.h5step;
6761      const map = { 'loads':'loads','lin-s':'sh','lin-b':'bl','lin-r':'rg' };
6762      const k = map[key]; if(!k) return;
6763      const min = (k==='loads') ? 1 : 0;
6764      H5Q[k] = Math.max(min, Math.min(20, H5Q[k]+d));
6765      const v = st.querySelector('.h5-st-v');

6769    }));
6770  });

6775const KC_PLANS = {
6776  solo: { name:'Solo',   who:'One to two people. One standard bag each week.',              price:'plan1' },
6777  pair: { name:'Pair',   who:'Two-person household. Weekly bag with room to spare.',       price:'plan2' },
6778  fam:  { name:'Family', who:'Three to four people. Two bags a week or one big bag.',       price:'plan3' }
6779};
6780const KC_STATE = { plan:'solo', loads:2 };
6781function kcPrice(planKey){
6782  const px = (typeof PX==='object'?PX:{}) || {};
6783  const key = KC_PLANS[planKey].price;
6784  return px[key] ?? { plan1:63.70, plan2:89.70, plan3:115.70 }[key];
6785}
6786function kcRecalc(){
6787  const px = (typeof PX==='object'?PX:{}) || {};
6788  const load = px.load ?? 32;
6789  const del = px.delivery ?? 13.50;
6790  const min = px.min ?? 73.50;
6791  const plan = KC_PLANS[KC_STATE.plan];
6792  const price = kcPrice(KC_STATE.plan);
6793  const adhocPerBooking = Math.max(KC_STATE.loads*load + del, min);
6794  const save = adhocPerBooking - price;
6795  const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);
6796  if($('kcName')) $('kcName').textContent = plan.name;
6797  if($('kcWho'))  $('kcWho').textContent = plan.who;
6798  if($('kcPrice')) $('kcPrice').textContent = money(price);
6799  if($('kcCtaName')) $('kcCtaName').textContent = plan.name;
6800  if($('kcSliderV')) $('kcSliderV').textContent = KC_STATE.loads;
6801  if($('kcAdhoc')) $('kcAdhoc').textContent = money(adhocPerBooking);
6802  if($('kcCalcPlanLbl')) $('kcCalcPlanLbl').textContent = `Legends Club ${plan.name}`;
6803  if($('kcCalcPlan')) $('kcCalcPlan').textContent = money(price);
6804  const saveTxt = save >= 0 ? `${money(save)}/wk` : `${money(-save)} more/wk`;
6805  if($('kcSave')) $('kcSave').textContent = saveTxt;
6806  const yearly = Math.round(save*52);
6807  if($('kcCalcFine')) $('kcCalcFine').textContent = save >= 0
6808    ? `≈ ${money(yearly)} saved a year at ${KC_STATE.loads} load${KC_STATE.loads>1?'s':''}/week, vs Legends Club ${plan.name}.`
6809    : `Legends Club ${plan.name} costs ${money(-yearly)} more a year at just ${KC_STATE.loads} load${KC_STATE.loads>1?'s':''}/week — add more loads to save.`;
6810  const sl = $('kcSlider');
6811  if(sl){ const pct = ((KC_STATE.loads-1)/(5-1))*100; sl.style.setProperty('--kc-fill', pct+'%'); }
6812}
6813function kcWire(){
6814  const tabs = document.querySelectorAll('.kc-tabs button');
6815  tabs.forEach(b => b.addEventListener('click', () => {
6816    tabs.forEach(x => { x.classList.remove('on'); x.setAttribute('aria-selected','false'); });
6817    b.classList.add('on'); b.setAttribute('aria-selected','true');
6818    KC_STATE.plan = b.dataset.kc;
6819    kcRecalc();
6820  }));

6822  if(sl) sl.addEventListener('input', () => { KC_STATE.loads = +sl.value; kcRecalc(); });

6851function revealOn(){
6852  if (!('IntersectionObserver' in window)){ document.querySelectorAll('.reveal').forEach(r => r.classList.add('in')); return; }
6853  const io = new IntersectionObserver((ents) => {
6854    ents.forEach(en => { if(en.isIntersecting){ en.target.classList.add('in'); io.unobserve(en.target); } });
6855  }, { rootMargin:'-40px 0px' });
6856  document.querySelectorAll('.reveal').forEach(r => io.observe(r));
6857}
